jobs.title: DIRECTOR, GOVERNMENT FUNDS - Montreal, Ottawa & Toronto
jobs.description:
We are banking at another level. 

 Choosing BDC as your employer means working in a healthy, inclusive, and skilled workplace that puts forward the best conditions to bring together unique teams where employees are empowered to act. It also means being at the centre of ambitious economic and financial projects to see further and to do things differently, to fuel the success of Canadian entrepreneurs.

 Choosing BDC as your employer also means: 
 Flexible and competitive benefits, including an Employee Savings and Investment Plan where BDC matches part of your voluntary contributions, a Defined Benefit Pension Plan, a $750 wellness and health care spending account, to name a few   

 In addition to paid vacation each year, five personal days, sick days as necessary, and our offices are closed from December 25 to January 1 

 A hybrid work model that truly balances work and personal life

 Opportunities for learning, training and development, and much more... 

 Explore the BDC Way in our Culture Book 

 Join a team shaping Canada’s venture capital ecosystem 
 At BDC, the Government Funds team manages capital on behalf of the Government of Canada to strengthen and grow Canada’s venture capital market. This includes deploying $350M under the Venture Capital Action Plan (VCAP), $450M under the Venture Capital Catalyst Initiative (VCCI), and $450M under the Renewed Venture Capital Catalyst Initiative (Renewed VCCI). These programs totalling $1.2B AUM are designed to crowd in private capital and support fund managers across the Canadian venture capital asset class.
 Building on this foundation, BDC is now deploying the $1B Growth Venture Capital Catalyst Initiative (Growth VCCI), a landmark platform focused on scaling Canada’s most promising funds and innovative companies.
 This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of investment, policy, and ecosystem development, with direct exposure to the most prominent Canadian fund managers while contributing to a national priority initiative shaping Canada’s innovation economy.

 POSITION OVERVIEW 
 As Director, you will combine leadership, investment expertise, and complex project management to support the deployment and oversight of government-backed venture capital programs, including VCAP, VCCI, Renewed VCCI, and upcoming Growth VCCI.
 You will play a lead role in investment execution, stakeholder management, and portfolio governance, while engaging closely with fund managers, institutional partners, and internal stakeholders including Government.

 CHALLENGES TO BE MET 
 Investment Expertise 
 Lead complex business and legal negotiations with fund managers and external stakeholders for execution of program delivery including fund investments.
 Provide strategic oversight of investment activities across the portfolio, ensuring alignment between policy objectives, portfolio construction considerations, and market dynamics
 Provide senior investment judgment and guidance on fund performance, risk management, and portfolio development matters

 Fund Oversight & Governance 
 Serve as BDC’s representative on portfolio funds’ LPACs and other governance bodies
 Monitor fund performance, governance, and compliance with fund agreements and program requirements
 Provide strategic insight and constructive challenge to support strong governance practices and enhance fund outcomes
 Guide fund managers on governance and operational best practices to strengthen the long-term sustainability of the venture capital ecosystem

 Leadership and Team Management 
 Demonstrate leadership in team meetings and operations processes, ensuring effective resource allocation, quality control, operational excellence, and alignment with strategic priorities
 Ensure the timely and accurate execution of operational activities, including capital calls, distributions, reporting, and stakeholder deliverables
 Provide coaching, mentorship, and leadership to a team of Analysts, fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture focused on continuous improvement and professional development
 Identify capability and capacity gaps, oversee recruitment and onboarding activities, and promote knowledge sharing and best practices across the team

 Program Delivery & Stakeholder Management 
 Provide strategic input into the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of current and future government investment programs
 Respond to complex and time-sensitive requests from internal and external stakeholders while maintaining a high standard of service and professionalism
 Oversee the preparation and dissemination of quarterly and annual reporting, performance dashboards, and stakeholder communications
 Ensure high standards of quality, consistency, accuracy, and timeliness across all reporting outputs and program deliverables

 Portfolio & Ecosystem Leadership 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with fund managers, institutional investors, ecosystem stakeholders, and government partners
 Represent BDC Capital and Government Funds at industry conferences, panels, events, and stakeholder forums
 Stay closely connected to venture capital trends, market developments, and emerging opportunities to support strategic decision-making
 Support and lead thought leadership initiatives, market studies, and research projects that generate insights from government investment programs and portfolio activities

 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 Experience and qualifications 
 Minimum of a Bachelor degree in Commerce or a related discipline (finance, accounting, law or business administration preferred), or an equivalent combination of academic training and relevant professional experience
 10 years+ experience in venture capital, private equity, or growth investing, with direct exposure to deal-making at the fund level as well as investment underwriting, structuring, business and legal negotiations and execution
 Demonstrated expertise in venture capital fund structures, LPAs, governance frameworks, and policy-driven investment programs
 Demonstrated ability to lead complex negotiations and manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously
 Significant experience serving on LPACs, Boards of Directors, or equivalent governance bodies
 Ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships involving fund managers, institutional investors, government representatives, and senior executives
 Strong understanding of the Canadian venture capital ecosystem and a well-established network of industry relationships
 Experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing teams

 Core competencies 
 Strong strategic and investment judgment
 Demonstrated leadership and people management capabilities
 Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
 Ability to align operational execution with broader policy, program, and organizational objectives
 High level of rigour, organization, and attention to detail
 Ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment
 Collaborative mindset with a commitment to team development, knowledge sharing, and excellence

 The position is primarily based in Montreal or Ottawa, with a preference for these locations. Toronto is also acceptable.
 BDC is committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace that reflects the communities we serve. We are dedicated to providing an environment where all employees feel valued, respected and able to reach their full potential. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and encourage candidates to request accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process.

 Proudly one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive and accessible environment where all employees can thrive and feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work. If you require an accommodation to complete your application, please do not hesitate to contact us at accessibility@bdc.ca.

 While we appreciate all applications, we advise that only the candidates selected to participate in the recruitment process will be contacted.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data, AI, & Automation Services
jobs.location: Calgary, AB; Vancouver, BC; Mississauga, ON
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Data, AI, & Automation Services 

As a member of the Business Systems leadership team reporting to the Vice President, Business Systems, the Director, Data, AI & Automation Services leads Bird's enterprise data, analytics, AI, automation, and information governance services. The role is accountable for translating business strategy into a practical Data, AI & Automation roadmap that improves decision-making, project and operational performance, productivity, and responsible innovation across Bird.

The Director leads the modernization of Bird's data platform and analytics ecosystem, establishes scalable AI and automation capabilities, and advances enterprise data governance, data quality, stewardship, and data fluency. Working with executive sponsors, business leaders, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Enterprise Architecture, and delivery teams, this role ensures data and AI capabilities are trusted, secure, adopted, and measurable in business value.
 What You Will Be Working On 

 Develop and execute Bird's enterprise Data, AI, Analytics, and Automation strategy, aligned with corporate objectives and the priorities of the Business Systems leadership team, translating business strategy into measurable outcomes across decision-making, operational excellence, and innovation.

 Establish and maintain a multi-year roadmap and prioritized portfolio for data modernization, AI adoption, analytics, automation services, and information governance — sequencing initiatives by business value, risk, feasibility, and adoption readiness, and reporting quantified value realization to executive leadership.

 Lead the modernization and operation of Bird's enterprise data platform, including lakehouse, Azure Databricks, semantic models, enterprise data models, metadata, data pipelines, and analytics architecture, in partnership with Business Subject Matter Experts, Data Architects, and Business Analysts.

 Establish and maintain enterprise standards for analytics, reporting, data engineering, AI solution development, and delivery governance — covering architecture reviews, solution design reviews, testing, release management, training, documentation, and operational support.

 Lead enterprise data governance, master data management, data quality, metadata, stewardship, and information lifecycle management, ensuring compliance with privacy, cybersecurity, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements — including ownership of the Semarchy MDM tool and enterprise data standards.

 Establish and operationalize responsible AI governance and lifecycle controls for Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, machine learning, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation — covering AI inventory, human oversight, third-party AI/data risk, monitoring, incident response, and decommissioning, aligned with recognized frameworks such as NIST AI RMF (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage) and ISO/IEC 42001)

 Deliver trusted analytics, business intelligence, KPI frameworks, dashboards, predictive models, and AI-enabled solutions — including Power BI visualization on the enterprise Lakehouse — that improve executive, operational, project, and functional decision-making, and leverage structured, unstructured, and IoT data to solve complex business challenges and improve project outcomes.

 Lead enterprise automation services and the Automation Center of Excellence, including workflow automation, RPA, AI Agents, reusable patterns and templates, citizen-development guardrails, and consistent benefits realization through KPIs, ROI tracking, and process rationalization.

 Champion enterprise data literacy, AI fluency, self-service analytics, adoption, and change management — including Bird's Data & AI Community of Practice and the Data & AI Fluency Journey — measuring and communicating the business value delivered through data, AI, and automation initiatives.

 Build, coach, and lead a high-performing Data, AI & Automation Services team across Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, AI Specialists, and Automation professionals, and foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer service excellence in partnership with executive leadership, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Privacy, and business stakeholders.

 What We Are Looking For 
 Education 

 Post-secondary degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
 Master's degree considered an asset.

 Experience 

 Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Data, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, or Digital Transformation. Prior Director-level (or equivalent senior enterprise leadership) experience is required.
 Demonstrated experience operating at the enterprise leadership level, including partnering directly with executive leadership and cross-functional, influencing strategic decisions, and communicating complex technical concepts in clear business language
 Minimum 8 years of leadership experience managing high-performing technical teams.
 Proven experience developing and executing enterprise data and AI strategies.
 Demonstrated ability to lead organizational change, technology adoption, and enterprise capability-building initiatives, including data literacy, AI fluency, self-service analytics, and responsible AI adoption, across business functions

 Technical Knowledge 

 Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, predictive analytics, and business intelligence.
 Deep knowledge of data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, data governance, and enterprise analytics.
 Experience with data quality management, master data management, metadata management, and information governance.
 Knowledge of AI lifecycle management, responsible AI practices, and modern data engineering methodologies.
 Experience building scalable data platforms and self-service analytics capabilities.

 Data Governance and Data Fluency Competencies 

 Proven ability to embed governance and data fluency practices into analytics delivery, automation initiatives, AI adoption, and business transformation programs.
 Experience translating complex data concepts into clear business language for executives, operational leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.
 Ability to promote data fluency across business functions by improving data literacy, self-service analytics adoption, and responsible use of AI-enabled insights.
 Strong understanding of data quality, metadata management, master data management, privacy, security, and information lifecycle management.
 Demonstrated ability to establish data governance frameworks, stewardship models, data ownership practices, and enterprise data standards.

 Leadership Skills 

 Strategic thinking and business acumen.
 Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
 Proven ability to lead organizational change and technology adoption.
 Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
 Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
 Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience leading enterprise AI adoption initiatives.
 Experience implementing AI governance and data governance frameworks.
 Experience in construction, engineering, or project-based industries is considered an asset.
 Knowledge of project delivery methodologies including Agile and Scrum.

 Success Measures 

 Adoption and business value realization of AI-enabled solutions.
 Growth in enterprise data literacy and analytics adoption.
 Improvements in data quality and governance maturity.
 Productivity gains through automation and AI.
 Delivery of strategic data platform and analytics initiatives.
 Enhanced decision-making through trusted, accessible, and actionable data.
 Development of a high-performing Data & Automation Services organization.

 Applications 

 Applications are accepted online at www.bird.ca.
 Please describe your experience with Business Intelligence, Machine Learning, Agile methodology, Data Warehouses, Generative AI, Data Governance, Data Fluency, and modern cloud data platforms in your cover letter and/or resume.

 For Those Who Seek to Redefine 

 The greatest achievements in history are borne from the greatness within people – where human potential meets vision, and passion fuels evolution. Unlocking this potential is the most important thing we do at Bird.

 As a leader in Canadian construction for over 100 years, the impact of our team is etched deeply within the core of our legacy. Beyond Bird, this impact is felt in the fundamental aspects of our everyday lives. From the critical infrastructure we depend on, to the energy and resources that keep us moving - we are powering our communities and shaping Canada’s skylines coast-to-coast-to-coast. Entrenched in the foundation of a culture built more than a century ago is an enduring quest to reimagine what is possible. Our impact is greater than ever, and we are looking for those who seek to redefine their story.

 What We Believe In 

 We Put Safety First 
 A healthy and safe work environment is non-negotiable. We build a culture of operational and psychological safety through engagement, learning and leadership.

 We Lead With Honesty 
 We speak and act with integrity, clarity and care so people can trust our word and our work. Being honest means we can deliver the best outcomes and consistent results.

 We Are Stronger Together 
 Success is a team effort. Our inclusive workplace enables our combined expertise, humility and creativity to unlock our greater potential.

 We Are Driven To Do Great Work 
 We built our name on quality. We have a passion for excellence in our work and relationships that honours our businesses and our industry.

 We Create Opportunity 
 Rooted in a solid foundation, we adapt and grow to face the future. We are committed to elevating each other to chart the best path forward in an evolving world.

 At Bird, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I) and believe it is essential to our success. We will continue to listen, learn, and take action in our commitment to building progress in our organization, and the industry as a whole. Cultivating an environment where all employees feel included, seen, and have a sense of belonging is core to Bird’s culture. We commit to proactively employing a workforce that reflects the communities in which we work, fostering an environment of continuous learning, and never compromising on our values.

Application Deadline: 

12/17/2026 

 Address: 
100 King Street West 

 Job Family Group:

Audit, Risk & Compliance 

 The Director, Compliance Program Governance is responsible for providing strategic leadership, governance, oversight, and continuous improvement for the Enterprise Compliance Program (ECP). The role leads centralized governance activities including program reporting, quality assurance, controls oversight, training, program assessments, and strategy.

 The Director ensures the compliance programs continues to operate effectively and remains aligned with regulatory expectations. The role operates at an enterprise-wide level and functions as a senior specialist and thought leader. The role collaborates closely with other risk leaders in enterprise risk. The role is positioned within Legal and Regulatory Compliance (LRC) and reports to the Head, Enterprise Compliance Programs.

 Program Governance, Quality Assurance & Controls 
 Oversees governance and execution of centralized compliance program activities.

 Establishes and maintains applicable program standards, procedures, operating models, controls, and methodologies.

 Leads independent quality assurance reviews and organizes data for compliance effectiveness assessments

 As directed, establishes and reinforces centralized controls supporting compliance programs and governance processes.

 Identifies opportunities to strengthen governance, improve data quality, streamline processes, and enhance regulatory compliance capabilities.

 Conducts and/or effectively challenges compliance assessments to improve control environments.

 May performs and/or oversees monitoring and testing activities to evaluate the effectiveness of compliance controls.

 Supports root cause analysis and remediation activities arising from control failures, audit findings, regulatory concerns, and compliance issues.

 Enterprise Reporting 
 Leads development and oversight of compliance metrics included executive, management, committee, and board reporting

 Reviews, analyzes, and reports insights on regulatory risk using compliance data, metrics, key risk indicators, and effectiveness assessments.

 Establishes governance over compliance reporting processes, methodologies, and data quality controls.

 Reports compliance program effectiveness and regulatory risk trends to senior management and governance committees.

 Identifies, assesses, escalates, and monitors regulatory risks and compliance issues for timely resolution

 Leadership and People Management 
 Fosters a culture aligned to BMO's purpose, values, strategy, and Winning Culture behaviours by role modeling expected leadership behaviours.

 Maintains strong networks internally and externally to identify industry trends, benchmarks, and best practices.

 May consult to or serve on enterprise governance committees and leadership forums.

 Anticipates future regulatory and industry developments and drives proactive changes to governance frameworks and compliance programs.

 Ensures alignment between values and behaviours that foster diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

 Builds highly collaborative and interdependent teams that partner across functions and operating groups to create value for stakeholders.

 Attracts, develops, retains, and enables top talent through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and career development.

 Recognizes and rewards performance, addresses development opportunities, and manages performance improvement where required.

 Creates an environment of continuous learning, innovation, engagement, and operational excellence.

 Promotes a strong risk and compliance culture across the organization.

 Advises and influences senior leaders regarding regulatory risks associated with business decisions, strategic initiatives, transformation activities, and emerging regulatory developments.

 Required Qualifications ​ 
 Typically 10+ years of relevant experience in Compliance, Risk Management, Governance, Audit, Regulatory Affairs, or related disciplines.

 Post-secondary degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

 Extensive knowledge of regulatory compliance frameworks, risk management practices, governance principles, and enterprise compliance programs.

 Experience leading enterprise reporting, quality assurance, controls oversight, governance, or compliance program functions.

 Exceptional communication, relationship management, critical thinking, and project leadership skills.

 Ability to operate effectively in highly regulated and rapidly changing environments.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 CRCM, CAMS, CCEP, CIA, CISA, or equivalent professional certification.

 Strong knowledge of regulatory expectations applicable to financial services organizations.

jobs.description:
Application Deadline: 

12/30/2026 

 Address: 
250 Yonge Street 

 Job Family Group:

Data Analytics & Reporting 

 Please note: This is a hybrid role based in Toronto. Candidates outside Ontario would need to relocate to meet the role's in-office requirements.

 About the Role 

 As Director, Technology Delivery Lead, you are accountable for the end-to-end technology delivery of Em, BMO InvestorLine's premier AI agent. You will lead the integrated delivery system across AI engineering, wealth platforms, Microsoft Azure, data, architecture, quality engineering, cybersecurity, operations, and third parties to deliver safe, resilient, scalable, and measurable client outcomes.
 You will operate as the principal technology counterpart to the Product Owner for Em. Together, you are jointly accountable for overall delivery: the Product Owner leads product vision, client value, priorities, and acceptance; the Technology Delivery Lead owns the integrated technology plan, engineering execution, technical quality, production readiness, and predictable delivery. This role is not a program coordination position. It is a hands-on senior technology leadership role with clear decision rights and accountability for outcomes.

 Mandate and Decision Rights 

 Own the integrated technology delivery plan for Em from discovery and architecture through build, evaluation, release, operation, and continuous improvement.
 Jointly commit scope, sequencing, release outcomes, and delivery forecasts with the Product Owner, balancing client value, technical feasibility, risk, cost, and capacity.
 Make or escalate timely technology delivery decisions across architecture, engineering, environments, data, integration, testing, controls, and production readiness.
 Hold delivery teams and partners accountable for agreed outcomes, quality standards, dependencies, and evidence-based release criteria.
 Protect the product from unmanaged technical debt, fragmented ownership, late-stage controls, and delivery practices that are not fit for AI.

 Key Responsibilities 

 1.      End-to-End Technology Delivery 

 Lead delivery across multiple cross-functional product and platform teams, establishing one integrated plan, clear critical path, transparent dependencies, and accountable owners.
 Convert the product roadmap into executable technology increments, release plans, capacity models, milestones, and outcome-based commitments.
 Drive delivery discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risk, and benefits, using forecasts rather than artificial certainty.
 Identify constraints early, remove impediments, resolve cross-team trade-offs, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
 Ensure each release has explicit entry, exit, acceptance, operational readiness, and rollback criteria.

 2. AI Engineering and AI SDLC Leadership 

 Apply deep knowledge of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, guardrails, memory, and human oversight.
 Embed full-lifecycle AI SDLC practices across requirements, design, build, test, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and model or prompt change management.
 Ensure AI quality is measured using fit-for-purpose evaluations covering safety, groundedness, relevance, accuracy, latency, reliability, and client experience.
 Champion specification-driven development, automation, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-assisted software delivery where approved.
 Ensure deterministic software testing and probabilistic AI evaluation are integrated into CI/CD and release decisions.

 3.      Azure, Architecture and Platform Integration 

 Provide senior technical leadership for solutions deployed on Microsoft Azure and integrated with BMO InvestorLine and Wealth Management platforms.
 Partner with solution, enterprise, security, data, and platform architects to maintain an approved, scalable target architecture and prevent local optimization or avoidable technical debt.
 Ensure APIs, event flows, data services, identity, access, observability, resilience, and non-functional requirements are designed and delivered end to end.
 Drive environment readiness, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, telemetry, performance engineering, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and production support readiness.
 Promote reuse of enterprise AI capabilities, shared services, patterns, and controls while preserving clear service boundaries and ownership.

 4.      Advanced Agile and Value-Stream Delivery 

 Establish and continuously improve an advanced Agile operating model organized around persistent, cross-functional teams and measurable client or business outcomes.
 Lead portfolio and product-level planning, backlog readiness, dependency management, release forecasting, and flow optimization across multiple teams.
 Use evidence-based metrics such as lead time, cycle time, throughput, work in progress, predictability, escaped defects, reliability, evaluation performance, and value realization.
 Reduce handoffs, unnecessary governance, meeting load, and blocked work; create fast decision paths and clear single-point accountability.
 Coach delivery leaders, Scrum Masters, engineering leads, and teams in modern product delivery, DevSecOps, continuous delivery, and learning-driven retrospectives.

 5.      Quality, Risk and Responsible AI 

 Build quality, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model risk, accessibility, and responsible AI requirements into delivery from inception, not as release-end checkpoints.
 Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Model Risk, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to establish proportionate controls and auditable evidence.
 Ensure full-spectrum observability across application, infrastructure, data, model, prompt, agent, safety, and client-experience performance.
 Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and learning reviews for technology or AI quality events.
 Maintain transparent risk, issue, dependency, and decision records and ensure material risks are escalated promptly.

 6.      Stakeholder, Financial and Partner Leadership 

 Serve as the senior technology delivery voice for Em with InvestorLine, Wealth, Technology & Operations, Applied AI, governance partners, and executive forums.
 Provide concise, fact-based reporting on outcomes, delivery confidence, risks, financials, quality, and decisions required.
 Own technology delivery financial stewardship, resource planning, vendor performance, commercial dependencies, and delivery commitments.
 Lead co-build and vendor engagements with clear accountability, knowledge transfer, architecture compliance, security obligations, and measurable outcomes.
 Create an inclusive, high-accountability environment that develops leaders, strengthens technical depth, and keeps teams focused on client outcomes.

 Key Success Measures 

 Predictable delivery of roadmap outcomes and releases, with transparent forecast accuracy and controlled scope change.
 Measurable improvement in delivery flow, engineering productivity, automation, quality, and time to value.
 AI evaluation thresholds and non-functional requirements met before release and sustained in production.
 Stable, secure, resilient production performance with effective observability, incident management, and continuous improvement.
 Clear ownership, faster decisions, fewer cross-team handoffs, and effective dependency resolution.
 Measurable client adoption, experience, business value, and risk outcomes delivered in partnership with the Product Owner.
 Effective financial, capacity, vendor, and technical-debt management.

 Required Skills and Competencies 

 Expert-level technology delivery leadership in large, complex, regulated environments, with accountability for multiple teams and production outcomes.
 Deep practical knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI delivery, including agentic architectures, LLM application patterns, evaluations, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI controls.
 Strong knowledge of wealth management and digital investing platforms, including client journeys, advice or guidance experiences, market and portfolio data, trading-related integrations, and regulatory considerations.
 Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Azure cloud architecture and delivery, cloud-native engineering, APIs, integration, identity and access, data services, telemetry, resilience, and DevSecOps.
 Mastery of advanced Agile, product operating models, value-stream management, Lean flow, Scrum or Kanban, portfolio planning, CI/CD, test automation, and evidence-based delivery metrics.
 Ability to challenge constructively, make decisions under ambiguity, translate technical complexity into business implications, and influence senior executives.
 Commercial and financial acumen, including technology investment, capacity, vendor, contract, and delivery-performance management.
 Exceptional leadership, communication, facilitation, negotiation, and talent-development skills.

 Qualifications and Experience 

 15+ years of progressive experience in technology delivery, engineering, architecture, platform, or product technology leadership, including senior leadership accountability.
 Demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale digital products or platforms from strategy through production and ongoing operation.
 Demonstrated delivery of AI/ML or generative AI solutions in production, ideally involving multi-agent systems or other complex AI-enabled client experiences.
 Significant experience with Microsoft Azure and modern software engineering practices in a regulated enterprise.
 Experience in wealth management, brokerage, digital investing, banking, or similarly regulated financial services is strongly preferred.
 Proven experience leading cross-functional internal and partner teams through complex dependencies and high-stakes releases.
 University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems; relevant advanced degree or certifications are considered assets.

 Leadership Expectations 

 Act as an owner: accountable for outcomes, not activity or coordination alone.
 Put clients, safety, quality, and sustainable value ahead of pace without evidence.
 Create clarity: make responsibilities, decisions, risks, dependencies, and delivery confidence visible.
 Lead with technical credibility while empowering engineering and product leaders closest to the work.
 Build trust through candour, transparency, inclusion, disciplined follow-through, and continuous learning.

100 King Street West

Capital Mrkts Sales & Service 

 BMO Capital Markets is a leading, full-service financial services provider. We offer corporate and investment banking, treasury management, as well as research and advisory services to clients around the world. #bmocapitalmarkets

 Mandate: 

 We are looking for an individual who has built out a metrics and reporting program for a client onboarding function that enabled removing bottlenecks and unlocking revenue. 

 The Client Enablement team is responsible for onboarding new clients and enabling them to successfully transact quickly and accurately, with high-touch service both internally and externally. The Client onboarding process encompasses Intake, Regulatory/Jurisdictional/Product Approval Compliance, Trade Reporting Compliance, Credit Line Setup, Legal Agreement (e.g. ISDA) Negotiation, Account Opening, and Electronic Setups. The group fulfills key governance requirements and plays a central role in how quickly and effectively clients are onboarded and enabled to transact with BMO Capital Markets.

 Reporting to the Managing Director & Head of Client Onboarding, Client Tax Governance, and Client Operations, the Director is a senior leader who will build and lead the onboarding analytics and reporting agenda for Capital Markets, bringing a proven track record of turning operational data into commercial insight in this space. The role links client onboarding and client enablement processes to revenue, connecting onboarding milestones such as KYC, legal documentation, credit, and account set-up to client activation and revenue outcomes, and delivers the insights needed to speed up and improve the end-to-end client experience. The role will also report on selected cross sell analytics. The Data and Analytics team aggregates data from across Capital Markets systems into outcome-driven visualizations and reporting that drive insights, enable day-to-day evidence-based decision making, and support targeting for increased revenue generation.

 This role will:
 Working with senior leadership, set the vision and roadmap for onboarding and client enablement analytics, defining the metrics, KPIs, and reporting that matter most to senior business and operations leaders.
 Provide hands-on leadership of a small team as people manager while building reports.
 Link onboarding and client enablement processes to revenue, quantifying the commercial impact of cycle time, bottlenecks, and backlog on client activation and revenue realization.
 Deliver insights that accelerate onboarding, reduce friction for clients and Front Office partners, and prioritize process, data, and technology improvements.
 Lead stakeholder engagement with senior leaders across Front Office, Operations, AML/KYC, Legal, and Technology, translating business questions into automated reporting and data visualizations.
 Provide data analytics, data governance, and data tools and technology leadership that will support Capital Markets, Client Enablement, and strategic transformation initiatives.

 Key Accountabilities: 
 Lead the onboarding analytics and reporting strategy, establishing an end-to-end view of the client onboarding and client enablement lifecycle from client request through account activation.
 Build and maintain an onboarding-to-revenue framework that links onboarding milestones (KYC, legal documentation, credit, and new accounts) to client activation, trading activity, and revenue.
 Define, capture, measure, and report KPIs and SLAs (e.g., cycle time, aging, backlog, throughput, and first-time-right) that support defined business objectives.
 Deliver executive-ready dashboards and data visualizations that provide actionable insights to senior business partners and governance forums.
 Use data to identify bottlenecks, root causes, and improvement opportunities, and recommend solutions that speed up and improve onboarding and the client experience.
 Partner with senior stakeholders to lead requirements gathering, with a focus on delivering desired business outcomes.
 Provide subject matter and technical leadership in data profiling and analysis that supports Client Data Strategy and enterprise initiatives.
 Champion data governance so that data is fit for purpose and meets business, usability, and data quality requirements and standards.
 Drive the maturation of operational process efficiencies using automation, AI, and technology.
 Mentor and develop analytics talent, fostering a culture of curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
 Ensure adherence to BMO privacy and confidentiality requirements (legal, compliance and operational risk).

 Authorities: 
 Accountable for the onboarding analytics and reporting roadmap, including prioritization of reporting and insight requests.
 Accountable for defining and governing onboarding KPIs, metric definitions, and the onboarding-to-revenue methodology.
 Responsible for providing insightful data visualizations and executive reporting.
 Responsible for BAU oversight; ensuring reports are built and breaks/issues with existing reports and/or processes are addressed in a timely manner.
 Make recommendations on, and lead implementation of, process automations and improvements.

 This role has direct or indirect impact on the following:
 Client Onboarding 
 AML/KYC 
 New Accounts 
 Legal 
 Tax Operations 
 Front Office groups 
 Client Enablement and client experience
 Data Governance

 Lines of business in Capital Markets (Global Markets and I&CB)

 The Director, Institutional Sales & Service – Prairies Canada, is responsible for developing and managing institutional client relationships across the region. The role focuses on supporting BMO Global Asset Management’s institutional clients and prospects through business development, relationship management, and investment education.
 A key component of the position includes supporting and deepening relationships with Indigenous clients and communities, while also contributing to broader institutional coverage across the Prairies, including engagement with investment consultants and other institutional stakeholders.
 This role combines institutional business development, relationship management, and client servicing responsibilities, with an emphasis on building long-term partnerships and delivering investment solutions aligned with clients’ governance frameworks and long-term investment objectives. The successful candidate will work closely with portfolio managers and internal specialists to deliver investment insights, client education, and tailored investment solutions.

 Institutional Client Coverage

Provide ongoing relationship management, including investment updates, portfolio reviews, and client education sessions in collaboration with portfolio managers and specialists. Support client onboarding and ensure a high standard of ongoing service.
 Indigenous Client Engagement

Engage respectfully with community leadership and governance structures while developing an understanding of community priorities, values, and long-term financial objectives. Provide investment education and support governance discussions where appropriate, while contributing to the development of long-term partnerships.
 Business Development

Participate in business development initiatives, including prospect and client meetings, presentations, and finalist discussions. Support responses to RFPs and other client inquiries and assist with the implementation of new investment mandates.
 Investment Consultant Engagement

Ensure BMO Global Asset Management’s investment strategies and capabilities are effectively represented in consultant discussions and reviews.
 Client Education and Thought Leadership

 Market Awareness

 Internal Collaboration

 Degree in finance, accounting or related business discipline and CPA designation

jobs.description:
About Coursera + Udemy 

 Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our  blog.

 Why join us now? 

 AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

 Shape what comes next 

 By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

 How we work 

 Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

 Job Overview: 

 Within Professional Services, you'll lead the Solutions Architecture team through a fundamental change: from a technical intake team that passes integration work to third parties to a team that designs and builds the integrations we choose to own on Workato. You'll decide which integrations are strategic to own and which third parties can deliver faster, and you'll balance capacity across Coursera and Udemy technical work. You'll lay a foundation to build from, so that integrations are productized and reusable rather than one-offs, and you'll upskill the team to design, build, and test the way an engineering team does. You'll also take ownership of integrations built by third parties for both Coursera and Udemy, and decide what, if anything, to migrate in house. This is a highly operational role. You'll redesign how the team works with Product, Partnerships, Presales, and Customer Support, define workflows that are not yet defined, and build the delivery discipline, capacity model, and metrics that make the function run like a well-oiled machine. You'll report to the Senior Director of Professional Services and partner closely with the Director of AI Innovation to streamline how the team works.

 Responsibilities: 

 Lead the shift from a technical intake team that routes work to third parties to a team that builds the integrations we choose to own, and set the criteria, service levels, and pricing for what we own versus what third parties deliver.

 Own the integration roadmap and prioritization with Product, Partnerships, Engineering, and Support, and make capacity and load-balancing tradeoffs across Coursera and Udemy technical work.

 Establish the Workato foundation and productize what we can, with shared standards and reusable components, and a custom layer on top that is easy to adapt. Build reuse into design review.

 Take ownership of the inherited integrations, six years of third-party work on the Coursera platform and a handful on Udemy. Document them, decide what, if anything, to migrate, retire, or keep, and steward the code and its environment.

 Hire and upskill the team to design, build, and test like engineers, aligned with Coursera Engineering's standards. Use AI-assisted development deliberately so the team builds fundamentals first, and manage token usage.

 Redesign how the team works, including Jira, intake, and workflows with Product, Partnerships, Presales, and Support, and train Support to deflect development-related tickets.

 Own the run and support model for what we build, including monitoring, maintenance, versioning, and service levels. Meet security, contractual, and data privacy standards, and serve as the senior escalation point for high-risk issues.

 Partner with Presales on early scoping and own the technical handoff from Sales into delivery. Work with the Director of AI Innovation and Solutions on the pilot-to-PS transition review and on streamlining the team's work.

 Run utilization and project tracking, manage the technical service catalog, pricing, SOWs, and margin, and build metrics that show impact on deal size, time to production, retention, and quality.

 Basic Qualifications: 

 8+ years of experience in solutions architecture, technical professional services, or integration consulting, with a strong focus on API integrations (REST, SOAP, GraphQL) and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

 Proven experience leading and developing technical teams, ideally globally distributed, and running a technical delivery function, including capacity planning, utilization, and cross-team workflows.

 Experience building reusable, productized integrations on an iPaaS platform and designing for reuse across customers.

 Experience applying engineering standards (SDLC, design and code review, testing) to integration delivery, and coaching a team to adopt them.

 Experience taking over third-party-built or inherited code and making build, buy, partner, and migrate decisions, including managing third-party partners.

 Direct experience in pre-sales activity for technical services, including discovery, scoping, and SOW creation.

 Strong communicator with stakeholders from engineers to executives. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

 Hands-on experience with Workato, or a comparable iPaaS platform such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Jitterbit, or Tray.io.

 Integration experience with SSO, ERP, HRIS, and LMS/LXP systems.

 Experience integrating teams, codebases, or service portfolios through a merger or acquisition.

 Proficiency in data analytics and SQL.

 Compensation 

 Coursera offers competitive pay and fair compensation practices across all regions. Job titles may span multiple career levels, and the targeted hiring base salary range for this role in Canada is $175,000 - $218,000. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, education, transferable skills, business needs, and location. This range may be adjusted over time and may include eligibility for variable pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

 Application Window: December 7, 2026

 We anticipate the application window will be open until December 7, 2026. Based on business needs, this opportunity may remain posted beyond or closed before the anticipated application window.

jobs.title: Head of Communications and Marketing
jobs.description:
Salary: $120,000 - $170,000 per year.

Harlo Entertainment is a Toronto-based operator, management and private equity company, delivering value over 30 years of aggregate experience in both the hospitality and entertainment industry. With first-hand insights and perspectives, Harlo Entertainment defines best-in-class, luxury experience and is deeply committed to the highest level of guest satisfaction.  

We are a collection of diverse individuals with unique skill sets and subject matter expertise focused on building and scaling ventures. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work across multiple high-profile, growing brands including Shake Shack Canada, Kasa Moto, MIMI Chinese, Sunnys Chinese, Linny's, The Playbook Commons, Valerie, Roses Social and more. Check out our website to learn more: www.harloentertainment.com  
We are a people-first culture. We strive to create great outcomes and establish win-win partnerships through integrity, reliability, inclusivity, and great communication. Our greatest asset is our people, as they are the powerhouses behind our outcomes. 

Role Overview
We are looking for a dynamic, creative and experienced Head of Communications and Marketing to be part of a growing team who will lead the marketing efforts across our portfolio of restaurant and hospitality brands. This role owns the full growth engine: brand and multi-channel marketing, strategic partnerships, SEO and digital presence, performance analytics, and PR. The ideal candidate uses data to decide where to invest, can lead cross-functional projects such as new openings and concept launches from idea to execution, and is measured on results: traffic, covers, revenue and brand strength.

Key Responsibilities
Marketing Strategy & Brand
Develop and own the marketing strategy and budget for each brand in the portfolio, tied to clear traffic, cover and revenue targets.
 Oversee the execution of marketing initiatives across all channels (digital, social, email/CRM, in-venue, partnerships and PR) and own the portfolio marketing calendar.
Direct content and creative across social, email and web, holding internal teams and creative partners accountable for quality and each brand's distinct voice.
Manage external partners (creative, PR, paid media, SEO), holding them to clear deliverables and KPIs.
Ensure all materials and activations follow established brand guidelines, and work with leadership to implement approved brand direction.
Maintain quality control across all guest-facing touchpoints and support the rollout of brand standards across new and existing locations.
Data, Digital & Performance
Build and maintain a marketing performance dashboard for each brand (traffic, reservations/covers, guest acquisition cost, ROAS, CRM, social and search) and report regularly to leadership.
Use guest, reservation, sales and campaign data to decide where to invest, what to test and what to stop, and set success metrics for every campaign, partnership and activation before launch.
Oversee SEO and digital presence across all brands (local search, Google Business Profiles, websites, booking paths and online reviews), holding partners accountable for results.	
Oversee paid media (search, social, display) and manage spend against ROI targets.
Develop guest segmentation and CRM programs that drive repeat visits and guest lifetime value.
Strategic Projects & Openings
Lead cross-functional projects from ideation through execution, including new openings, concept development and business initiatives.
Lead the marketing and launch plan for every new opening and concept.
Partner with leadership and operations teams to identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities.
Develop project plans, timelines and budgets, and ensure projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
Act as a central point of coordination across departments to drive alignment and accountability.
Strategic Partnerships
Identify, develop and manage partnerships that drive brand awareness and business growth.
Negotiate and execute collaborations with aligned brands, media, creators and community partners.
Oversee partnership activations from concept through execution, ensuring strong ROI and brand alignment, and report on results.
PR & Communications
Set PR strategy that supports openings, launches and business milestones, and oversee PR partners in execution.
Build and maintain relationships with media, journalists and influencers, and serve as the primary point of contact for media inquiries.
Maintain crisis communication plans and manage issues response alongside leadership.
Keep internal teams informed and aligned on key initiatives, campaigns and launches.
Represent the portfolio at industry events, conferences and public forums.
Other duties as assigned.

What Success Looks Like in Year One
Within the first year, you will have built a clear marketing plan and KPI dashboard for every brand in the portfolio, delivered successful launches for new openings and concepts on time and on budget, grown traffic and covers through data-led campaigns and partnerships with measurable ROI, strengthened organic search and digital presence across all brands, and built a high-performing network of agency and media partners.

Skills and Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, Marketing or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
7+ years of experience in public relations, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
Proven track record of successful media relations and PR campaign execution.
Proven track record of executing successful digital and brand marketing campaigns. 
Strong copywriting, content planning, and creative direction skills. 
Proficiency in social media management tools and analytics platforms (e.g., Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, Google Analytics). 
Experience managing paid advertising campaigns across platforms (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, etc.). 
Excellent communication, collaboration, and project management skills. 
Strong crisis management and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to build and maintain relationships with media and key stakeholders.
Experience in the food and beverage industry is a plus.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively with our portfolio teams, cross-functional departments, and stakeholders.  
Proficiency in PR analytics and tools

What we offer:
Competitive compensation, including comprehensive benefits, spending account and professional development program.
Opportunity to develop skills and gain experience in multiple disciplines in a fast-paced environment.
Dynamic and fun office culture with colleagues who share the same core values.
Exclusive perks from our portfolio companies.
Unlimited vacation policy. 

Harlo Entertainment is an equal opportunity employer.  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, gender expression, medical condition, genetic information, marital, military and veteran status.

jobs.title: Director, FP&A
jobs.description:
At Range Group we believe in the power of the professional travel advisor. We represent over $4.5 billion in annual travel sales. All our investments stem from a common thesis, that travel advisors add real value to a trip. Travel advisors when equipped with technology and 24/7 support are irreplaceable. Equally important is our philanthropy. Range Foundation channels 10% of group profits to social impact. From exploration grants, improved access to education, new discoveries on sea and land, cultural infrastructure, and helping our global neighbors in times of need — we are investing to build a better future.

 About the Role
 This is a hands-on senior finance leadership role for someone who operates at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution. You’re as comfortable building a complex multi-entity model from scratch as you are presenting the story behind the numbers to the executive team.

 As Director, FP&A, you will own the analytical engine that supports decision-making across Range Group’s portfolio of travel brands — leading enterprise planning and forecasting, managing a small team, and working directly with senior leadership to evaluate opportunities, navigate risks, and drive performance.

 What You’ll Do

 Financial Modelling & Planning 

 Build, maintain, and continuously improve financial models covering consolidated Group performance, brand-level P&Ls, cash flow forecasting, and scenario analysis.

 Own the Group-level cash flow tracker and EBITDA bridging model, ensuring accuracy and timeliness week over week.

 Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes across the organization.

 Support ad hoc financial analysis — acquisition modelling, business case development, and covenant compliance.

 Drive continuous improvement in financial planning frameworks, forecasting methodologies, and analytical tools.

 Performance Management & Executive Insights 

 Own enterprise-wide performance reporting — financial reviews, KPI dashboards, executive scorecards, and variance commentary.

 Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership.

 Translate financial results into clear, decision-ready insights that prompt action.

 Identify and proactively flag emerging risks, opportunities, and performance trends across the portfolio.

 Strategic Business Partnership 

 Partner with executive and business leaders to align financial plans with strategic priorities and growth objectives.

 Evaluate investments, business initiatives, and strategic opportunities through modelling and scenario analysis.

 Provide financial leadership on strategic initiatives, business cases, and investment decisions.

 Support executive and Board reporting requirements.

 Treasury & Foreign Exchange Management 

 Own foreign exchange exposure tracking, reporting, and scenario analysis across the Group's multi-currency operations. 

 Partner with treasury, banking partners, and external advisors to evaluate foreign exchange risks and mitigation strategies.

 Assess the financial impact of currency fluctuations on forecasts, budgets, cash flow, and business performance.

 Develop recommendations and decision-support materials for leadership regarding FX risk management and capital planning.

 Monitor market trends and currency movements, proactively identifying risks and opportunities that may impact business performance.

 Team Leadership & Capability Building 

 Lead a small finance team — including a Finance Manager and intern — as a player-coach: owning models and analysis end-to-end while delegating and developing where appropriate.

 Foster a high-performance, analytically rigorous culture within the team.

 Support ERP and reporting tool improvements from a finance data and output perspective.

 Champion the evolution of finance from a reporting function to a true strategic business partner.

 What You’ll Bring 

 8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Strategic Finance, or Finance Business Partnering — with a track record of owning complex models in a multi-entity environment.

 Advanced Excel skills — non-negotiable. You build models from scratch, structure them for auditability, and are fast and precise in the tool.

 Strong accounting foundation: you understand how the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement connect inside a model.

 Proven experience leading enterprise budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes.

 Experience analyzing foreign exchange exposure, multi-currency financial impacts, and scenario modelling within a corporate FP&A, finance, or strategic finance environment.  

 Strong executive presence, comfortable presenting to senior leadership and capable of influencing and constructively challenging stakeholders.

 Experience in multi-entity and multi-currency operating environments.

 CPA designation strongly preferred; candidates without the designation will be considered where technical skills and experience are strong.

 Background in travel, technology, hospitality, or another fast-paced, multi-brand environment is an asset.

 Who You Are 

 You are a builder. You prefer to own models end-to-end and take pride in work that is structured, auditable, and built to last.

 You are intellectually curious and detail-oriented, but able to zoom out and connect the numbers to a broader business narrative.

 You operate well with ambiguity and can manage competing priorities without losing accuracy or composure.

 You are a collaborative leader who still wants to be close to the work — energized by doing, not just directing.

 You communicate with a low-ego, peer-level style — credible with senior stakeholders, collegial with the broader team, and proactive about surfacing issues.

 Why Join Range Group
 This is a rare opportunity to bridge corporate finance and executive strategy in a multi-brand travel and technology portfolio. You’ll have genuine influence — shaping how capital is allocated, how performance is communicated, and how the finance function evolves as the company grows.

 The role carries real complexity: multi-entity consolidations, multi-currency exposure, and a direct reporting line to the Chief Finance Officer. You’ll lead a small team and have the space to build the frameworks and processes that become the foundation for the company’s next phase.

 Hybrid Work Model
 We’re based in Toronto and targeting three days in office per week, with flexibility built in.

 We provide a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. Employees have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and compensation tied to business and individual performance. The actual compensation may vary depending on local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. #LI-Hybrid 

 We are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any stage of our hiring process, please advise us when completing your application. 
 The Range Group may use artificial intelligence throughout the recruitment process to screen, assess or select applicants for this position. These tools assist our hiring team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. 

We thank all candidates for their interest however only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer – Digital Assets & Capital Markets
jobs.description:
Salary: CAD $225,000 - $300,000 per year.

Chief Financial Officer – Digital Assets & Capital Markets 
 Company: Secure Digital Markets (SDM)
 Location: Toronto, Ontario
 Compensation: Target $225,000-$300,000 + performance bonus + equity participation
 Employment Type: Full-Time | Executive Leadership
 About Secure Digital Markets 
 Secure Digital Markets (SDM) is an institutional digital asset and financial services firm providing sophisticated clients with access to digital asset liquidity, execution, lending, and capital markets solutions.
 Operating at the intersection of cryptocurrency, institutional trading, and financial markets, SDM serves a global client base that demands speed, expertise, discretion, and institutional-grade execution.
 As we enter our next stage of growth, we are seeking a strategic Chief Financial Officer to strengthen our financial infrastructure, optimize capital deployment, and help drive long-term enterprise value.
 The Opportunity 
 This is not a traditional accounting-focused CFO position.
 We are seeking a commercially minded, capital-markets-oriented finance executive who understands how financial businesses create value and how capital can be strategically deployed to accelerate growth.
 Reporting to and partnering closely with the CEO, the CFO will oversee corporate finance, treasury, liquidity, capital allocation, financial reporting, investor relations, and strategic transactions.
 The successful candidate will bring sophisticated financial expertise, ideally gained within institutional digital assets, cryptocurrency trading, market making, exchanges, hedge funds, or related capital markets environments.
 Given SDM's international operations, the CFO must also understand the complexities of managing financial operations across Canada and the United States.
 This is an opportunity to shape financial strategy, influence major investment decisions, and build the financial foundation for SDM's next stage of growth.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Capital Strategy, Treasury & Investments
 Lead SDM's enterprise-wide treasury, liquidity, and capital allocation strategy.
 Optimize balance-sheet management, capital reserves, collateral utilization, and risk exposure across trading, lending, and investment activities.
 Evaluate capital deployment opportunities based on profitability, risk-adjusted returns, and long-term shareholder value.
 Oversee banking, custody, counterparty relationships, regulatory capital requirements, and financial oversight of fund and investment initiatives.
 Strategic Finance, Reporting & Performance 
 Develop financial models, budgets, forecasts, and scenario analyses to guide strategic decisions.
 Establish clear visibility into revenue, profitability, margins, and return on capital across business lines.
 Build scalable financial reporting systems, management dashboards, internal controls, and financial processes.
 Ensure accurate financial reporting and readiness for audits, regulatory reviews, and investor diligence.
 Partner with leadership to evaluate new products, investments, hiring decisions, and resource allocation.
 Cross-Border Finance & Regulatory Coordination 
 Oversee financial operations, reporting, and consolidated financial oversight across Canadian and U.S. entities.
 Manage cross-border financial considerations, including intercompany transactions, transfer pricing, taxation, and capital movement.
 Coordinate with legal, tax, compliance, and regulatory advisors to support effective corporate structures and regulatory compliance.
 Investor Relations & Capital Raising 
 Lead financial strategy and execution supporting investor relations, fundraising, and capital partnerships.
 Develop financial models, investor presentations, diligence materials, and a compelling financial narrative for institutional investors.
 Represent SDM in investor discussions, communicating financial performance, capital strategy, risk management, and growth opportunities.
 Strategic Transactions & Executive Partnership 
 Lead financial evaluation, due diligence, valuation, and structuring for acquisitions, investments, and strategic partnerships.
 Maintain institutional-quality financial information and transaction readiness.
 Serve as a trusted strategic partner to the CEO and shareholders, providing independent financial judgment and constructively challenging investment and operating decisions.
 Ideal Candidate & Qualifications 
 We are seeking an accomplished finance executive with 12+ years of progressive experience in financial leadership, treasury, or capital markets, including meaningful senior management responsibility.
 The ideal candidate will bring:
 Digital Assets & Capital Markets: Direct experience in institutional cryptocurrency, digital asset trading, market making, exchanges, hedge funds, brokerage, or sophisticated capital markets environments.
 Treasury & Capital Management: Strong expertise in liquidity management, capital allocation, balance-sheet risk, collateral management, and financial risk oversight.
 Cross-Border Financial Expertise: Demonstrated experience managing financial operations across Canada and the United States, including multi-entity reporting, taxation, and regulatory considerations.
 Strategic Financial Leadership: Proven ability to build financial models, forecasting frameworks, reporting infrastructure, and financial decision-making processes.
 Investor Relations & Transactions: Experience supporting institutional capital raises, investor communications, M&A, or strategic transactions.
 Executive Experience: Previous leadership as a CFO, Deputy CFO, Treasurer, Head of Finance, VP Finance, or comparable senior finance executive.
 Experience with institutional lending, investment funds, or structured financial products is highly desirable.
 CPA, CFA, MBA, or equivalent professional qualifications are beneficial but not required.
 Leadership Profile 
 The successful candidate combines financial rigor, commercial judgment, and an entrepreneurial mindset.
 You are analytical, intellectually independent, and comfortable challenging assumptions when financial evidence does not support a proposed strategy.
 You can communicate complex financial information clearly, build credibility with institutional investors, and work effectively alongside entrepreneurial founders and executive leadership.
 Above all, you take ownership. You establish accountability, make sound decisions under pressure, and turn financial analysis into meaningful business outcomes.
 Compensation 
 SDM offers a competitive executive compensation package based on experience and demonstrated results.
 Miami: CAD $225,000–$300,000 base salary*
 Annual Incentive: Performance-based bonus
 Long-Term Incentive: Equity / ESOP participation
 *Exceptional candidates may be considered outside the stated salary ranges. 
 Why Secure Digital Markets? 
 This is an opportunity to play a central role in shaping the future of an established institutional digital asset business.
 Rather than inheriting a mature finance organization, you will help determine how capital is allocated, how financial decisions are made, and how SDM scales its operations.
 Working directly with entrepreneurial leadership, you will influence strategic investments, strengthen institutional financial infrastructure, and help position the company for its next phase of growth.
 For the right executive, this is an opportunity to have a direct and measurable impact on enterprise value.

jobs.title: Data & AI Operations Director
jobs.description:
About us

 Qualio is a unified quality and compliance management platform that helps regulated organizations get products to market faster with reduced risk. Trusted by biopharma, medtech, and diagnostics companies worldwide, Qualio eliminates fragmented systems that create audit delays and compliance blind spots. Our platform enables audit readiness in weeks through multi-standard automated gap analysis and evidence reuse across ISO and FDA requirements. Qualio is ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and ISO 27701 certified, reflecting our commitment to security, quality, and privacy.

 The Qualio team is all-remote, and currently distributed across North America, Europe and Australia.

 What's the opportunity?

 The way software companies operate is being rebuilt right now, and the teams that figure out how to run AI-natively will move at a speed the rest can't match. Not by bolting a chatbot onto an existing process, but by taking workflows apart and reassembling them around what these tools can actually do.

 We've also reached the size where product, delivery, and go-to-market can no longer coordinate by proximity. The seams between them are where our leverage leaks out: a feature ships that the field can't articulate, a positioning shift lands that delivery hasn't been briefed on, a customer commitment gets made that the roadmap doesn't reflect.

 This role owns both, because they're the same problem.

 You can't rewire how a company works without seeing how the work actually flows across it.

 What will I be doing?

 Own our AI-native transformation. Partner across the organization to take our major workflows apart and rebuild them. You'll own enablement, change management, and the measurement that shows whether a new workflow is actually used and actually saves time.

 Assess the existing data infrastructure and actively make changes to improve data hygiene and maintenance in order to execute changes.

 Act as a team of one to implement sweeping operational change.

 Partner with leaders across the business, from product and engineering, to GTM, to operations, and support strategic decision making and initiative prioritization.

 Take Qualio's most ambiguous, highest-stakes business questions from "no one knows" to a decision we can act on and own the outcome.

 Bring a sharp, independent voice into company planning and our biggest capital-allocation calls.

 Partner with our finance, revenue ops, and product organizations to standardize and distribute the key operating metrics.

 Set the direction for how Qualio monetizes the AI era: agents, consumption/usage-based billing, and our APIs; with a real point of view on where the model is going, not just where it is.

 What skills do I need?

 Experience 

 8 to 10+ years of expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and NLP, with a proven track record of implementing modern Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic workflows in SaaS environments over the last 3+ year.

 You’ve built agents or LLM-powered tools on top of company data yourself, so you know what good data for agents looks like and can guide teams building their own.

 Excellent analytical problem-solving skills with ability to unearth insights and turn them into recommendations and action plans.

 BA/BS in Economics, Math, Finance, Engineering, CS, or other quantitative field; MBA or other advanced degree a plus.

 Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to synthesize findings and concisely articulate them to an array of audiences.

 Self-starter with a demonstrated ability to adapt to a rapidly-changing environment.

 Extremely organized and structured, with a proven ability to run projects and processes from end-to-end.

 Ability to effectively build and maintain cross-functional relationships, manage multiple competing priorities, and drive projects to completion.

 Added plus if you also have exposure to monetization, pricing & packaging, or business-model design — especially in the AI/consumption era.

 Benefits
