jobs.title: Director of Technology Operations
jobs.description:
Coinspaid Dev is the engineering brand behind the technology, infrastructure, and R&D expertise built within Coinspaid. With more than 120 engineersand over 11 years of industry experience, Coinspaid Dev brings together software engineering, infrastructure, security and R&D teams with experience building distributed systems and blockchain infrastructure operating across more than 20 blockchain networks.

Coinspaid Dev emerges as an independent engineering brand with a straightforward mission: to advance blockchain infrastructure engineering and contribute practical expertise back to the industry. The structure is new. The experience behind it is not.
 
Director of Technology Operations
We are building the next operating model for a ~150-person technology organization behind production-critical financial infrastructure.
We are looking for a Director of Technology Operations to lead that transformation.
This is not a traditional infrastructure or IT operations role. The mandate is to evolve Technology Operations from a primarily reactive model toward a scalable organization built around clear ownership, platform engineering, automation, self-service, operational excellence, resilience and measurable outcomes.
You will initially lead several established technology functions through their existing Heads and Leads, with approximately 25 people across Platform/DevOps, Corporate IT and Operational Excellence. The mandate is broader than the initial team size: you will help shape the operating model of a ~150-person technology organization and build capabilities designed to scale significantly beyond today's structure.
Your responsibility will go beyond managing these teams. You will help shape how the broader technology organization operates: how production services are owned, how incidents and changes are managed, how engineers consume infrastructure capabilities, how operational risks are identified, and how recurring manual work is systematically eliminated.
A major part of the role is organizational transformation. We expect you to assess the current model, challenge it where necessary, define the target state, develop the leaders underneath you, and deliver measurable improvements rather than simply introduce new processes.
The goal is straightforward: as the company grows, Technology Operations should become more reliable, resilient and scalable while requiring less manual coordination, less operational toil and less executive intervention.
What you will do
Lead the transformation of Technology Operations across Platform/DevOps, Corporate IT and Operational Excellence, moving the organization from reactive operations toward ownership, automation, self-service and measurable outcomes.
Define the Technology Operations strategy, target operating model, organizational structure, responsibilities, priorities and transformation roadmap.
Lead multiple established technology functions through Heads, Leads and other managers, creating clear accountability and developing leaders who can operate with increasing autonomy.
Lead the evolution of DevOps toward a Platform Engineering model that reduces operational toil, increases self-service and improves developer productivity while maintaining reliability and security.
Partner with Engineering to establish a "you build it, you own it" model, where product teams retain ownership of their services in production while Technology Operations provides the platform, standards, tooling and operational framework that enable them to operate reliably.
Develop Service Management toward Operational Excellence: strengthen service ownership, incident and problem management, introduce risk-based change governance, reduce unnecessary manual controls, and use operational data to eliminate systemic causes of failures.
Transform Corporate IT toward a secure, automated employee technology model, with strong identity and access lifecycle management, device management, governance and employee self-service.
Continuously assess the current organization, technology landscape and operating model, identify structural and operational gaps, and turn them into concrete improvement initiatives.
Improve the maturity, reliability, scalability and efficiency of technology operations supporting production-critical systems.
Define meaningful operational metrics and use them to identify systemic problems, measure transformation outcomes and drive improvements rather than simply report performance.
Own the Technology Operations contribution to digital operational resilience, including ICT business continuity, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, resilience testing, recovery objectives, crisis readiness, and remediation of findings from incidents and resilience exercises.
Partner with Security, Risk and Compliance to maintain an effective ICT risk management and control environment, including technology risk identification, critical service dependencies, ICT third-party risk, resilience testing, audit readiness and regulatory remediation.
Ensure operational and technology risks are identified early, understood, prioritized and addressed appropriately.
Support the company through audits, certifications, regulatory requirements and other controls relevant to financial and technology organizations.
Own and optimize budgets, technology vendors, infrastructure investments and external partnerships within the function.
Partner closely with Engineering, Security, Risk, Compliance, Product, Finance and other business functions.
Represent Technology Operations in cross-functional and executive discussions and communicate complex technology and operational topics clearly to different audiences.
Help prepare the technology organization for the next stage of the company's growth, including increasingly complex enterprise customers, new products and a larger engineering organization.
What we are looking for
Significant leadership experience in Technology Operations, IT Operations, Infrastructure & Operations, Platform/Production Operations, Platform Engineering or a comparable technology function.
Experience as a manager of managers, with responsibility for several teams or functions through Heads, Engineering Managers, Team Leads or equivalent leadership roles.
Previous experience as a Technology Director, VP/Head of Technology Operations, Platform/Infrastructure leader or in a comparable senior role within a product engineering organization is highly relevant.
Proven examples of significant organizational or technology transformation: changing operating models, building or restructuring functions, introducing new capabilities, increasing operational maturity, scaling teams or materially changing how technology organizations operate.
Experience leading or evolving DevOps, SRE or infrastructure capabilities toward Platform Engineering, including developer self-service, automation and reduction of operational toil.
Strong understanding of modern production ownership models and the relationship between Platform Engineering and product engineering teams.
Experience with production-critical systems where availability, reliability, security and operational failures have direct business impact.
Experience with IT and Service Management in modern product/engineering environments, including incident, problem and change management.
Experience transforming Corporate IT or employee technology environments, including identity/access lifecycle, endpoint/device management, automation, governance and employee self-service.
Practical experience with business continuity, disaster recovery and operational resilience in production-critical environments, including BIA, RTO/RPO, backup and restoration, resilience testing and remediation.
Experience working with Security, Risk and Compliance teams and managing technology and operational risks.
Exposure to audits, certifications, regulatory requirements and operational controls relevant to financial institutions or other regulated environments.
Working knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to technology operations in financial services, such as DORA, and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into pragmatic engineering and operational controls, is a plus.
Experience managing budgets, vendors, contracts and technology investments.
Ability to operate effectively when requirements, organizational boundaries or the final solution are not yet fully defined.
Track record of developing leaders and building teams that can operate without constant escalation or executive intervention.
Ability to move between strategic topics and operational problems: understand what requires executive attention, delegate what should be owned by your leaders, and personally step in when the situation requires it.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with technical teams, senior business stakeholders and executive leadership.
Experience in fintech, payments, banking, financial infrastructure or another regulated and production-critical technology environment would be highly valuable.
How we think about this role
We are not looking for a traditional IT or infrastructure leader whose primary focus is maintaining existing systems and following established processes.
We need someone who is comfortable entering an environment where not everything has already been defined — and who sees that ambiguity as part of the mandate.
You should be able to understand how the organization actually operates today, distinguish symptoms from systemic problems, bring the right people together, make decisions with incomplete information, and turn those decisions into measurable organizational and technology improvements.
You will not be expected to solve every problem personally. A major part of your role will be to build strong Heads and Leads who can own their areas independently, while you focus on the most important organizational, strategic and cross-functional challenges.
At the same time, limited resources, legacy approaches or imperfect processes should be constraints to work with — not reasons why progress cannot happen.
What success looks like
Within the first 6–12 months, we expect to see measurable movement in addition to plans:
reduced recurring operational toil;
increasing developer and employee self-service;
stronger and clearer service ownership;
fewer repeated incidents and systemic operational failures;
more risk-based and automated change management;
improved developer and employee experience;
clearer operational and resilience metrics;
measurable progress toward a Platform Engineering model;
stronger operational resilience and risk management;
and Heads and Leads operating with greater autonomy.
You will have established a clear target operating model and transformation roadmap, but success will not be measured by the existence of the roadmap itself. It will be visible in how the organization operates.
Success means the organization requires less manual coordination and executive intervention while becoming more reliable, resilient, faster and more scalable.

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

 Job Description 

 Team Summary

Working closely with Canada market leadership, Sales, Business Lines, Finance and regional teams, the team connects strategy with execution and helps ensure we focus on the opportunities that matter most. The team’s remit spans market and commercial strategy, sales operations, business planning and performance management, with a focus on continuously improving how we serve clients and drive growth.

Reporting to the Vice President, Strategy & Operations, the Director will translate Canada’s strategic priorities into commercial action, strengthen performance management, and continuously evolve how we sell as client expectations, competition and technology change.

 Sales & Commercial Strategy

 Support client segmentation, account prioritization and coverage strategy.

jobs.description:
Sales Enablement Lead – North America
 Location: Toronto, Canada
 Practice Area: Global Sales | Growth Activation
 Employment Type: Permanent

 Shape strategic deals. Strengthen how we sell. Drive growth. 

 The Opportunity 

 Capco is looking for a Sales Enablement Lead – North America to play a key role in strengthening sales effectiveness, shaping strategic opportunities and driving growth across our US and Canadian businesses. Working closely with regional leadership and reporting to the Global Sales Enablement Lead, you will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution — supporting high-value pursuits, challenging commercial approaches and delivering practical initiatives that improve how we sell. This is a highly visible, collaborative role for someone who understands how consulting business is won, can engage credibly with senior leaders and has the drive to turn ideas into tangible results.

 What You'll Do 

 Drive Strategic Pursuits and Improve Win Rates 

 Lead and shape priority pursuits, from opportunity strategy and solution development through proposals, commercial discussions and executive presentations.

 Challenge deal strategies, sharpen differentiation and strengthen client value propositions.

 Bring together the right expertise across Capco to develop compelling, commercially sound solutions.

 Champion exceptional quality across strategic pursuits, establishing clear quality standards and review gates to ensure proposals, solutions and client presentations are compelling, differentiated and commercially robust.

 Facilitate pipeline and deal reviews, win strategy sessions and pitch preparation for major opportunities.

 Capture lessons from wins and losses to improve future deal performance.

 Build Sales Capabilities Across Capco 

 Lead and support sales education initiatives that strengthen sales confidence, develop practical selling skills and build growth capabilities across career levels.

 Design and deliver targeted learning, coaching and hands-on development for client-facing teams.

 Strengthen capabilities in opportunity origination, consultative selling, solution shaping, storytelling and strategic account growth.

 Work with regional leaders to identify capability gaps and address them through practical interventions.

 Build commercial confidence and embed effective sales behaviours into everyday client engagement.

 Make Selling More Effective 

 Develop practical playbooks, tools and guidance that improve effectiveness across the sales lifecycle.

 Champion AI-enabled sales productivity, identifying opportunities to simplify work, improve quality and reduce duplication.

 Drive the adoption and effective use of knowledge assets and reusable sales content.

 Translate successful sales approaches into repeatable practices that can scale across the business.

 Work with sellers to identify friction points and deliver improvements that make a tangible difference.

 Connect Expertise and Unlock Growth 

 Work across accounts, domains and capabilities to identify cross-sell opportunities and shape integrated client propositions.

 Connect regional teams with relevant market insights, expertise and growth initiatives from across Capco.

 Support joint pursuits and go-to-market opportunities with strategic partners, including Wipro.

 Turn successful approaches and lessons learned into opportunities for wider adoption across the firm.

 What We're Looking For 

 We are looking for a growth-minded, credible and action-oriented sales professional who understands how consulting business is won and actively collaborates across the leadership team to help Capco succeed. 

 You will bring:

 15+ years of consulting and financial services experience, ideally gained through client-facing consulting, business development, strategic sales or delivery roles.

 Proven experience shaping complex, high-value pursuits, including win strategy, solution development, proposals and senior client presentations.

 Commercial judgement and confidence to challenge senior stakeholders, test assumptions and strengthen deal strategies.

 A strong understanding of financial services, with experience in Banking, Capital Markets, Wealth & Asset Management or Insurance.

 Excellent storytelling and communication skills, translating complex ideas and solutions into compelling client narratives.

 Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to influence senior leaders and mobilize teams across a matrix organization.

 A strategic and analytical mindset, combined with the ability to turn ideas into practical solutions and measurable outcomes.

 A collaborative, entrepreneurial approach, with the confidence to take ownership, challenge constructively and get things done.

 A passion for developing people, sharing knowledge and strengthening the capabilities of the wider organization.

 Above all, you are someone who can see the bigger growth picture while staying close to the detail and execution.

 Bonus Points For 

 Experience designing or delivering sales capability development, coaching or enablement programs.

 Hands-on experience using Generative AI, GPT technologies or AI agents to improve sales productivity.

 Experience in sales operations, commercial management or sales process improvement.

 Experience developing joint propositions or supporting strategic partner pursuits.

 An established network within North American financial services.

 Experience implementing knowledge management, credentials or sales enablement platforms.

 Why Join Capco? 

 Influence growth across North America. Work directly with senior leaders and strategic deal teams to create opportunities, strengthen pursuits and contribute to business growth.

 Shape the future of how Capco sells. Play a leading role in building stronger sales capabilities, embedding effective commercial disciplines and delivering our Capco 30 ambitions.

 Make a tangible difference. This is a role where you will not just recommend improvements - you will shape, build and deliver them.

 Connect the best of Capco. Work across regions, domains, capabilities and strategic partners to bring our collective expertise to clients.

 Be part of an entrepreneurial culture. Join a collaborative, ambitious organization where ideas are valued, initiative is encouraged and individuals can make a visible impact.

 Grow your own career. Gain exposure to senior leadership, complex strategic opportunities and the development of a globally connected sales enablement capability.

 The Impact You'll Make 

 Your success will be measured by the difference you make: stronger deals, more confident sellers, better sales practices and greater commercial effectiveness.  You will help Capco win more business today while building the capabilities and disciplines that support sustainable growth tomorrow.

Benefits 

 We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

 Comprehensive Benefits Coverage: 100% company-paid health, life and disability insurance, effective from Day 1 of employment.

 Retirement Savings Program: Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with the option of receiving a matching employer contribution.

 Virtual Health Care: Company-paid virtual health care program available to all employees and their dependents/partners.

 Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP): Company-paid support services for employees and their dependents/partners.

 Parental Leave Top-Up: Enhanced parental leave benefits available from Day 1 of employment.

 New Parent Gift: A company-sponsored gift to celebrate the arrival of a new child.

 Wellness Support: Fitness reimbursement benefit to promote health and well-being.

 Business Coach from Day 1: Personalized one-on-one coaching to support career growth, accelerate development and help achieve your professional goals at Capco.

 Inclusion at Capco 

 We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

 Use of Artificial Intelligence in Talent Acquisition 

 At Capco, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support and enhance several parts of talent acquisition. This includes using AI-enabled features within LinkedIn to help source potential candidates, speeding up routine recruitment communications such as emails and creating compelling and brand-aligned job postings that accurately reflect role requirements, and AI-scheduling applications to improve the efficiency of interview coordination.  AI is used as a support tool only. All hiring decisions are made by talent acquisition and hiring teams.

 Why This Role Is Open 

 We are currently hiring for this role due to an existing or newly created vacancy within our organization. This position is open as part of our ongoing business needs, and we are actively reviewing applications to fill this role with a qualified candidate who can make an immediate impact.

CI Financial is seeking a Director, Insurance Operations to lead the modernization and ongoing performance of our Canadian individual life insurance Operations function.

This role combines daily operational leadership with a significant transformation mandate. You will strengthen case progression and carrier advocacy, build actionable Operations Intelligence, improve operational data and technology, develop differentiated advisor service, and lead an established team through sustained change.

This opportunity is suited to an insurance operations leader who has personally delivered meaningful change while remaining accountable for people, service quality, and daily results.

 Lead the daily performance and modernization of Insurance Operations.

 Strengthen case ownership, underwriting follow-up, carrier advocacy, escalation, delivery, placement, and oversight of complex, high-value, or aging cases.

 WHAT YOU WILL DO: 
 Liaison between the company, internal audit, external audit, and Mubadala Capital (CI’s parent) in corporate audit projects.

 Support internal and external auditors in their audit duties – ensure all requests are delivered in line with agreed timetable.

 Leading the management testing program areas such as scoping, scheduling, stakeholder management, workpaper review, etc., in communication with relevant stakeholders.

 Monitor management’s implementation of audit recommendations and maintain a tracking system to ensure timely resolution and accountability.
 Prepare and present reports with well-documented observations, risk ratings, and practical recommendations to Management and the Compliance Committee.
 Elevate the importance of internal controls through training and technical assistance on internal controls, risk management, compliance, and audit readiness, and coach team through the methods for evidence and retaining evidence of controls.

 Self-driven and self-managed with the ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet established deadlines.
 Strong project management skills.
 Preferred but not required: CISA or CIA Credentials.
 Fundamental understanding of core Information Technology processes and systems.
 Knowledge of internal control concepts and frameworks (COSO), Sarbanes-Oxley standards, and auditing processes.
 Extensive experience in auditing Sarbanes Oxley (SOX) IT General Controls (ITGC), IT Automated Controls (ITAC), including testing the completeness and accuracy (C&A) of key reports supporting business processes.
 Experience with testing various systems and technologies, such as ERP systems, cloud technologies, and other enterprise applications.
 Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data validation and record keeping.
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.
 Strong interpersonal and influencing skills and communication, reports and/or analytics, internal controls, compliance controls, knowledge and exposed to IT, back office and/or marketing operations, preferably in the online gaming industry.
 Superior written and verbal communication, listening and presentation skills to effectively communicate with individuals at all levels of an organization.
 Exceptional interpersonal, negotiating and influencing skills to achieve win-win solutions.
 Demonstrated leadership and strong commitment to collaboration and teamwork with proven success inspiring teams to high levels of performance and engagement.
 Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint).

 Personal Attributes 
 Team player, collaborative, approachable, supportive, positive, open, patient, diplomatic and respectful.
 A confident, proactive and results-oriented individual with the demeanor, maturity, and intellect required to quickly establish trust and credibility.
 Exceptional interpersonal, listening, and conflict management skills. High EQ and self-awareness.
 High level of tact, discretion, and diplomacy in dealing with highly sensitive and confidential matters.
 Influencer, able to persuade others to action without absolute authority.
 Not afraid to express opinions and provide feedback in a balanced and constructive manner.

 At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute. 

 To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com 

 What you'll be doing 

 Our product team brings together business, data, and technology expertise to deliver meaningful solutions that create value for clients and the business. As a Senior Director, Product Owner, you'll set the vision and direction for your Squad, ensuring priorities align with Crew strategy and broader organizational goals. You'll develop and manage a strategic product roadmap, translate complex business and client needs into clear backlog priorities, and lead release planning to deliver impactful outcomes. You'll work closely with partners across Crews, Squads, and business units to manage dependencies, resolve issues, and keep delivery on track in a complex environment. You'll also help strengthen product practices by mentoring other Product Owners, championing continuous improvement, and promoting delivery excellence across teams.

 At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote. 

 How you'll succeed 

 Product strategy and vision - Set and champion the Squad’s vision, goals, and priorities, ensuring alignment with Crew strategy and broader business objectives. Build and communicate a strategic product roadmap that maximizes client and business value.
 Backlog and delivery leadership - Build, prioritize, and manage a complex Squad backlog by translating business and client needs into actionable user stories and requirements. Lead release and delivery planning, assess outcomes, and reprioritize work to respond to changing needs.
 Risk and dependency management - Anticipate, navigate, and resolve risks, issues, and dependencies across Squads and business units. Ensure work is delivered within established frameworks, guardrails, and compliance requirements.
 Cross-functional collaboration - Partner with Crew Leads, Crew Technology Leads, Chapter Leads, Agility Coaches, Squad members, stakeholders, and external partners to drive progress and achieve shared outcomes. Build strong relationships across teams to support decision-making and delivery.
 Thought leadership and continuous improvement - Provide mentorship to other Product Owners and share best practices that strengthen product delivery across teams. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and product outcomes.

 Who you are 

 You act like an owner. You thrive when you're empowered to take initiative, go above and beyond, and deliver results.
 Your influence makes a difference. You know that relationships and networks are essential to success. You inspire outcomes by sharing your expertise.
 You give meaning to data. You enjoy investigating complex problems and making sense of information. You communicate detailed information in a meaningful way.
 You embrace and advocate for change. You continuously evolve your thinking and the way you work in order to deliver your best.
 You can demonstrate experience in product ownership, strategic roadmap development, backlog management, agile delivery, stakeholder management, and navigating complex cross-functional dependencies in data, technology, or analytics-focused environments. It’s an asset if you bring experience in decision science, machine learning, optimization, product analytics, technical strategy, or consulting.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Strategy Director
jobs.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

 Edelman is a trusted voice helping organizations earn trust through action. Through the Edelman Trust Barometer, the definitive global study of trust, we inform and advise leaders across business, government, media, and civil society on how trust shapes growth, reputation, and societal expectations. Our work is consistently recognized at the industry's highest levels, including Cannes Lions, WARC, and the IPA Effectiveness Awards.

 We are looking for a Senior Vice President, Brand Strategy to join our team in Canada, leading strategic thinking for some of the world's most recognized consumer brands.

 This is an opportunity to shape brand strategy across North America while collaborating with global teams to deliver culturally relevant, insight-driven work that connects brands with consumers in meaningful ways.

 As a senior strategic leader, you will work at the intersection of brand, culture, creativity, and commerce, helping clients navigate evolving consumer behaviours, identify new opportunities, and build brands that earn attention, trust, and relevance.

 You'll partner closely with senior client leaders, creative teams, strategists, and specialists across Edelman's integrated network to develop ambitious ideas grounded in consumer understanding and designed to drive business impact.
 This is a role for someone who loves the craft of strategy as much as the opportunity to lead it. You'll be hands-on in shaping the work, a trusted advisor to clients, and an inspiring mentor to the next generation of strategic talent.

 Who You Are
 You're a strategic thinker and brand builder who understands what makes consumers care, what drives culture, and how brands can show up meaningfully in people's lives.

 You bring deep experience working with consumer brands, ideally within CPG, and know how to turn complex business challenges, consumer insights, and cultural tensions into clear, compelling strategies that inspire creative thinking.
 You're equally comfortable working directly with senior clients, collaborating with creative teams, and rolling up your sleeves to develop the strategic thinking behind the work.

 You thrive in collaborative environments, bring curiosity and fresh perspectives to challenges, and enjoy working across markets and disciplines to create work that makes a difference.

 What You'll Do
 Lead brand strategy for major CPG clients, developing insight-led approaches that strengthen brand positioning, cultural relevance, consumer engagement, and business growth.
 Shape strategic thinking across North America, collaborating with Canadian, U.S., and global teams to connect local market understanding with regional and global brand ambitions.
 Turn consumer and cultural insights into creative opportunities, drawing on research, data, audience behaviours, category dynamics, and emerging trends to uncover compelling brand platforms and communications strategies.
 Partner with creative and integrated teams to inspire distinctive, culturally relevant ideas and campaigns that connect with consumers across earned, social, digital, and other brand touchpoints.
 Build trusted relationships with senior clients, providing strategic counsel, challenging conventional thinking, and helping brand leaders navigate evolving consumer expectations and business challenges.
 Drive strategic excellence and business growth, identifying opportunities to expand client partnerships, contributing to new business pitches, and championing work that delivers measurable impact.
 Lead and develop strategy talent, mentoring strategists, fostering collaboration, and building an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives and bold thinking can thrive.
 Champion innovation and connected thinking, bringing together expertise from across Edelman's North American and global network to explore new methodologies, tools, and approaches to brand-building.

 What We're Looking For
 10+ years of experience in brand strategy, communications strategy, advertising, integrated marketing, consulting, or a related discipline, including experience leading strategy for major consumer brands.
 Strong understanding of the CPG landscape, consumer behaviours, brand-building, and the cultural and commercial dynamics shaping categories such as food, beverage, personal care, and household products.
 Proven ability to develop compelling brand positioning, creative briefs, communications platforms, and integrated strategies that translate insights into distinctive, effective work.
 Experience leading large, complex client relationships and collaborating with senior stakeholders across multiple markets, ideally including North America.
 A track record of inspiring creative work and translating strategic thinking into measurable brand or business outcomes.
 Strong leadership, communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence clients, inspire creative teams, and mentor strategic talent.
 A collaborative, curious, and entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to bring together diverse perspectives and navigate complex, cross-functional environments.

 Life at Edelman
 At Edelman, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of some of the world's most recognized brands while working alongside talented colleagues across strategy, creative, communications, data, and digital.

 Our global network brings together different perspectives, expertise, and capabilities to solve complex challenges and create work that matters.
 Our culture is built on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum. 

 We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where people feel respected, supported, and empowered to bring their perspectives and ideas to the table.

 We believe that great strategy starts with curiosity, thrives through collaboration, and creates impact when it challenges what's possible.

 We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

 Mandatory Certification: Active CISSP credential backed by a deep understanding of SOC 2, ISO 27001, privacy regulations, and enterprise SaaS security standards.

 AI Security Expertise: Hands-on experience securing AI-enabled products and LLMs, or utilizing AI tools to scale security operations and automated testing.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Sandboxes
jobs.description:
About Docker 
 Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control. 
 _______________________________________________________________________

 The Role 
 The Products Team at Docker is looking for a Director of Product Management to lead our core Sandboxes platform. You will own the vision, strategy, roadmap and execution for Docker’s sandboxes, taking this area from high-level concept design to delivery and adoption. You will manage a team of 2-3 product managers, coaching them and setting the bar for how we build. You will help shape the future of a key area of Docker, partnering with Engineering, Design, Security, and Go-to-Market leaders, and working closely with developers inside and outside of Docker, our customers, and our partners to expand our open ecosystem offering and provide value. As the company and ecosystem grow, you will build a team and a culture eager to continuously build, measure, and learn.

 To thrive in this role, you’ll need a track record of leading product teams, along with deep experience working with developers and technical knowledge of developer tools. You’ll need to know how to work with the developer community and understand the lifecycle of software development, the software supply chain, and how AI agents are safely orchestrated and deployed with sandboxes. You’ll need a relentless drive to try new things, and an eye for detail. Your long-term success will depend on your ability to set and own the product strategy and roadmap, develop great product managers, collaborate with the developer community, and scale our services. Most importantly, you’ll need to be okay with taking ownership of big objectives with big goals, leading through cross-functional teams, and maintaining a bias for action.
 _______________________________________________________________________

 Responsibilities 
 You own the product line for Docker’s sandboxes: the long-term vision, the strategy, the roadmap, the revenue, and the results.

 You lead and manage a team of 2-3 product managers. You coach them, set clear expectations and a high bar for product quality, and create the conditions for them to do the best work of their careers.

 You believe in and can articulate succinctly our customers and their pain points. You empathize with and understand the world they live in and the constraints they work through, and you make sure your team does too.

 You will engage deeply with developers and find amazing solutions that solve today’s problems while optimizing for tomorrow’s vision, including how AI agents are safely run and orchestrated.

 You enjoy building products that are easy to adopt and use. You have a keen design sensibility, and you hold your team to a standard of always looking for ways to improve usability.

 You are comfortable with ambiguity and will guide product definition, prioritization, and scope across your team, in concert with Engineering, Design, Security, and Go-to-Market leaders.

 You translate company strategy into a clear product direction and communicate it with clarity and conviction to partners and your own team.

 You present your thinking, plans, and progress to Docker’s executive leadership team, making a clear case for where to invest and why, and you incorporate their feedback into the strategy.

 _______________________________________________________________________

 Qualifications 
 You have 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years managing and developing product managers.

 You have deep empathy for the needs of developers and are obsessed with talking to your users.

 You have created and deployed AI agents at scale and dealt with all the challenges and pain points of such tasks.

 You have experience building B2B, SaaS, or have a background in Public Cloud.

 You have experience working with tools in the software supply chain and/or software security.

 You can set a multi-year product vision and strategy, then break it down into small, release-able, user-valuable features that your team can deliver.

 You can explain complex ideas simply and communicate across diverse stakeholders, including presenting to executive leadership.

 You have effective written, verbal, and visual communication skills.

 You can analyze data, both qualitative and quantitative, to inform decision making, and you coach your team to do the same.

 You have a collaborative approach and the ability to lead through influence with fast-moving, distributed, cross-functional teams.

 You have experience running products at various stages of maturity, from legacy to greenfield.

 You are a coach/player. We are small and need all hands on deck. Everyone gets their hands dirty

 Visa sponsorship: Not available for this role.
 _______________________________________________________________________

 Compensation & Equity 
 All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

 Canada: CA$381,472 - CA$429,156 base
 United States: $280,000 - $315,000 base

 ______________________________________________________________________

 Posting Information 
 Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

 AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

 Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

 ______________________________________________________________________

 Perks & Benefits 
 Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

 Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

 Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

 Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

 Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

 Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

 Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

 Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

 Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

 Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

 Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

 Brand activation across Global Marketing
 Be the single point of accountability for how the Equinix brand shows up across the whole marketing organization, and the person every team goes to when they need the brand to work harder for them
 Translate brand strategy into activation plans that Web, Social, Paid Media, and Thought Leadership can execute, and set the brand standards each of those teams builds from

 Partner with Marketing Ops and IT on tooling, data, and governance so brand agents fit the broader Marketing AI stack rather than sitting beside it

 Be the person people come to when something is off brand, and the person who makes it easy to get it right

 Qualifications

 10 or more years in brand, creative, or integrated marketing, including several years leading brand execution for a global B2B company. Technology or infrastructure experience is a plus, not a requirement

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. 

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. 

 We are looking for a Senior Director to lead our AMER Enterprise Customer Success Management organization at an important point in the evolution of Customer Success Management at Equinix.  This leader will be responsible for translating our global Customer Success Management strategy into a value-led, data-driven regional operating model that strengthens customer relationships, improves value realization, identifies and mitigates risk, and drives predictable retention, renewals and growth.  

 The role requires more than operating an established Customer Success Management organization. We are looking for a builder and transformation leader who can help shape how Customer Success operates - combining high-touch customer engagement with data, digital capabilities, automation and AI to create a more proactive and scalable customer experience.  The Senior Director will lead CSM teams across AMER and serve as a senior Customer Success partner to AMER Sales leadership and teams across Equinix. Success will require the ability to set a clear vision, simplify complexity, develop strong leaders, and turn strategy into consistent execution across a diverse region.

 Key Responsibilities: 

 Lead a value-led Customer Success organization 
 Build a culture in which Customer Success begins with understanding customer priorities and desired outcomes. Ensure CSMs translate those priorities into Success Plans, value realization, adoption strategies, executive engagement and measurable customer outcomes. 
 Own retention, renewals and commercial performance 
 Be accountable for regional retention and renewal performance and predictability. Establish disciplined renewal management, forecasting and risk practices while strengthening CSM commercial acumen and accountability. Partner closely with Sales on renewal strategy, expansion opportunities and long-term customer value. 
 Build a proactive, data-driven engagement model 
 Use customer health, risk, lifecycle, commercial and behavioral signals to help CSMs prioritize where and how they engage. Drive a shift from reactive account management toward proactive engagement focused on value, risk, renewal and growth. 
 Operationalize the global Customer Success Management model across AMER 
 Translate global coverage, segmentation and engagement standards into disciplined regional execution while accounting for the needs of AMER customers and markets. Establish clear expectations engagement models and ensure consistent execution of core Customer Success Management motions. 
 Scale Customer Success through digital, automation and AI 
 Champion the use of technology to increase CSM capacity and improve the customer experience. Partner with global teams to incorporate digital journeys, automation, AI and agentic capabilities into the Customer Success operating model allowing CSMs to focus their time where human relationships, judgment and expertise create the greatest value. 
 Create consistent customer engagement and value rhythms 
 Drive consistent execution of Success Planning, Customer Business Reviews, health and risk management, renewal readiness and executive engagement. Ensure these motions are focused on customer outcomes rather than activity completion. 
 Partner deeply with AMER Sales and cross-functional leaders 
 Serve as the senior Customer Success counterpart to AMER Sales leadership. Build strong partnerships across Sales, Service Management, Renewals, Support, Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance and other teams to create a coordinated post-sale customer experience and remove barriers to customer outcomes. 
 Clarify CSM and Service Management accountability 
 Help establish clear accountability between value-led Customer Success Management and operational Service Management. Reduce unnecessary handoffs, eliminate ambiguity and ensure CSM capacity remains focused on customer value, retention and growth. 
 Manage material customer and commercial risk 
 Provide executive oversight for significant customer, relationship and renewal risks that cannot be resolved at the account or manager level. Ensure risks are identified early, clearly understood and addressed cross-functionally. 
 Build and develop an exceptional regional leadership team 
 Lead and coach CSM leaders across the AMERs. Build leadership capability in value articulation, commercial acumen, executive engagement, change leadership and disciplined execution. Own regional workforce planning and ensure organizational capabilities evolve alongside the Customer Success model. 
 Lead transformation and continuous improvement 
 Create belief in the future-state Customer Success model and translate transformation strategy into clear expectations and behaviors. Challenge legacy practices, remove barriers to change, and establish a culture of measurement, experimentation and continuous improvement. 

 Skills, Experience & Qualifications 
 We are looking for a leader who brings:
 Extensive experience leading Customer Success or related GTM organizations. 
 Demonstrated experience building and operationalizing value-led Customer Success motions, including Success Planning, value realization, adoption, customer health, risk management and executive engagement. 
 Proven accountability for retention, renewals, renewal forecasting and commercial performance. 
 Experience leading segmented Customer Success Management models and operating across differentiated coverage approaches such as high-touch, pooled and digital. 
 Advanced proficiency in Gainsight is required, with a proven ability to leverage the platform to drive customer success strategy, operational rigor, forecasting, customer health management, and executive-level business insights. 
 Experience using data, customer signals and analytics to prioritize engagement and improve customer outcomes. 
 Strong understanding of how digital Customer Success, automation and AI can increase scale and improve customer experience without sacrificing important human relationships. 
 Experience leading significant operating-model or organizational transformation and bringing teams through meaningful change. 
 Demonstrated ability to build strong partnerships with Sales and senior cross-functional leaders. 
 Experience developing leaders and building high-performing Customer Success Management organizations. 
 Bachelor's degree in a business-related discipline or equivalent experience. 

 Leadership Characteristics 
 The successful candidate will be:
 A builder and operator who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. 
 A customer- and value-first leader who understands the connection between customer outcomes, retention and growth. 
 A strong commercial leader who is comfortable owning renewal performance and predictability. 
 A digital-first thinker who sees technology, automation and AI as ways to enhance, not replace, the customer relationship. 
 A strong simplifier who can turn complex strategies into clear priorities and operating expectations. 
 A confident leader of leaders with a strong coaching and talent-development mindset. 
 Highly effective at influencing across organizational boundaries and building alignment with Sales and other functions. 
 Data-informed and comfortable using signals and metrics to drive decisions. 
 Comfortable operating with ambiguity and leading through significant transformation. 
 Willing to roll up their sleeves when necessary to turn a vision into an operating reality.

 The Director, AI & Automation is a senior business transformation leader accountable for setting the direction for, and leading the identification, prioritization, and delivery of, artificial intelligence, generative AI, intelligent automation, and digital workflow solutions across Procurement and the broader Operations organization. The role will translate enterprise and business priorities into a scalable portfolio of initiatives that simplify work, improve decision-making, strengthen controls, and create measurable operational and financial value.

No AI or automation initiative will advance outside established DIO engagement, intake, architecture, platform, data, Information Security, and Cybersecurity processes. The Director will connect business process expertise with approved enterprise platforms and technical capabilities, including AI assistants and agents, machine learning, robotic process automation, workflow automation, intelligent document processing, process mining, analytics, and low-code solutions. 

 The role will serve as a strategic partner to Procurement, MCE, GDC, and other Operations senior leaders, leading the redesign of priority processes and scaling practical solutions that reduce manual effort, cycle time, cost, and operational risk. All opportunities, experiments, pilots, and production deployments will be planned and executed with DIO engagement and in alignment with enterprise architecture, Information Security, Cybersecurity, privacy, data governance, Responsible AI, and change-management requirements 

 Responsibilities 

 AI & Automation Strategy and Portfolio 
 Set the vision for and own a multi-year AI and automation roadmap aligned with Procurement, MCE, GDC, and broader Operations priorities
 Partner with DIO leadership to apply its established intake and assessment process to identify, size, prioritize, and sequence opportunities based on business value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, security requirements, and scalability
 Own business cases, delivery plans, resource requirements, investment asks, and benefit targets for the portfolio, with clear accountability and executive decision points
 Monitor market and enterprise technology developments and advise senior leadership on practical use cases that address defined business problems rather than technology-driven experimentation

 Business Partnership and Process Transformation 
 Serve as a trusted advisor to Procurement and Operations leaders to shape strategic priorities, map end-to-end processes, identify root causes, and redesign work before automating it
 Direct focus toward high-value opportunities across source-to-pay, supplier management, contracting, risk and compliance, planning, project delivery, asset operations, and shared operational services
 Partner with MCE and GDC leadership to improve productivity, throughput, service levels, data quality, cost performance, and execution predictability
 Lead discovery efforts and ensure business needs are translated into clear process, data, user, control, and technology requirements

 DIO-Led Governance, Partnership, and Solution Delivery 
 Serve as the primary business leader and counterpart to DIO leadership and DIO product, engineering, architecture, data, security, and platform teams, ensuring DIO is engaged from initial opportunity identification through planning, delivery, production approval, and ongoing support
 Co-develop solution strategies and delivery roadmaps with DIO within DIO governance and using DIO-approved enterprise capabilities, including generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, RPA, workflow, intelligent document processing, process mining, and low-code tools
 Provide business leadership across the full lifecycle—discovery, prototyping, design, testing, deployment, stabilization, support transition, and continuous improvement—while DIO provides the required technology governance, architecture, security, and platform engagement
 Direct and align business subject-matter experts, DIO teams, Information Security, Cybersecurity, vendors, implementation partners, and managed-service providers to deliver on scope, schedule, quality, security, and value commitments

 DIO-Centered Governance, Information Security, and Responsible AI 
 Operate within DIO-owned governance, design standards, documentation requirements, stage gates, decision rights, and operating routines; do not initiate or advance AI and automation work without the appropriate DIO engagement and approvals
 Ensure Information Security and Cybersecurity are engaged through DIO at the earliest stage and maintain alignment throughout design, testing, deployment, monitoring, and change management
 Ensure solutions comply with DIO requirements for enterprise architecture, approved platforms, cybersecurity, information security, privacy, data governance, records management, legal and regulatory obligations, and Responsible AI
 Partner with DIO, Information Security, and Cybersecurity leadership to define controls for human oversight, identity and access, data protection, testing, model and output quality, exception handling, monitoring, incident response, and issue escalation
 Provide transparent reporting to executive, business, and DIO stakeholders on portfolio health, dependencies, risks, approvals, costs, benefits, adoption, and operational performance

 Adoption, Capability Building, and Value Realization 
 Lead stakeholder, communication, training, and adoption strategies that embed new ways of working and deliver sustained business outcomes
 Champion AI and automation fluency across Procurement and Operations through playbooks, reusable patterns, communities of practice, and role-based learning
 Establish baselines and own value tracking across productivity, cycle time, cost, quality, compliance, user experience, adoption, and capacity released for higher-value work
 Deliver executive-ready recommendations, portfolio updates, and value-realization reporting to senior leadership; take decisive action when initiatives are not delivering expected outcomes

 Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
 Typically, 10+ years of progressive experience in AI, intelligent automation, digital transformation, process excellence, product or program management, or technology-enabled operations, including leadership of complex cross-functional initiatives
 Demonstrated experience identifying, prioritizing, and delivering AI and automation use cases from concept through production, adoption, and value realization
 Working knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, RPA, workflow automation, intelligent document processing, process mining, analytics, APIs, and low-code platforms
 Experience improving end-to-end business processes and translating operational needs into business requirements, solution designs, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes
 Strong understanding of DIO-centered technology governance and the role of enterprise architecture, Information Security, Cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, controls, testing, monitoring, and Responsible AI across the solution lifecycle
 Proven ability to partner with senior business leaders, technology organizations, process owners, vendors, and geographically distributed teams in a global matrixed environment
 Excellent business-case development, program leadership, analytical problem-solving, facilitation, executive communication, and stakeholder-influence capabilities

 Preferred Qualifications
 Advanced degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
 Experience applying AI and automation in Procurement, source-to-pay, supplier management, infrastructure delivery, data center, engineering, construction, or asset-intensive operations
 Experience with enterprise platforms and ecosystems such as Microsoft Azure and Power Platform, Copilot, UiPath, ServiceNow, Celonis, Oracle, Coupa, or comparable technologies
 Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, process reengineering, product management, agile delivery, or enterprise change-management methods
 Relevant certification in AI, automation, cloud, process mining, project or product management, change management, or process improvement

jobs.description:
Who are we? 
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.   

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. 

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. 

 Job Summary 
 We are more than legal professionals protecting Equinix’s interests. We are valued business partners, known as responsive, consistent and proactive. We take customer service seriously and strive for excellence in our execution. Equinix’s dynamic growth trajectory keeps us on our toes and constantly learning. Our strong relationships with our internal clients, fueled by our solution-driven orientation and creative yet practical advice, bring us to the table early and often and lead to interesting and rewarding work in support of Equinix’s overall business objectives.

 Our global Legal department may span four continents, but we are One Legal - a true team working together across borders in support of our shared strategic objectives. We work hard but take time to celebrate our accomplishments – both professional and personal, with a healthy dose of fun thrown in along the way. We look forward to coming to work every day to support Equinix and each other and highly value the “team first” culture we have created. We are proud that our collective effort has led to Equinix One Legal being named as one of the Top Innovative Law Departments in North America by the Financial Times.

 This open role of Senior Director, Americas will be responsible for supporting the one of the 2 Strategic accounts teams and is the leader of the Global Contracts Americas region team. Responsible for the team’s contracting support for named accounts and as lead representing the Americas Region, this role is instrumental in leading these teams and closing complex, strategic deals and keeping abreast of the legal developments in the region. This role advises the business in alignment with corporate goals and objectives and risk thresholds in a manner that supports the objectives for the global business. Adept at using and leveraging technology to better scale the organization, this role oversees deals which have significant impact to the business, specifically the Americas business and is charged with building relationships with our Americas stakeholders and in concert with others in the Global Contracts team, to take charge of specialized areas which are entrusted to them by the Vice President Global Contracts or the Chief Legal Officer as the case may be.

 Location
 Americas-based. The role must be positioned to provide effective leadership and senior stakeholder coverage across Americas working hours, while operating globally across time zones.
 Reports to
 Vice President, Legal, Global Contracts.

 Responsibilities 
 This role is a senior people leader, commercial lawyer and trusted business adviser responsible for these mandates:

 Americas leadership
 Lead and coordinate Global Contracts’ presence and engagement across the Americas, representing GC with Americas business leadership and ensuring that regional priorities are understood, translated into clear legal support strategies and delivered effectively
 Translate Americas priorities and risks into clear legal support plans, ensuring GC is engaged early and support is responsive, consistent and commercially pragmatic
 Provide senior escalation support on significant Americas and strategic matters (including complex customer negotiations, strategic opportunities, disputes, public-sector opportunities outside the US Federal business), coordinate Americas-based GC colleagues, and manage external counsel where required

 Leadership of Strategics team and its named-account portfolio
 Lead the team, setting its vision, strategy and operating model, with overall accountability for legal support to its portfolio of named AI, Neocloud, SaaS and semiconductor accounts, Channel/OEM accounts
 Maintain close oversight of account strategy, pipeline, risk, resourcing and escalations, and ensure effective delivery across the full deal lifecycle
 Partner with the Channel Lead on Channel go-to-market support, collaborate with other GC and One Legal leaders where needed and/or portfolios intersect, and shape the team's future structure as it matures

 Complex deal leadership and negotiation
 Personally lead or oversee the most complex, strategic and high-value transactions, operating as an experienced and credible negotiator across customers, partners, external counsel and senior stakeholders
 Balance commercial, legal and operational considerations, present clear recommendations to executives, and drive matters to closure
 Convert deal experience into scalable positions, templates and training, while mentoring the team to build negotiating capability and domain knowledge

 People leadership and capability development
 Lead, coach and develop a team of lawyers and contracts professionals, setting a clear vision, objectives and a collaborative, high-performing "team first" culture
 Provide clear direction, candid feedback and meaningful development; manage performance fairly and recognise strong contribution
 Close capability gaps through mentoring and succession planning, and develop future leaders able to work across boundaries

 Global Contracts leadership
 Act as a full member of the GC leadership team, contributing to strategy, operating model, talent, culture and resourcing
 Work with peer leaders to build consistency across teams while respecting portfolio and regional differences
 Support global initiatives (policy, process, technology, transformation) and model enterprise leadership across GC and One Legal

 Technology, transformation and scale
 Champion technology, including AI tools, to improve service delivery, reporting and decision-making, and drive standardisation to increase capacity
 Ensure the team adopts GC platforms, processes and knowledge resources, using data to monitor workload, risk and performance
 Lead transformation in a way that builds team capability and confidence, not just system adoption

 Governance, risk and operational excellence
 Work with the VP, Global Contracts to apply practical risk frameworks, policies and escalation paths, ensuring consistency with Company policy and governance
 Oversee work allocation, resourcing, budget and external counsel use, with clear reporting on significant matters and risks
 Promote collaboration with shared-services teams and drive operational excellence through accountability and continuous improvement

 Qualifications 
 The successful candidate will bring:
 A law degree and admission to practise in a relevant jurisdiction (e.g. a state in the United States of America)
 Substantial post-qualification legal experience appropriate for a Senior Director role, preferably including at least 15 years of experience in a similar role (having at least five years of strong law-firm experience is a preference)
 Deep experience in negotiating and in commercial contracting and in leading complex, strategic, high-value and high-impact transactions
 Demonstrated success as a people leader, with a genuine interest in managing, coaching and developing lawyers and contracts professionals
 A clear leadership vision and experience evolving a team’s capabilities, structure, operating model or strategic direction
 Experience supporting senior business leaders in an international, fast-moving and commercially demanding environment
 Experience operating successfully in a matrix organisation and working across functions, reporting lines, geographies and time zones
 Strong commercial and legal judgement, with the ability to assess risk, balance legal and business considerations and recommend practical solutions
 Executive presence and the confidence to advise, challenge and influence the most senior leaders in the organisation
 Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly, concisely and persuasively

jobs.description:
Who are we? 
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.   

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. 

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. 

 Job Summary 
 A lot of companies are still working out what AI means for how work gets done. At Equinix, this role sits at the center of that question. In this role, you’ll help decide how the company reimagines its most critical value streams leveraging AI, and how its leaders build the management habits that make the changes stick.

 The Senior Director, Process Excellence guides how Equinix reimagines some of its most critical value streams for AI transformation. Forward-deployed engineers build and deploy the solutions. This leader facilitates the work that comes before and alongside them: bringing business leaders and engineers into the same room to examine how work flows today, decide what the future flow should look like, and place AI and human judgment where each adds the most value, so the redesign starts from outcomes and decisions rather than from tools.

 The role also develops the management practices / operating system that put continuous improvement principles to work, drawing on lean principles, along with the toolset that supports them, in partnership with HR. In selected areas of focus, this leader coaches parts of the organization directly on building the operating system that sustains a culture of continuous improvement. You’ll work with business leaders, people team, and our Digital and Innovation Organization, with visibility to senior leadership.

 Responsibilities 
 Reimagining Critical Value Streams for AI Transformation
 Facilitate working sessions with business leaders and forward-deployed engineers to examine how work actually flows, find the structural bottlenecks, handoffs, and rework, and define the future flow before solutions are built
 Bring Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, and value stream thinking together with process and process mining, so the redesign is grounded in how work runs today and aimed at measurable gains in speed, quality, cost, and decision-making
 Help business leaders design for decisions and outcomes rather than tasks, build intelligence into core workflows, and place AI, automation, and human judgment where each adds the most value
 Advise senior leaders on where AI applies and where it does not, and challenge designs that only speed up an existing process
 Connect business leaders, the Digital and AI organization, and change efforts so that opportunities move from identification to deployment and adoption
 Promote always-on visibility into how redesigned processes perform, so gains are sustained and drift is caught early
 Establish a consistent approach across the enterprise to prioritizing, framing, and launching value stream redesigns

 Management Practices / Operating System
 Develop the Equinix management practices / operating system that builds from some of the best and enforces continuous improvement principles into daily use, including visual management, structured problem solving, performance management, and standard work
 Build, with partners, the toolset that supports those practices, including standards, templates, and routines that teams can adopt and adapt
 Work with HR so the practices reinforce the leadership expectations set for the company, and so the language, learning experiences, and capability pathways are consistent
 Help create the shared language and mindset that make continuous improvement part of how the company operates
 Coach selected parts of the organization on best practices for building the operating system that drives continuous improvement, with hands-on enablement in priority areas so teams and leaders can apply the practices and the redesign approach themselves
 Decide what is standard across the enterprise and what can flex by region or function, and set a deliberate path for starting the practices where they will take hold
 Embed process excellence disciplines at scale, and build communities of practice in process redesign and AI-enabled improvement so the capability spreads beyond this team
 Assess how mature the practices are across the organization, establish feedback loops on adoption and effectiveness, and refine the system based on what is learned

 Qualifications 
 Required
 12–15+ years leading enterprise-level operational excellence, process excellence, or large-scale change in complex, global organizations
 Fluency in Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, and value stream methods, and the ability to apply them to redesign how end-to-end work flows
 Working knowledge of AI, analytics, automation, and digital platforms, with the ability to translate capability into business outcomes
 Strong facilitation and coaching skills, with credibility working with senior leaders and executives
 Experience developing management practices and tools built on lean principles, and helping an organization adopt them at scale
 Deep understanding of organizational behavior and what it takes to change habits and shared language
 Comfort building something without an established playbook, balancing structure with pragmatism
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or equivalent experience

 Preferred
 Hands-on experience with process or task mining
 Experience partnering with HR on capability programs
 Experience in technology, services, or infrastructure environments
 Lean Six Sigma, change management, or comparable certification

 How You’ll Make an Impact 
 The Director, Architecture & Technology Strategy reports to the Vice President, AI and is responsible for shaping and executing the enterprise architecture and technology strategy for Fidelity Investments Canada. The role provides strategic and people leadership across enterprise, domain, solution and data architecture, ensuring these capabilities evolve in support of the firm's business priorities, technology modernization and AI ambitions. 

 The successful candidate will combine strong strategic thinking, technical depth and business partnership skills.  Strong knowledge of enterprise, domain, solution and data architecture, including application design, integration patterns, data modelling, semantic layers and enterprise information architecture. 
 Strong understanding of technology modernization, architecture governance, technical debt management, technology lifecycle management and enterprise architecture standards. 
 Broad knowledge of enterprise architecture across applications, integration, cloud, security and technology domains and experience establishing target-state architecture and multi-year technology roadmaps. 
 Strong understanding of how enterprise architecture and modern engineering practices enable AI, machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI and AI-enabled software development at enterprise scale.

 Exceptional leadership, interpersonal, communication, presentation and relationship-management skills, including the ability to influence senior business, technology and international stakeholders.
