jobs.title: Head of Partnerships
jobs.description:
This posting reflects a current, actively recruited opening at Float. All applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis. 

 About Float 
 Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 

 As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025, 2024 and 2023, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

 At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

 Our Product 
 Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

 Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.

 AI Use in Our Hiring Process 
 We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

 About the Role 
 Float’s partnerships channel is one of our newest growth motions, and the one with the most room to run.

 Accounting firms, affiliates and technology platforms already use Float as one place to manage their clients’ financial operations while growing their own. The foundation is strong. The playbook is still unwritten.

 As Head of Partnerships, you’ll report into our SVP of GTM and own the partnerships channel end to end: how we find and win partners across all three types, how we build a community that makes them want to stay, and how what they tell us shapes the product roadmap. You’ll take partnerships from promising to a meaningful share of Float’s growth.

 What You’ll Do 
 Write the partnership playbook 
 Build a multi-year partnership strategy with clear milestones tied to revenue and strategic value.

 Create the processes, playbooks and infrastructure to scale from a handful of partners to dozens.

 Set the targets and reporting. You define what a great channel looks like, then hit it.

 Win and grow partners 
 Find, win, activate and grow partners across accounting and bookkeeping firms, fractional finance teams and investor networks.

 Own the full deal cycle, from first conversation to signed partner.

 Design one-to-many distribution and enablement programs so one partner relationship reaches hundreds of clients.

 Start with the firms that bring the most reach, then widen from there. Once a partner is live, work with Sales to accelerate revenue through them.

 Build the community 
 Run the programs, events and community that make partners better at their jobs and make serving clients easier.

 Track what each partner type delivers, and double down on what works.

 Own how Float shows up for partners, in their language, alongside Marketing.

 Bring the outside in 
 Carry market intelligence and partner feedback back into company strategy and roadmap.

 Work with internal stakeholders to clear whatever slows partners down.

 Build the team 
 Grow a small team, shape it around where the channel is today, and decide where you stay hands-on.

 What You'll Bring 
 8+ years in partnerships, channel or ecosystem growth in B2B SaaS, fintech or payments, including building a partner program from the early stage

 Proven ownership of a partner funnel end to end (sourcing, conversion, activation, expansion) and fluency in the numbers behind each stage

 Comfort being the public face of a program: building community and representing us with external partners

 A marketer’s instinct for positioning a product for a specific audience, ideally professional-services firms

 Experience leading a small team

 Working knowledge of how accounting and bookkeeping firms operate

 Willingness to travel regularly across Canada for events and partner visits

 Strong command of AI tools, as both a user and a builder

 Nice to haves 
 A network in Canadian accounting, bookkeeping, VC or PE circles, or a background as an accountant or bookkeeper

 French proficiency (an asset, not a requirement)

 This May Not Be the Role for You If
 You need an established playbook and a large team before you can do your best work.

 You would rather manage a channel from the sidelines than meet partners yourself.

 You prefer a narrow, single-function remit. This role spans marketing, sales and product.

 You're not energized by feedback or fast-paced change.

 Our Hiring Philosophy 
 We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.

 Why You Should Join 
 Be part of an award winning company: we're one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies 2026 according to Report on Business, and Deloitte’s Technology Fast50 2026

 Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role

 Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team

 Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits

 Hybrid work model: we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration

 Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday

 Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office

 Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters

 In Short 
 At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you. 

 Protect yourself from recruiting scams. Float only contacts candidates from @ floatfinancial.com addresses and schedules interviews through Ashby or Float calendar invites. We will never ask you to install software, pay a fee, buy equipment or share bank or card details. If something looks off, don't engage. 

 We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic ( victoria@floatfinancial.com ), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

jobs.title: Head of Domain, Product & Engineering
jobs.description:
Who we are: 

 Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. 

  

 Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. 

  

 Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our  blog  and follow us @InsideGeotab on  Instagram.  

 Who you are: 

 Geotab is looking for entrepreneurial product and business leaders to head our domains – focused teams that each own a customer outcome and the business results that come with it. As a Head of Domain, you'll own the strategy, roadmap and results for your area, lead a multi-disciplinary team of product managers, designers and engineers, and turn customer problems into products that customers adopt and pay for. 

 What you'll do: 

 This is a role for someone who has built and sold something: a leader who measures success by business results, not by what shipped, and who uses AI to change how work gets done. You'll report to Geotab's Technology Development Board and operate with real autonomy as the business owner of your domain. 

 We welcome applicants nationwide! If you’re based near one of our office hubs, this role follows our hybrid model, blending the comfort of working from home with regular on-site days to connect and collaborate. 

 This is an evergreen posting. We're building a pipeline of exceptional leaders for current and future domain leadership opportunities across Technology Development. 

 How you'll make an impact: 

 Own the outcome. Set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your domain and be accountable for its primary business results – adoption, revenue, retention and customer impact. 

 Run it like a business. Make clear build, buy and partner decisions, prioritize by customer and revenue impact, and say no when the return isn't there. 

 Stay close to customers. Ground your team in customers' real experience to find the problems worth solving, and work with sales, support and partners to bring solutions to market. 

 Lead the AI shift. Redesign how your domain works around AI to move faster, and help others across the organization do the same. 

 Build a high-performing team. Hire the right talent without settling, place people where their strengths matter most, set a clear and high bar, and develop the next generation of leaders. 

 Work across Geotab. Partner closely with platform, segment and other domain leaders, contribute beyond your own goals, and help shape strategy with the Technology Development Board. 

 Manage your investment. Own your domain's people and budget plan, make investment cases, and report on results and risks to the board. 

 What you'll bring to this role: 

 10+ years of experience in product management, product engineering, or related customer-facing product roles. 

 5+ years of senior product and people leadership with cross-functional scope and direct accountability for customer-facing business outcomes. 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience). 

 Strong product leadership capability with demonstrated ability to define and execute customer-facing product strategy tied to measurable business outcomes, with P&L literacy and revenue attribution. 

 Cross-functional leadership experience managing teams across product management, product design, and product engineering disciplines, with proven capability in identifying and coaching high-potential leaders. 

 Excellent stakeholder management, change readiness, and communication skills to effectively collaborate with platform teams, segment leads, and executive leadership in evolving organizational structures. 

 Familiarity with modern product discovery, validation practices, and engineering practices (CI/CD, cloud-native delivery, agile), alongside the ability to redesign domain workflows around AI to compress effort. 

  

 Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees. 

  

 This posting is not for an existing vacancy. 

  

 Why job seekers choose Geotab: 

 Flex working arrangements 
 Baby bonus & parental leave top up program 
 Online learning and networking opportunities 
 Electric vehicle purchase incentive program 
 Competitive medical and dental benefits 
 Retirement savings program 

 *The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only 

 How we work: 

 At Geotab, we thrive on a flexible hybrid work model that combines the dynamic energy and connection of in-person collaboration with the independence and flexibility of virtual work. We believe that coming together in person is fundamental to cultivating trust, nurturing a vibrant culture of belonging, and fostering meaningful innovation across our diverse teams. Office visit schedules are tailored thoughtfully based on role requirements. Specific expectations regarding workplace location and on-site attendance for this position will be shared during the hiring process. 

  

 #LI-Hybrid 

  

 We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Click here to read our Privacy Notice.  

 The annual base salary for this position is the expected annual salary for this role, and may be subject to change.  Key Accountabilities: 

 People leadership, development, and organizational health. 

 AI-native product development lifecycle, including AI-assisted modernization of legacy MyGeotab workflow pages. 

 Cross-domain communication and coordination. 

 Product ownership and engineering standards for MyGeotab core workflows 

 Customer outcomes and reliability, with MyGeotab customers as primary customers and dependent product domains as internal customers 

 How you'll make an impact: 

 Product Engineering & Technical Standards 

 Define, maintain, and evolve the technical standards, architectural patterns, and shared components for the domain's workflows. 

 Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of messaging, notification, rules UI, and exception services; accountable to customer-facing SLOs for notification delivery success and latency. Own regression protection and VIP-customer test coverage so no release silently breaks customers' rules or notifications. 

 Lead the identification and resolution of technical debt, security vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements in the domain, including the integrity of group-based data visibility, in coordination with Core API and Security. 

 Shape and communicate the vision for core workflows to solution and segment domains; publish and maintain the capability contract for rules, notifications, and groups — intended use patterns, integration standards, and system constraints — so consuming domains can build on reusable platform capability correctly and confidently; keep platform tooling decisions aligned with the needs of consuming domains. 

 Modernize legacy MyGeotab workflow pages to the Zenith/React stack, using AI-assisted conversion where practical, while preserving the behaviour customers depend on. 

 Customer Outcomes & Enablement 

 Treat product domain teams as internal customers of rules, notifications, and groups; proactively understand their evolving needs and remove blockers. MyGeotab customers remain the domain's primary customers. 

 Own product discovery and the domain roadmap with the domain's product manager and designers; prioritize transparently based on customer impact, reliability, and the needs of dependent domains. 

 Define and measure customer and product metrics as primary success indicators: notification delivery success and latency, exception-to-notification time, rules-related incidents and PMIRs, support ticket volume per feature, feature adoption and usage, and investigation escalation accuracy. 

 Establish feedback loops with peer Heads of Domain to capture platform gaps and translate them into actionable improvements. 

 Provide technical consultation and guidance to product domain teams on the capabilities and constraints of rules, notifications, and groups. 

 Manage external delivery dependencies (email, SMS, voice, and webhook providers) and internal dependencies (Gateway/embedded for in-vehicle feedback, Drive and in-cab devices for messaging, the rules engine, Video, and Safety) — integration standards and the risk each dependency creates for reliability and roadmap. 

 People Development 

 Provide career development support. 

 Conduct regular 1:1s and performance conversations. 

 Support employees through KPA goal-setting and development planning. 

 Oversee the hiring, onboarding, development, and performance management of a cross-functional team consisting of product managers, designers, and product engineers or other skills as required. 

 Support company-wide strategic initiatives including AI adoption, security posture, accessibility, and compliance programs as directed. 

 Identify growth opportunities and training aligned to domain needs. 

 Foster a high-trust, high-accountability team culture that values craftsmanship, documentation, and service mindset. 

 Manage team capacity and resource allocation across roadmap initiatives, customer commitments, and support obligations. 

 Domain Strategy & Roadmap 

 Translate board-level strategic direction into a coherent domain roadmap and execution plan. 

 Own the domain investment portfolio within approved parameters; make principled trade-offs between new capability, reliability, and technical debt reduction. 

 Lead annual planning processes including headcount, budget, and OKR input to department leadership. 

 Track and report on domain health, customer outcomes, and team delivery through defined KPIs; surface risks and recommendations to board leadership. 

 Cross-Domain Coordination 

 Contributes domain expertise to cross-domain initiatives when assigned. Maintains clear, documented ownership boundaries with adjacent domains — notably the rules engine (evaluation and processing), Safety (collision reconstruction and post-collision workflows), and Geospatial (zones). 

 Collaborate with product domain leads to align core workflow capabilities with product roadmaps and delivery timelines. 

 Participate in department planning forums as a subject-matter authority for MyGeotab core workflows; represent domain constraints and opportunities clearly to board leadership. 

 Board Relationship & Accountability 

 Own and execute the domain strategy within board-set direction. 

 Make investment cases to the board for resourcing, headcount, and capability investment. 

 Operate under structured board coaching with increasing autonomy. 

 Geotab First Mindset 

 Champions a Geotab First approach to leadership by putting the success of the broader organization ahead of siloed or individual domain wins. 

 Beyond leading their own domain, actively fosters collaboration, builds consensus, and works effectively across diverse internal and external teams. 

 Seeks out different perspectives before decisions are made, shares credit and information openly, and treats other domains' priorities as shared priorities. 

 Drives collective success through strong interpersonal relationships, shared goals, and a willingness to flex personal or domain agendas in service of the company's broader objectives. 

 What you'll bring to the role: 

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

 Equivalent combination of education and work experience in a related field may be substituted. 

 5+ years of relevant industry experience. 

 5+ years of experience in SaaS or web product engineering or product management, ideally on configuration-heavy, multi-tenant products. 

 3+ years in technical leadership roles. 

 3+ years of leadership experience. 

 1+ years leading a cross-functional team of product managers, designers, and engineers. 

 Deep technical and product expertise in configuration-heavy, multi-tenant B2B SaaS workflows; experience with event, alerting, and multi-channel notification systems (delivery, templating, rate limiting). 

 Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed or shared-services organizational model. 

 Strong product sense and UX judgment — able to make complex configuration (rules, groups, notifications) powerful for large fleets yet simple for small ones. 

 Strong systems thinking — ability to anticipate how platform decisions ripple across multiple consuming teams. 

 Proficient in defining and tracking SLOs, customer-facing product metrics, and reliability indicators. 

 Ability to shape and evangelize a vision for core workflows across consuming domains — communicating intended use patterns, constraints, and trade-offs of reusable capability so solution and segment teams adopt it correctly.

 Experience operating in evolving organizational structures with ambiguity and shifting priorities.

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Hi, Future Homie! 
 At Homebase, you’ll join a team that’s bold, fast-moving, and obsessed with helping small businesses thrive. We build with empathy, act with urgency, and take big swings that drive real-world impact. Here, every Homie shows up to raise the bar, support one another, and celebrate wins as a team.
 We’re not just building an app—we’re building unstoppable teams. So what do you say, are you in?

  📍Your Impact Starts Here 
 As our Director of Product Marketing, you will own how Homebase wins small business owners. That means the story we tell, how we price and package, which industries we go after, and what sales and support say on every call. Homebase has grown from a suite of tools for hourly teams into AI that takes care of an owner's least favorite work for them. More than 150,000 businesses already run on it. Most owners who would love Homebase have never heard of us, and your work decides how fast that changes.
 You will report to our CMO, lead our Product Marketing team, and work daily with Growth, Creative, Product, Sales, and Support. Every campaign, landing page, sales script, and support conversation starts from what your team learns and builds.
 This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll write the first draft of the narrative yourself and run the team with AI built into its work.
 These are the key ways you’ll contribute and create impact in this role: 
 The Homebase story 
 Own the company narrative and the testing system behind it. New messages go into market with frequent testing and are judged on conversion.

 Make sure Growth, Creative, Sales, Support, Product, and PR tell one story with the outcome owners care about up front and our product as the proof.

 Pricing and packaging 
 Own how we price and package Homebase so an owner understands it in seconds, and it grows revenue per customer.

 Ship pricing and packaging changes, and measure each one on conversion and revenue.

 Industry go-to-market 
 Use data to choose the industries we go after first, then run a cross-functional pod to execute vertical growth campaigns.

 Build the kit every channel runs on, including owner insights, competitor maps, ad and landing page messaging, creator briefs, and Sales and Support scripts.

 Sales, support, and customer growth 
 Give Sales and Support the scripts, plays, bundles, and offers they use on every call, and refresh them regularly from what reps hear and why deals are lost.

 Products and customer insight 
 Partner with Product so Team App, Payroll, Cash Out, and Hiring are positioned to win with the story carried through sign-up, trial, and an owner's first 30 days.

 Build a customer insight engine with regular owner conversations, a panel you can hear from in days, and a running read on the market.

 Team leadership 
 Decide how the team is organized and what it works on each quarter, and say no to work that doesn't move revenue.

 Grow the people on your team into bigger roles, and run the team on the same weekly cadence as Growth with AI built into research, briefs, testing, and analysis.

 What success looks like 
 In your first 90 days, you've talked with dozens of owners and our new narrative and first industry kits are running in market. Your team has a clear plan for the next two quarters.

 By month 6, you know within two weeks which message is winning, and industry campaigns are beating general ones. Your first pricing and packaging changes are live and measured.

 By month 12, Sales and Support run your plays on their calls, and revenue per customer is growing. Growth and Creative start new campaigns from your team's story and owner insight.

 🚀 The Foundation for Success - These are the experiences and strengths that will set you up for success in this role:
 8+ years in Product Marketing or go-to-market roles. You have led a team of Product Marketers and grown people into bigger roles.

 You have built a company narrative from customer insight and got a leadership team with strong views behind it. You can show what it did to growth once it shipped.

 You have owned pricing and packaging decisions with real data behind them and a measurable result on revenue or conversion.

 You have worked side by side with growth teams in a self-serve or high-velocity business and judged messaging on conversion.

 You have built industry or segment go-to-market programs that marketing and sales actually ran.

 You use AI in your own work every day and can show how you check what it produces.

 Bonus points if you have: Experience marketing to small businesses or hourly teams, a background in HR, payroll, or fintech software, and pricing work in freemium-to-paid models.

 This role is probably not for you if 
 Your best work is brand campaigns, launch plans, or positioning that lives in slides.

 Your playbook comes from enterprise, sales-led businesses with long deal cycles. Most of our owners buy on their own, and we judge messaging by whether they convert.

 You need months of research before anything ships. We test in weeks and learn in market.

 You prefer to direct from a distance. We need a leader who still writes the first version of the story.

 🤝  The Homie Way - These principles guide everything we do—from how we work and make decisions to how we show up for each other.
 💡 Be Customer Obsessed – Solve problems with empathy and creativity.

 ⚡ Move Fast, Learn Fast – Experiment, take action, and grow every day.

 🎯 Own Your Impact – Think big, focus on what matters, and make decisions you stand behind.

 🏆 Master Your Craft – Excellence fuels impact—show up, step up, and make your mark.

 🏅 Win Together – Put goals over roles, lead with trust, and connect to our mission and each other.

 What We Offer (United States) 
 💰 Ownership & Financial Security: Stock options + 401(k) with 4% match

 🏥 Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage + FSA options

 ⏰ Flexible Time: Unlimited PTO (salaried) + company holidays

 🤖 AI access, for real: We invest in builders and believe that curiosity shouldn't have a paywall. That means you'll have access to paid AI tools with minimal restrictions, so you can build, experiment, and level up your craft.

 👶 Family Support: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave (after 6 months of service)

 🛡️ Protection Plans: Life insurance + short/long-term disability coverage

 🌟 Work Your Way: Work From Anywhere Month + meeting-free weeks yearly

 🍽️ Workspace Perks: Meals provided, commuter benefits, team offsites, and Customer Days

 💼 Our Hybrid Rhythm: We believe collaboration drives impact. That’s why Tuesdays and Wednesdays are our required in-office days —a time to move faster as a team, build deeper connections, make better decisions, and build together.

 What We Offer (Canada)

jobs.description:
Why you’ll love working here: 
 high-performance, people-focused culture

 our commitment that equity, diversity, and inclusion are fundamental to our work environment and business success, which helps employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves

 Job Summary 

 This fast-paced role is ideal for someone who thrives on identifying and remediating operational risk challenges with a focus on the investment environment. Reporting to the Senior Director, the Associate Director will help evolve HOOPP's Operational Risk Management (ORM) and Enterprise Crisis and Continuity (ECC) programs by promoting a strong risk culture and partnering with business areas across the organization to identify and mitigate key operational risks.

 The role will support both programs. For Operational Risk, the Associate Director will support the execution and enhancement of HOOPP's ORM programs including vendor risk management, operational risk event reporting, key risk indicators and industry event surveillance. This role will also work directly with front office trading teams to review end-to-end processes and surface risks, inefficiencies and control gaps. For ECC, this role will lead the execution and ongoing management of HOOPP's Enterprise Crisis Management and Business Continuity programs, including plan development and testing and response management during actual disruptions.

 We are looking for someone who brings an exceptional command of AI and applies it through a strategic lens—identifying high-value opportunities, translating emerging capabilities into practical business solutions, and guiding responsible AI adoption to improve decision-making, efficiency, innovation, and long-term organizational value.

 What you will do: 

 For designated divisions, support the Operational Risk Management (ORM) and Enterprise Crisis and Continuity programs.

 Operational Risk: 
 Investment Management: Partner with front office trading teams to review end-to-end processes, identify operational risks, inefficiencies, control gaps and opportunities for improvement.
 Develop a strong understanding of trading activities, products and workflows to ensure recommendations reflect business needs and market realities.

 Leverage existing risk management processes and capabilities, as well as industry knowledge to support the implementation, enhancement, ongoing maintenance, and execution of HOOPP’s ORM program and underlying processes, including but not limited to: Vendor Risk Management
 Operational Risk Event reporting
 Key Risk Indicators
 Industry Event surveillance and reporting

 Provide analytical and operational support to the maintenance and execution of HOOPP’s operational risk event reporting process, and the undertaking of associated procedures, including ongoing monitoring of the program for continued relevance and effectiveness.
 Support business partners in their implementation of ORM program components within their respective divisions and provide appropriate oversight to govern the effectiveness of the implementation.
 Support the ongoing development and evolution of an Operational Risk Dashboard that will showcase the results of the key operational risk metrics.
 Support on-demand advisory requests and opportunities, which can include special projects, deep dive analysis and investigations.

 Enterprise Crisis and Continuity: 
 Oversee the development, enhancement, maintenance, and testing of business continuity plans.
 Facilitate business impact analyses (BIAs), dependency mapping, and risk assessments in collaboration with divisions and IT partners.
 Support enterprise response, recovery, and restoration activities during actual crisis or disruption events.
 Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Crisis Management program and support the implementation and awareness for leaders, plan owners, and staff.
 Provide advisory support to business units on crisis preparedness, continuity planning, and resilience best practices.

 Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Information Technology: 
 Identify opportunities to use technology, automation and AI to improve efficiency, decision-making and control effectiveness.
 Support the design, testing and implementation of tools that reduce manual activity, improve data quality and enhance the user experience.
 Develop and leverage AI to automate manual processes, which can include ongoing monitoring activities, data extraction and report generation.

 Job Summary 

 he Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan (HOOPP) is a defined benefit pension plan serving members and employers in Ontario's healthcare sector. The Pension Services division supports the delivery of HOOPP's pension promise through accurate and reliable service to members and employers.
 Reporting to the Director, Actuarial Solutions, the Associate Director provides technical leadership to ensure the accuracy and integrity of pension calculations and pension-related data across HOOPP's administration system, member-facing solutions, and off-system tools.

 The Associate Director is a senior resource for pension calculations, pension data, system functionality, testing, defect management, and modernization of calculation capabilities. The role helps ensure that on- and off-system solutions using pension data or calculations are accurate, well controlled, and aligned with HOOPP's administration practices and member service objectives. The Associate Director works with various teams to translate plan provisions, legislation, policy, and administration practices into practical solutions through requirements, testing, implementation, and operational controls.

 What You Will Do 

 1. Calculation Accuracy and Technical Leadership
 Provide leadership to ensure the accuracy of pension calculations and member-facing pension information across HOOPP’s administration system, digital services, and off-system tools.

 Act as a senior subject matter expert for complex pension calculations and pension administration concepts, including escalated, precedent-setting, and high-risk cases.

 Identify inconsistencies among plan provisions, policy, administration practices, system logic, member communications, and calculation tools, and lead their resolution or escalation.

 Advise senior leaders on calculation risks, member impacts, and recommended courses of action while balancing calculation integrity, efficiency, and member experience.

 Promote consistent, explainable, and sustainable calculation logic across member-facing solutions.

 2. Cross-Functional Delivery and Strategic Initiatives
 Act as the actuarial lead for cross-functional initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, influencing project direction, identifying risks and dependencies, and helping ensure solutions involving pension calculations or pension data are delivered successfully.

 Ensure calculation- and data-related considerations are incorporated early in discovery, design, requirements, delivery, testing, and implementation.

 Assess proposed solutions for calculation accuracy, appropriate use of data, alignment with plan provisions, and member impact.

 Lead or support implementation of plan, legislative, policy, or administration-practice changes affecting calculations or pension data.

 Build effective relationships and influence decisions without direct authority, including challenging proposals where calculation integrity may be at risk.

 3. Calculation Requirements, Tools, and Modernization
 Lead the development of calculation requirements, implementation planning, testing strategies, and business readiness activities for calculation engine capabilities and other calculation solutions.

 Establish standards for and develop calculation requirements, including business intent, formulas, data inputs, dependencies, exception handling, auditability, and outputs.

 Ensure requirements are complete, maintainable, and sufficiently detailed for business analysts, developers, and end-users.

 Identify and lead opportunities to automate exception processing and recurring activities while maintaining appropriate controls and human oversight.

 Set standards for calculation tools and other off-system solutions, including testing, approval, version control, access, monitoring, and change management.

 4. Release Delivery, Testing, and Calculation Quality
 Lead the Actuarial Solutions team’s work on calculation-related changes to HOOPP’s pension administration system, from early design and requirements through to testing, implementation, and production monitoring.

 Set and execute testing approaches, ensuring they cover regression testing, complex cases, and data storage.

 Assess release readiness and ensure identified defects and required controls are documented and escalated.

 Coordinate and participate in production validations of calculation functionality, rate tables, and calculation controls after a release is deployed.

 Lead the review and resolution of calculation defects and production incidents, including impacted-member analysis, interim controls, correction methods, and validation of fixes.

 Act as the point of contact for external vendors and stakeholders as it relates to discussions involving calculations or pension data storage. Lead discussions and find resolutions that prioritize calculation and data accuracy in HOOPP’s pension administration system.

 Lead audits of HOOPP’s pension administration system and related tools to ensure consistent quality.

 5. Pension Data and Calculation Controls
 Provide oversight for the interpretation and appropriate use of pension administration data in calculations, member-facing solutions, and internal processes.

 Ensure the correct data fields and transformations are used where the results could affect pension amounts or related information shown to members, employers, or internal staff.

 Define data requirements for initiatives involving pension calculations, reporting, or the presentation of pension information.

 Partner with Pension Technology, Product & Delivery Management, Member & Employer Services, and other Pension Services teams to ensure pension data is used consistently and accurately across solutions.

 Recommend new pension data health checks, calculation controls, or monitoring activities where issues are identified.

 Recommend updates to existing pension data health checks based on changing needs.

 Assess and communicate risks arising from pension data quality issues or control gaps.

 What You Will Bring 

 University degree in actuarial science

 An ASA or ACIA designation is required; progress towards FCIA designation is preferred

 Ten or more years of progressively responsible experience in pensions consulting, actuarial work, pension administration, pension systems, or a related field.

 Several years of experience leading complex technical initiatives, establishing standards, making or recommending high-impact technical decisions, and influencing cross-functional project delivery.

 Deep knowledge of defined benefit pension administration, pension calculations, applicable legislation, plan provisions, and administrative policy.

 Demonstrated ability to interpret complex pension provisions and translate them into clear calculation requirements and business rules.

 Experience leading calculation-related system implementations, testing strategies, and defect resolution

 Ability to understand, review, and challenge complex system calculations, Excel-based calculation tools, and other off-system calculations.

 Strong judgment and decision-making ability where errors could affect member benefits, financial outcomes, regulatory compliance, or member experience.

jobs.title: Chief Scientist - Physical AI

Huawei Canada has an immediate permanent opening for a Chief Scientist. 

 About the team: 
 Founded in 2012, the Noah’s Ark lab has evolved into a prominent research organization with notable achievements in academia and industry. The lab’s mission focuses on advancing artificial intelligence and related fields to benefit the company and society. Driven by impactful, long-term projects, the aim is to enhance state-of-the-art research while integrating innovations into the company's products and services, including LLMs, RL, NLP, computer vision, AI theory, and Autonomous driving.

 Work at the forefront of Embodied AI and Spatial AI, collaborating with researchers and engineers to solve real-world challenges and bridge cutting-edge research with scalable deployment. 

 Develop state-of-the-art approaches in Physical AI, including robotic foundation models, world models, multimodal representation learning, reasoning and planning, as well as imitation and reinforcement learning with integrated low-level control.

 Design and execute experiments across both simulation and real-world robotic platforms, covering data collection, evaluation, and performance analysis. 

 Drive closed-loop learning by integrating data, models, and real-world feedback to continuously improve system robustness and adaptability. 

 Collaborate cross-functionally across research, infrastructure, and robotics systems to ensure end-to-end system coherence and scalability. 

 Contribute to and lead high-impact research outputs, including patents and publications in top-tier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, and ICRA.

jobs.description:
Location: US or Canada
 Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor

 **A note before you read further** 

 The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

 About Human Agency 

 We’re scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

 We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don’t insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

 Our clients’ missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

 Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

 We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are at and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 This is not a traditional chief of staff role. At Human Agency, the chief of staff is the prototype for every person we hire. You're someone who wants to be running a company — a dynamic C-suite leader — but you're choosing to ride shotgun alongside an executive because you know it's the fastest path to getting there. What makes us different is that we actually give you that shot. Today. Not in three years.

 You are floor to ceiling. You will take out the trash, sweep the floors, and then walk into the board meeting and run it. Nothing is beneath you. There is no ceiling above you. You are a garbage disposal for problems — every food scrap, every random piece of metal gets thrown your way, and you figure out how to handle it without breaking.

 What You'll Do 

 Rather than being hired for a predetermined set of tasks, you will be brought on to solve complex, evolving challenges. Success in this role requires self-direction, proactive value creation, and the ability to thrive without constant oversight. Over the coming year, your responsibilities will be tailored to both organizational needs and your individual strengths, potentially including:

 Leading AI transformation projects with clients

 Leading fundraising efforts for funds or clients

 Managing investment funds

 Managing CEOs at client organizations

 Driving sales initiatives at Human Agency

 Partnering closely with recruiting to help grow our team

 Serving as CEO of a venture studio company

 Managing client project delivery

 Driving value through data and analytics for clients

 Leading go-to-market initiatives for clients

 Own and solve ambiguous, high-stakes problems that don't fit neatly into any department

 Manage yourself entirely — no hand-holding, no coaching, no check-ins about how your day is going

 Move between strategic work (board prep, investor materials, business development) and ground-level execution (scheduling, research, client fires) without blinking

 Deploy AI tools daily to amplify your output — you are not doing the work of one person, you are doing the work of five

 Identify opportunities, inefficiencies, and threats before anyone asks you to

 What We're Looking For 

 A fundamentally good human. Table stakes.

 Mission-driven operator with deep commitment to Human Agency's values and vision

 No ego. No job description. You do whatever the job requires.

 Self-managing problem solver — the last thing a CEO or Founder wants is someone they have to manage

 AI-first mindset — you use AI as a force multiplier across everything you touch

 Builder mentality — you've shipped something. Attach proof of something you've built with AI to either your application or cover letter. 

 Generalist with range — you don't need to be an expert in any one thing, but you need to be dangerous across many things

 Experience & Skills 

 5-7+ years in high-performing environments such as management consulting, venture capital/private equity, business development, or startup leadership positions

 Demonstrated success in taking ambiguous, complex initiatives and driving them to completion, you're the person who makes hard things happen

 Outstanding written and verbal communication; you can synthesize complex information into clear, actionable briefs for different audiences

 Bonus: Experience in high-growth startups, venture studios, or AI/tech companies

 Considerations 

 Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; top-tier programs and/or an advanced degree in a relevant field is a plus

 Ethics:  Commitment to ethical practices and responsible business operations

 Travel:  Occasional (10–25%) for company offsites, key events, and leadership meetings

 Location:  Remote-friendly with preference for candidates in major tech hubs and strong preference for overlap with EST business hours

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse backgrounds and strive to build an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and empowered.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff for our Managing Director of AI—someone who combines strategic vision in AI with hands-on execution and technological know-how. You'll be both a force-multiplier and a transformation architect: designing AI-enabled processes, building automated engines that run independently, leading organizational rollouts, and ensuring crisp execution across our AI solutions practice.

 This role goes beyond traditional Chief of Staff responsibilities. You'll design processes that leverage AI, build repeatable systems that scale, and lead entire client transformations from discovery to sustained adoption. You have the potential to grow into leading organizational-level AI implementations as the practice expands.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Strategic & Executive Leadership 

 Partner with the Managing Director of AI and the executive team to translate priorities into sequenced plans, resourcing, and measurable outcomes

 Lead Human Agency's AI transformation methodology: define offerings, build repeatable frameworks, and establish best practices for AI-enabled workflows

 Design end-to-end processes that embed AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms, knowledge assistants) into client workflows and internal operations

 Translate complex AI capabilities into clear business cases, use cases, and implementation roadmaps for executive audiences

 Produce high-quality executive materials (briefings, roadmaps, decision memos) that drive alignment and decisions

 Identify where AI creates leverage across client engagements and surface strategic opportunities to leadership

 AI Process Design & Automated Engines 

 Design and build AI-powered systems that operate independently with minimal ongoing intervention—automated engines that scale beyond individual engagements

 Create repeatable processes for AI implementation: discovery frameworks, solution architectures, evaluation routines, and governance models

 Design prompts, playbooks, and knowledge bases optimized for reliability, consistency, and reusability across multiple clients

 Implement lightweight automation using no/low-code tools (Zapier, Make, Airtable) integrated with AI capabilities

 Establish monitoring and feedback loops that enable self-correcting, continuously improving systems

 Document patterns and best practices that can be deployed at scale

 Client Service Delivery & Organizational Rollouts 

 Own end-to-end delivery on multiple client engagements involving AI-enabled solutions (e.g., knowledge assistants, workflow automations, content summarization, research copilots), from discovery through launch and sustained adoption

 Lead company-wide and client-wide AI adoption initiatives—managing stakeholder alignment, training, governance, and measurement across entire organizations

 Run comprehensive discovery to surface use cases, success metrics, risks, change-management needs, and technical requirements; translate findings into scopes, timelines, and clear acceptance criteria

 Coordinate solution build-outs with internal teammates and external partners: data/connectivity needs, tool selection, integration planning, prompt engineering, and rollout choreography

 Design change-management approaches that address skill gaps, cultural resistance, workflow disruption, and organizational readiness

 Partner with client leadership to sequence rollout phases, manage dependencies, and demonstrate ROI

 Quality, Governance & Evaluation 

 Set lightweight evaluation routines: accuracy metrics, latency benchmarks, cost tracking, quality assurance processes, and continuous improvement cycles

 Establish prompt/playbook management, basic safety/guardrail checks, and UAT plans

 Build governance frameworks that enable responsible, scalable AI adoption across organizations

 Implement monitoring systems that track performance, usage, and business impact

 Stakeholder Management & Enablement 

 Lead standing client check-ins, executive presentations, demo readiness, decision logs, and release notes, presenting succinct options and recommendations

 Create comprehensive enablement materials: user guides, FAQs, training programs, and governance playbooks that empower client teams to operate AI systems independently

 Build lasting client relationships through proactive communication, anticipation of needs, and consistent delivery quality

 Present to executive audiences with clarity and confidence, addressing concerns about accuracy, security, and adoption

 Operations & Project Management 

 Design and continuously improve the operating system for AI work: intake → triage → prioritization → delivery → QA → launch → measurement

 Manage staffing assignments and subcontractor contributions across concurrent workstreams; keep tools current (Asana/Notion, Google Workspace, Slack)

 Budget & scope control: track time against SOWs, flag changes early, manage vendors, and ensure on-budget delivery with clear documentation

 Establish shared dashboards for delivery health (timeline, risk, burn, dependency status) and run tight meeting cadences

 Communications & Reporting 

 Prepare agendas, briefings, and executive-ready presentations; synthesize complex information into actionable insights

 Provide clear, timely reporting to the Managing Director of AI and stakeholders on progress, risks, and decisions

 Contribute to Human Agency's AI thought leadership through documentation of best practices, case studies, and insights

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5-7+ years in operations, client services, product/program/project management, strategic support, consulting, or transformation roles with direct ownership of client-facing delivery

 Demonstrated success leading multi-stakeholder projects and organizational change initiatives end-to-end (scope, timelines, budgets, risk, and change management)

 Deep AI fluency: hands-on experience implementing LLM-enabled solutions, prompt engineering, workflow automation, and knowledge management systems; can shape prompts/playbooks, evaluate quality, and choose appropriate tools or vendors

 Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, when to use AI, how to design for reliability, and how to manage risks responsibly

 Proven ability to design repeatable processes and systems that scale beyond individual projects

 Experience with no/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier/n8n), knowledge bases, and modern AI tooling

 High proficiency with Google Workspace, Asana/Notion, Slack, and comfort with modern web and content tools; experience preparing polished executive documents and presentations

 Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for non-technical audiences

 Bonus: Experience leading organizational-level technology rollouts, background in management consulting, familiarity with responsible AI considerations (privacy, data handling, consent, bias mitigation), or experience in AI/ML product development

 Mindset & Traits 

 Builder and operator: You design systems that work without constant oversight, not just execute tasks

 Strategic and tactical: Comfortable setting vision while rolling up sleeves for hands-on implementation

 AI pragmatist: Excited about possibilities but grounded in what actually delivers measurable value

 Mission-driven; systems thinker with bias for action

 Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence executive stakeholders and earn trust through delivery

 Calm under pressure with excellent judgment about when to escalate vs. solve independently

 Able to hold strategic context while driving tactical execution across multiple concurrent engagements

 Intellectually curious with strong learning agility, you stay current on AI capabilities and translate findings into practical applications

 Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists

 Considerations 

 Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; an advanced degree in business, technology, or a related field is a plus

 Ethics: Commitment to ethical practices and responsible AI (transparency, human oversight, privacy, bias mitigation)

 Travel: Regular (20–40%) for client activities, organizational rollouts, and events

 Location: Remote-friendly with preference for candidates in major tech hubs

 Compensation 

 This role offers a competitive base salary with performance-based bonuses and potential equity participation. Final compensation will vary based on experience, performance, and location.

 Why Join Human Agency 

 Join a team of thinkers and builders creating meaningful impact across sectors—with autonomy to lead, the resources to succeed, and room to grow. This role offers the opportunity to shape how organizations integrate AI at scale, with clear pathways to increased leadership responsibility as our practice expands.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse backgrounds and strive to build an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and empowered.

 Who You Are

 Experience & Skills

 You have an established, high-quality network of owners, founders, family office principals, PE partners, or C-suite executives at large enterprises. Your rolodex opens doors that most people spend years trying to access.

 You graduated from an elite MBA program — Harvard Business School, Stanford GSB, Wharton, Booth, Kellogg, or equivalent — and you've built on that foundation with real-world credibility and relationships.

 You have 10+ years of experience operating at senior levels in consulting, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or enterprise sales — environments where trust, reputation, and relationship capital matter more than product demos.

 You have a track record of opening and closing high-stakes relationships. You know how to navigate complex organizations, multi-stakeholder decision processes, and long sales cycles without losing momentum.

 You are comfortable in any room. You can hold a conversation with a third-generation family business owner, a PE Managing Director, and a Fortune 500 CEO — and you know how to adjust your approach without losing authenticity.

 Mindset & Traits

 You have integrity and seriousness. You are not coasting on your pedigree or your last name. You are building something, and you want this role to be the proof of what you are capable of.

 You see this as your opportunity, not a stepping stone. You are here to build the revenue engine for a company that is going to matter, and you want to be the person who made that happen.

 You are entrepreneurial and resourceful. You do not wait for a playbook. You figure out what works, you test it, you refine it, and you scale it.

 You have sales instinct. You may not describe yourself as the world's best closer, but you know how to move a conversation forward, read a room, and create the conditions for a yes.

 You operate with clarity and discipline. You manage your time, your pipeline, and your relationships like an investor manages a portfolio — with rigor, intentionality, and a long-term view.

 You care about the work, not just the deal. You want to sell something that matters, to people who will use it to build something great. You believe in what Human Agency is doing, and that belief shows up in every conversation.

 Compensation & Logistics

 This is a remote role based in the United States or Canada. You will work closely with leadership and collaborate across time zones as needed.

 This is a full-time role with significant upside and equity participation for the right person.

 Occasional travel required for client meetings, conferences, and company offsites.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.title: Director, AI Transformation
jobs.description:
Location: Remote
 Type: Full-Time Employee for US Candidates; Independent Contractor for Canadian Applicants

 **A note before you read further** 

 The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

 About Human Agency 

 We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

 We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

 Our clients' missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

 Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

 We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it, and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we create about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 Most AI consultants are good at one of two things: writing the strategy or doing the work. We need someone who refuses to separate the two. This role exists because our clients don't just need a roadmap - they need someone who will build the road, navigate the detours, and still show up to the steering committee with a clear-eyed point of view on where they're headed next.

 You'll lead AI transformation engagements end-to-end, from diagnosing what's broken and what's possible to rolling up your sleeves and building the thing alongside the client's team. That might mean designing an AI-enabled workflow on Monday, pressure-testing a product decision with a C-suite on Wednesday, and shipping a working prototype by Friday. The client doesn't see the seams. You own the outcome.

 This is the right role if you've spent years inside Big Four firms, strategy boutiques, or early-stage companies and found yourself frustrated by the gap between advice and execution. You know what good looks like, you've seen what happens when no one stays accountable for making it real, and you're done handing off decks to someone else's team. You want the whole thing - the strategy, the build, the proof.

 What You'll Own 

 Client Engagement Leadership — Run AI transformation projects from discovery through delivery, serving as the primary client relationship owner and the person ultimately accountable for outcomes.

 Strategy and Execution, Both — Develop transformation roadmaps grounded in a client's actual constraints, then stay in the work long enough to see them implemented, not handed off.

 0-to-1 Product Building — Identify high-value AI use cases, prototype solutions, and shepherd them from concept to something clients can actually use, often building hands-on alongside the client's internal team.

 Executive-Level Communication — Translate complex AI concepts, technical constraints, and strategic tradeoffs into crisp, confident communication for boards, C-suites, and frontline operators alike.

 Go-to-Market and Growth Support — Contribute to business development, help scope new engagements, and actively deepen relationships with existing clients as their needs evolve.

 AI Tool Deployment — Apply AI tools aggressively across your own workflow and your clients', not as a demo, but as a working standard for how fast and how well this work can get done.

 Internal Contribution — As a senior member of a flat, growing team, you'll help shape how Human Agency delivers, what we learn, and who we become.

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5–8+ years of experience in management consulting, venture-backed startups, product strategy, or a combination, with direct ownership over outcomes, not just deliverables.

 Demonstrated track record of taking AI from concept to working reality in an organizational context — not just advising on AI strategy, but building or deploying something that worked.

 Fluency with the AI tooling landscape — foundation models, workflow automation, prompt engineering, and the judgment to know when to build versus buy versus recommend against.

 Proven ability to lead client relationships at the senior level, including navigating organizational politics, managing ambiguity, and keeping complex engagements on track without a safety net.

 Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp executive brief, run a working session with a skeptical VP, and explain a technical architecture decision to a non-technical founder, often in the same day.

 Experience in 0-to-1 product building — you've shipped something, taken something from nothing to real, and you can speak concretely about how you did it.

 Bonus: Background in venture studios, high-growth AI or tech companies, or operator roles at the intersection of strategy and product.

 Mindset & Traits 

 You're a builder first. Decks are useful; working things are better. You default toward making something real.

 You manage yourself completely. No one will check on your progress, remind you of a deadline, or coach you through a hard week. You are the accountability structure.

 You have no patience for the gap between strategy and execution and have spent your career closing it.

 You're curious about AI in a way that shows up in your actual work — you experiment, you break things, you have opinions formed by firsthand experience, not secondhand summaries.

 You can hold the big picture and the small detail simultaneously, and you know when to zoom in and when to zoom out without being told.

 You do what the work requires. Not what's in scope, not what's comfortable, not what's in your lane.

 Logistics 

 Location: Remote-first; US and Canada eligible. 

 Travel: Occasional travel required for client engagements, company offsites, and key strategic meetings.

 Application Note: Attach proof of something you've built with AI — a product, a workflow, a tool, a result. If you don't have something to show, this is not the right role.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can do their best work.

 The opportunity 

 Human Agency is hiring a Head of Business Development to lead commercial strategy, pipeline, and growth for our AI solutions. This senior, hands-on role will own go-to-market planning, direct sales of services and product offerings, commercial deal design, and the development of a repeatable business development function. The role combines heavy early execution with the responsibility to build systems that scale sales and improve efficiency over time.

 What you will own 

 Lead GTM and pipeline strategy for AI solutions: target segments, messaging, channels, and repeatable sales plays.

 Own direct sales of services and productized solutions: source leads, qualify opportunities, close deals, and ensure clean handoffs to delivery.

 Design commercial and billing models: craft pricing, commission structures, contracts, and terms that align incentives across Human Agency and portfolio engagements.

 Build BD systems and operations: CRM hygiene, funnel definitions, forecasting, playbooks, compensation plans, dashboards, and SLAs.

 Recruit and develop BD talent: hire sellers and account leads, define ramp plans and performance metrics, and create training and career paths.

 Partner with product, design, and delivery teams: translate customer insights into product improvements and ensure commercial motions map to product-market fit.

 Run experiments and commercial diligence: test GTM approaches, validate revenue models for studio investments, and iterate quickly based on market feedback.

 Be accountable for revenue outcomes: set targets, manage forecasts, and report performance to senior leadership.

 First-year signature deliverables 

 Documented go-to-market plan for core AI offerings.

 Standardized commercial model and term framework for studio engagements and services contracts.

 Predictable pipeline and a functioning BD operating cadence (forecasting, reporting, conversion metrics).

 Initial BD hires and a documented hiring and compensation plan.

 First commercial wins: service contracts and at least one monetized studio engagement.

 A dashboard tying BD activity to revenue and unit economics.

 Success metrics 

 Pipeline coverage and month-over-month pipeline growth.

 New services revenue and ARR attributable to BD activities.

 Funnel conversion rates (lead → qualified → opportunity → closed).

 Gross margin and unit economics on studio engagements.

 Time-to-first-revenue for studio investments.

 Speed and quality of hiring and ramp for BD staff.

 Qualifications 

 Required 

 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales or business development leadership, with experience selling services and complex solutions.

 Proven record of building pipeline and closing deals across multi-stakeholder buying processes.

 Experience designing commercial models, commission schemes, and billing structures.

 Demonstrated ability to build BD systems: CRM, playbooks, compensation, and dashboards.

 Strong negotiation skills and experience structuring creative commercial arrangements.

 Ability to partner with product and delivery teams to align GTM to product-market fit.

 Preferred 

 Experience selling into complex buyer ecosystems (enterprise, multi-site operators, or similar).

 Experience in a venture studio, incubator, or professional services model that blends services and equity.

 Prior experience hiring and scaling early-stage sales teams.

 Mindset and traits 

 Tactical closer who can design scalable strategy.

 Comfortable with heavy early execution and rapid iteration, while building systems to reduce long-term grind.

 High tolerance for ambiguity and a bias for action.

 Strong judgment, humility, and collaborative leadership.

 Commercially rigorous and data-driven.

 Reporting & team 

 Reports to: Partners; direct partnership with the Founder and Managing Director of AI Solutions.

 Compensation & logistics 

 Senior leader compensation with base salary, performance bonuses, commission, and equity participation.

 Remote-friendly (U.S. / Canada). Occasional travel for client meetings, portfolio company engagements, and offsites.

 Why join 

 Lead the commercial engine for Human Agency’s AI practice. You will build systems and a team, own revenue outcomes, and directly influence product and investment decisions that scale real business impact.

 Equal opportunity 

 Human Agency is an equal opportunity employer committed to building inclusive teams.
