jobs.description:
About Kindsight: 
 Kindsight builds technology that helps fundraisers make a difference. For decades, Kindsight has supported the education, healthcare, and nonprofit sectors with fundraising tools and the largest charitable giving database on the market. And as the giving sector evolves, so does Kindsight. As the leader in fundraising intelligence, Kindsight leverages real-time data and AI to help thousands of organizations around the world identify, manage, and engage with donors - at any scale. With purpose-built CRMs that corral all of that donor information and campaign tracking into one place, donor prospect research tools that offer proactive insights and real-time donor intel, and generative AI that creates personalized, meaningful content drafts at scale, Kindsight’s product suite is truly changing the game for donor fundraising. 
 Position Summary: 
 We are seeking a strategic technology executive with extensive experience leading enterprise technology, cybersecurity, and compliance within a growing SaaS business. This leader will enable the business through modern, secure, and scalable technology while accelerating Kindsight's transformation into an AI-native company. Working closely with the CTO, you will lead the enterprise technology strategy that enables the business while complementing the company's product and engineering strategy. You will hire, lead, and develop a high-performing Enterprise Technology organization spanning IT, cybersecurity, and compliance. You will be responsible for ensuring budget discipline while optimizing technology investments and operating costs. In addition to enterprise technology responsibilities, this role will ensure the business operates within legal, regulatory, and ethical boundaries—especially around data, privacy, and global software regulations.
 What You’ll Do: 
 AI Strategy 
 Lead the development and execution of Kindsight’s internal enterprise AI adoption strategy, partnering with executive leadership to improve productivity, automate business processes, and deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes..

 Translate strategy into a clear technology roadmap across infrastructure, systems, and enterprise applications, supporting an AI-native operating model and a scalable, cost-effective SaaS environment.

 Lead enterprise technology transformation initiatives, including Lead-to-Cash, business systems modernization, business intelligence, and AI enablement, with accountability for execution, organizational adoption, and measurable business outcomes..

 Lead technology due diligence and integration for acquisitions, strategic partnerships, and other corporate initiatives.

 IT Operations and Business Systems 
 Own Kindsight’s enterprise technology ecosystem: business systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS), infrastructure, networks, collaboration platforms, and enterprise data architecture.

 Oversee day-to-day IT operations and end-user services, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability, with strong service management practices including SLAs and incident management.

 Security and Risk 
 Own Kindsight’s enterprise information security program, establishing and maintaining appropriate security policies, controls, monitoring, and risk mitigation practices across corporate technology environments.

 Identify and manage technology risks, including vulnerabilities, third-party exposure, and operational risk.

 Oversee incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.

 Compliance and Privacy 
 Lead Kindsight’s information security and technology compliance programs, establishing governance, policies, controls, and audit readiness aligned with applicable regulatory requirements and recognized frameworks, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

 Establish governance for AI usage, third-party technology risk, and enterprise data management.

 Drive audit readiness, coordinate internal and external audits, and serve as the key contact for auditors, regulators, and enterprise customers.

 Oversee data privacy practices and monitor regulatory developments affecting SaaS and CRM platforms.

 Partnership and Culture 
 Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success to establish consistent security and compliance standards, support customer security assessments, and ensure appropriate governance across enterprise and customer-facing technology. Provide clear, concise updates to executive leadership on risk, security posture, and compliance status.

 People and Budget 
 Hire, lead, and develop IT and compliance teams, including directors and managers, with clear accountability, performance expectations, and succession planning.

 Manage the IT and compliance budget and oversee vendor selection, contracts, and performance, ensuring technology investments deliver business value.

 Build a culture of security, compliance, and responsible data use, including employee training programs.

 What We’re Looking For: 
 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in enterprise technology, cybersecurity, or IT operations, including significant executive-level responsibility within a complex SaaS or technology organization.

 In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST), compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.), and data protection.

 Proven executive leadership of enterprise-wide business transformation initiatives, serving as the accountable executive responsible for strategy, governance, planning, execution, and organizational adoption.

 Demonstrated experience developing and executing enterprise transformation roadmaps, including program governance, milestones, dependencies, and executive reporting.

 Proven experience creating and leading enterprise-wide communication and change management strategies that keep employees, leaders, and stakeholders informed and aligned throughout transformational initiatives.

 Track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives across Technology, Product, Finance, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success while driving organizational alignment and measurable business outcomes.

 Demonstrated experience managing enterprise technology budgets, optimizing vendor expenditures, and allocating resources to deliver measurable business value.

 Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), and scalable infrastructure management.

 Strategic Vision: Ability to align technology roadmap with business objectives to enhance competitive advantage.

 Demonstrated experience deploying AI technologies to improve productivity, automate business processes, and drive measurable business outcomes across enterprise functions.

 Leadership: Exceptional team leadership, mentoring, and talent development skills, with experience managing remote or distributed teams.

 Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and the Board of Directors.

 Vendor Management: Strong negotiation skills for managing relationships with strategic technology partners and vendors.

 Experience leading enterprise technology within a high-growth SaaS organization, preferably in a private equity-backed environment.

 Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or IT, Cybersecurity or Information Systems and MBA or equivalent is an asset.

 What Success Looks Like 
 Accelerate responsible AI adoption across Kindsight's business functions, delivering measurable improvements in productivity and operational efficiency.

 Maintain a secure, highly available enterprise technology environment.

 Strengthen the company's security and compliance posture.

 Optimize technology investments while improving employee productivity.

 Build and develop a high-performing enterprise technology organization.

 What’s in it for you? 
 Compensation Range: $300,000-$350,000 CAD/USD OTE annually, based on experience, market benchmarks and role complexity. We aim to offer fair, competitive pay that reflects your skills and the market. 

 Time to unplug: Vacation, flex days, volunteer time and a team-wide year-end wellness shutdown.

 Whole-person health: Comprehensive health and dental, 24/7 virtual doctor visits and flexible wellness stipends.

 Flexibility first: Digital-first remote setup with built-in “work from anywhere” travel flexibility.

 Investment in you: Departmental professional development budgets and company-matched retirement savings.

 A team that celebrates: Paid parental leave, peer recognition rewards and company-wide celebrations.

We hire based on skills, potential, and impact, and we believe our differences fuel innovation. jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! 

 Job Description 
 Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

 Job Description 
 As Head of Business Systems Product & Transformation for Fiix, Rockwell Automation's cloud-based maintenance management (CMMS) and asset management software business, you will own the systems and processes that run our software business from lead to cash to renewal.

 Your first and most important priority is to perform: stabilize and run the business systems that support Fiix today. You will reduce a significant backlog, bring clear ownership and priorities, strengthen platform reliability and deliver at high velocity for Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Support.

 Once the foundation is stable, you will lead the transformation: working with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation program to define the future-state operating model for the Fiix business (how our processes, systems and teams work across the Rockwell Automation organization) and to deliver coordinated outcomes across the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub.

 You will lead a team of Lead Product Managers across three areas – Go-to-Market & Salesforce CRM, Product & Integration (including FactoryTalk Hub), and Revenue & Support Operations – and partner closely with a dedicated PMO and a business systems engineering team to turn strategy into delivered results.

 What Fiix Business Systems Does 
 Our business systems connect how Fiix markets, sells, quotes, provisions, bills and supports its customers. The platform spans Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ), revenue and billing systems, middleware and integrations, product provisioning, and marketing and customer success tools. Today these systems are dedicated to Fiix. As Rockwell Automation's enterprise systems and software portfolio evolve, including FactoryTalk Hub, this role will help determine how Fiix systems and processes should work alongside them.

 Your Responsibilities 
 Perform: Stabilize & Execute
 Stabilize the Fiix business systems in the first 6–12 months: triage and reduce the backlog, fix the highest-impact issues and restore confidence with business stakeholders.
 Establish clear ownership, service levels and measures of success for core systems and processes (e.g., backlog age, quote-to-cash cycle time, system reliability, data quality).
 Partner with the PMO on a single intake process, prioritization, capacity planning, budget and status reporting.
 Partner with the business systems engineering lead on release planning, platform stability and delivery quality.
 Run a regular operating rhythm: weekly prioritization, regular delivery cycles and monthly roadmap reviews with business stakeholders.
 Reduce backlog and operational friction through clear ownership, process simplification and automation.
 Keep near-term delivery aligned with the enterprise direction so today's work does not create rework later.

 Strategy & Roadmap
 Own the end-to-end vision, multi-quarter roadmap and architecture principles across nine domains: go-to-market, Salesforce enterprise architecture, product provisioning, middleware and integration, case management and support, finance systems (FinTech), marketing technology, customer technology and data.
 Set priorities across the three product areas, balancing business value, risk, cost and engineering capacity.
 Translate company and business-unit goals into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes (e.g., quote-to-cash cycle time, forecast accuracy, data quality, backlog age, system adoption).
 Establish architectural standards and governance for changes that cross systems and teams.

 Leadership & Team Development
 Lead, coach and develop Lead Product Managers; set clear decision rights, priorities and performance expectations.
 Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
 Recruit for open roles and strengthen capability through talent development and succession planning.

 Cross-Functional Partnership
 Be a trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Support, Product and IT leaders.
 Balance stakeholder priorities and facilitate cross-functional governance and communication.
 Coordinate with Product Engineering and IT on product provisioning, integrations, identity and access.
 Keep management, peers and team members informed on priorities, progress and risks. Transform: Future-State Operating Model
 As the business stabilizes, lead the shift to transformation in partnership with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team.
 Serve as the Fiix business systems lead with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team, representing Fiix requirements in future-state design, release planning and roadmap decisions.
 Develop a multi-year strategy that evaluates, process by process, the right future-state approach for Fiix (keeping Fiix-specific systems, connecting with Rockwell Automation enterprise systems, or adopting shared capabilities as they become ready), with clear decision points, sequencing and risks.

About EliseAI

 Requirements

A Little Bit About Us 
 Founded in Vancouver in 2016, FORM is the sports technology company behind the award-winning FORM Smart Swim Goggles. Since launching in 2019, our goggles have earned global recognition, including Red Dot, iF Design, and Global Triathlon awards, and are trusted by professional athletes, age-group triathletes, and swimmers looking to get better.
 We’re a talented, tight-knit team that’s fun to work with and serious about building great products. Together, we bring decades of consumer product experience spanning sports eyewear, interface design, and activity-tracking algorithms.
 To learn more, visit formswim.com

 The Opportunity 
Reporting to the CEO, you’ll own FORM’s finance function end to end. You’ll start by learning how our accounting function runs today, then partner with the team to strengthen controls and streamline processes as we grow. From there, you’ll lean into financial modelling and become a strategic partner to the executive team.
 You’ll work directly alongside the CEO, with access to our fractional CFO for mentorship. You’ll have real ownership over how FORM plans, reports, and grows, and the support to step up as the role expands. This role requires a hands-on leader who likes being close to the numbers.

 What You’ll Own 
 Lead a two-person accounting team, managing our Senior Accountant and supporting the development of the Accountant on their team
 Work with the team to put scalable internal controls in place for accurate, reliable financial statements
 Own cash and cashflow planning across short- and long-term horizons
 Partner with the executive team to build annual budgets, forecasts, and department-specific KPI reporting
 Build financial models and scenario plans to support strategic decisions and fundraising
 Support the CEO on investor materials and Board and shareholder reporting
 Manage tax, audit, legal, and banking partners, and keep FORM compliant across jurisdictions

 What Great Looks Like 
 Reliable reporting generated in hours, not days
 A controls environment the executive team trusts
 Budgets and KPI reports that department leads use to run their teams
 AI embedded in our finance workflows, so the team spends less time on manual tasks and more on insights

 The Landscape 
 Inventory across multi-warehouse global operations 
 Multiple entities (Canada and US) and multiple currencies 
 Startup financing, including SAFEs, convertible notes, and equity and debt rounds

 How We Work 
 Daring - Greatness lies just outside our comfort zone. You bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to try something new.
 Focused - We’re not afraid of throwing out great ideas to execute the right one. You know which numbers matter most and keep the team pointed at them.
 Human - Work as a team, work for one another, listen to our members. You make finance approachable and explain the numbers so every FORMie can act on them.
 Learn Fast, Act Fast - Improve through trial, testing and action. You move with urgency, learn from each cycle, and keep improving how finance works.

jobs.title: Director of Ecommerce Growth
jobs.description:
At Hadley Designs, we believe early learning should be joyful, screen-free, and filled with connection.
 Founded by Becca Hadley, a former teacher and mom who began creating hand-drawn learning tools at her kitchen table, we’ve grown into a leading early childhood education brand trusted by millions of parents, grandparents, and teachers. Our products are developmentally sound, emotionally engaging, and intentionally designed to help children ages 3–8 grow curious, confident, and resilient.
 We serve busy, intentional families who are tired of screens and want more meaningful ways to teach and connect with their kids. From educational posters to busy books, handwriting guides to emotional learning kits, every product is crafted with care and rooted in research.
 Our vision is bold: to become the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, and passed down for generations, while reaching $100 million in annual revenue by 2030.
 Today, Hadley Designs is an approximately $25 million ecommerce brand selling across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, and other channels. We've built a strong foundation, an established customer base, and a talented team of specialists. Now, our next chapter is about building a repeatable, profitable growth engine that can take us from $25 million to $100 million and beyond.
 We're looking for an entrepreneurial Director of Ecommerce Growth who has helped scale ecommerce brands before and knows how to turn growth opportunities into measurable business results. Someone who can see the bigger picture, connect the dots across channels, align talented teams, and determine where to invest, what to scale, and what to stop.
 This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of our growth strategy, build systems that consistently generate profitable demand, and help shape the next stage of Hadley Designs.

 Role Overview 
 The Director of Ecommerce Growth is responsible for building and leading Hadley Designs' next phase of profitable growth, developing a repeatable demand generation engine that can scale our business from $25 million to $100 million and beyond.
 This is a hands-on growth leadership role that combines strategic thinking, financial accountability, and cross-functional execution. We're looking for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, understands the economics of scaling an ecommerce brand, and knows how to turn promising opportunities into profitable, repeatable growth systems.
 We've built a talented team of specialists across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, paid media, creative, and affiliate marketing. The Director of Ecommerce Growth connects the dots between these functions, aligning priorities, coordinating execution, removing bottlenecks, and ensuring our investments translate into measurable business results.
 This person doesn't need to be the best specialist in every channel, but they must know how to lead specialists, challenge assumptions, diagnose performance, and make the entire growth engine more effective. They take ownership of growth initiatives from strategy through execution, without relying on the CEO to drive every decision.
 The role is channel agnostic. We don't care whether our next major growth opportunity comes from Meta advertising, Amazon external traffic, Shopify, TikTok Shop, creator partnerships, AI-powered content, or an entirely new channel. What matters is identifying where the greatest opportunities exist, validating them through disciplined experimentation, and allocating resources toward what produces profitable, incremental growth.
 Equally important is knowing what not to pursue. The Director of Ecommerce Growth must be willing to challenge existing strategies, stop underperforming initiatives, and redirect resources toward higher potential opportunities.
 The vision: Build a diversified, scalable, and profitable growth engine that consistently generates new customer demand, turns successful experiments into repeatable systems, and operates without requiring the CEO's daily involvement, ultimately helping Hadley Designs become a $100 million brand by 2030.

Metrics that You'll Own 
 Incremental Contribution Profit: Generate at least $1,000,000 in annual incremental contribution profit from growth initiatives, after all attributable variable marketing and program costs.
 Incremental Demand Generation Revenue: Generate at least $7,000,000 in annual incremental revenue through paid media, affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, and new acquisition channels, regardless of whether customers purchase through Amazon, Shopify, or TikTok Shop.
 Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER): Achieve a minimum 3.0x blended MER across the defined growth portfolio, while meeting contribution profit targets. Final target subject to validated channel economics.
 Growth Experiments: Execute at least 1 meaningful growth experiments per month (12 annually), each with a documented hypothesis, an approved budget, contribution profit target, performance review, and predefined stop criteria.
 Scalable Growth Engines: From the list of 12 growth experiments, at least 3 new experiments are repeatable, profitable growth engines annually, each generating at least $25,000 in incremental monthly revenue with positive contribution profit for three consecutive months.

 Primary Objectives 20% BIG ROCKS – These must be done first and at all costs.
 Build a Repeatable, Profitable Demand Generation Engine: Develop and scale sustainable sources of customer acquisition and revenue across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, paid media, affiliates, and emerging channels, prioritizing incremental contribution profit over revenue alone.
 Integrate and Lead Cross-Functional Growth Execution: Align existing specialists across creative, paid media, ecommerce, affiliates, and analytics around shared priorities. Own execution plans, remove bottlenecks, and ensure growth initiatives deliver measurable results without requiring the CEO's daily involvement.
 Own Growth Strategy and Marketing Investment Efficiency: Evaluate marketing performance using contribution margin, MER, acquisition costs, and incremental revenue. Determine where to allocate resources, what to double down on, and what to reduce or stop to maximize profitable growth.
 Build a Disciplined Growth Experimentation System: Identify new growth opportunities, launch at least 1 measurable experiment monthly, and systematically evaluate results. Turn winning experiments into repeatable, scalable growth systems while quickly discontinuing underperforming initiatives.
 Optimize Affiliate, Influencer, and Cross-Channel Demand Generation: Develop a profitable creator and affiliate strategy that connects TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and paid media. Ensure winning creator content, partnerships, and emerging AI opportunities are integrated into the broader growth strategy rather than operating as isolated programs.

 Regular Work Activities 80% – These must be done ongoing daily/weekly after the BIG ROCKS are complete. 
 GROWTH STRATEGY & PERFORMANCE 
 Monitor growth performance across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, paid media, affiliates, and emerging acquisition channels.
 Identify opportunities to increase profitable revenue through improved customer acquisition, conversion rates, offers, retention, and demand generation.
 Evaluate competitive strategies, emerging marketing trends, AI technologies, and new acquisition channels to identify opportunities worth testing.
 Maintain a prioritized pipeline of growth opportunities based on potential financial impact, resources required, and probability of success.
 Challenge existing strategies and recommend where to increase investment, improve execution, or discontinue underperforming initiatives.
 MARKETING ECONOMICS & CAPITAL ALLOCATION 
 Own the performance of the growth investment portfolio, including budgets, incremental revenue, marketing costs, and contribution profit.
 Review marketing efficiency ratio (MER), customer acquisition costs, conversion rates, and contribution margins across relevant channels.
 Work with Finance and Analytics to validate attribution, incremental performance, and profitability.
 Allocate approved marketing and experimentation budgets toward the highest potential growth opportunities.
 Identify inefficient spending and make timely decisions to scale, optimize, or stop initiatives.
 Ensure marketing investments are evaluated based on actual business outcomes rather than attributed revenue or platform ROAS alone.
 CROSS-FUNCTIONAL GROWTH LEADERSHIP 
 Coordinate growth initiatives across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, paid media, creative, affiliates, and analytics.
 Establish clear priorities, responsibilities, deadlines, and measurable outcomes for cross-functional growth projects.
 Lead weekly growth meetings focused on performance, bottlenecks, opportunities, and decisions.
 Ensure creative strategies, offers, customer acquisition campaigns, and product launches are aligned across relevant channels.
 Remove execution bottlenecks and hold initiative owners accountable for delivering results.
 Connect insights and winning strategies between teams so successful ideas can be tested and scaled across channels.
 GROWTH EXPERIMENTATION & EXECUTION 
 Launch and oversee at least 1 meaningful growth experiment monthly, each with a documented hypothesis, budget, owner, and success criteria.
 Coordinate experiment execution through existing specialists, internal teams, and external partners.
 Review results and distinguish meaningful performance improvements from temporary fluctuations or attribution noise.
 Document learnings and make clear decisions to scale, improve, continue testing, or stop each initiative.
 Turn successful experiments into repeatable growth systems with clear ownership and operating procedures.
 Maintain a centralized growth experiment tracker and prioritized testing roadmap.
 AFFILIATE, INFLUENCER & CREATOR GROWTH 
 Oversee the strategy and profitability of the affiliate and influencer program across TikTok Shop, Amazon, and Shopify.
 Evaluate creator acquisition, activation, retention, commissions, samples, incentives, and program economics.
 Direct the affiliate operations team to improve creator productivity and program profitability.
 Identify opportunities to develop high-value creator partnerships and expand creator driven demand generation.
 Ensure winning creator content is systematically shared with paid media teams and tested across appropriate channels.
 Integrate affiliate marketing, creator content, and AI influencer strategies into the broader growth engine.
 AGENCY, PARTNER & TEAM MANAGEMENT 
 Evaluate, select, and manage external marketing agencies, technology providers, and strategic growth partners.
 Establish clear performance expectations, financial targets, and accountability for outside partners.
 Lead growth initiatives through existing channel specialists without creating unnecessary management layers.
 Identify talent gaps and recommend additional resources when supported by clear financial opportunities.
 Develop systems and team capabilities that reduce dependence on the CEO for daily growth decisions.
 SYSTEMS, ANALYTICS & AI 
 Work with Analytics to maintain reliable marketing performance dashboards and growth scorecards.
 Ensure marketing and financial data is accurate, actionable, and consistently measured across channels.
 Use AI and automation to accelerate market research, competitive analysis, creative testing, reporting, and growth execution.
 Identify repetitive growth workflows that can be automated or delegated.
 Maintain documentation, SOPs, and historical experiment results so successful strategies can be repeated and improved.
 REPORTING & ACCOUNTABILITY 
 Weekly Growth Scorecard: Revenue, incremental contribution profit, MER, marketing spend, active experiments, emerging winners, underperforming initiatives, and recommended actions.
 Weekly Growth Meeting: Review performance with relevant specialists, resolve bottlenecks, assign priorities, and make decisions without requiring the CEO to lead the discussion.
 Monthly Growth Investment Review: Evaluate the growth portfolio, recommend budget reallocations, and identify opportunities to scale or discontinue.
 Quarterly Growth Strategy: Present the next quarter's growth priorities, investment recommendations, financial targets, and resource requirements.

jobs.title: Director, Computational DMPK (Drug Metabolism & Pharmacokinetics)
jobs.description:
Deep Origin is a biotechnology company building an operating system for science that transforms how life science research is conducted. Our AI-powered platforms simulate biology, streamline R&D workflows, and enable scientists to model complex biological systems at scale. 
 Deep Origin leads the PREDICTS consortium, funded by ARPA-H under the CATALYST program, to build in silico models that predict human drug safety and toxicity. As part of this work we are scaling our capabilities in whole-human modeling and predictive toxicology. 

About the role
 Deep Origin is building VHAT, the Virtual Human Avatars of Toxicology. VHAT takes a molecule, a dose and a patient population and predicts organ-level human toxicity before a compound is synthesized or dosed. Metabolism sits at the heart of that chain. What a drug becomes, which enzymes act on it and how fast they act determine what each organ is exposed to, and every predicted metabolite is screened for its own off-target and organ liabilities. The Metabolism group builds four connected models: drug-metabolizing enzyme, site of metabolism, metabolite structure, and enzyme kinetics. As the group’s leader, you will own those models, mentor the team that builds them, and drive integration of their predicted parameters into the physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) model that governs exposure across the VHAT.

 Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

jobs.title: Senior Director, People Operations
jobs.description:
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr
 Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating
 access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.
 We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr
 impact.

 LET’S START WITH OUR VALUES
 Excellent. Being excellent at what we do sets us apart. It happens when we care about our work and how it lands, set clear standards, and hold each other accountable. We don't stop at meeting the standard; we keep raising the bar.
 Authentic. Real connection happens when we show up as our best, truest selves, help others dothe same, and stand by each other through the harder times.
 Curious. Curiosity keeps us innovative. Better understanding comes from asking helpful questions, seeking to understand before we act, and building on each other's thinking.
 Dynamic. Growth is central to our purpose, and it only happens in dynamic environments where we stay flexible, adaptable and open.
 Empathetic. Great partnerships happen when we take the time to understand the people we work with, our teams, our clients and our communities, for better outcomes for each.

 WHAT IS YOUR ROLE
 As Senior Director, People Operations, you are the operational and governance backbone of Boldr's People function. You own the systems, rewards, and standards that let a five-country division run with consistency and care.
 Three connected disciplines roll up to you across the Philippines, South Africa, Mexico, Canada, and the United States:
 People Operations and Systems: the employee lifecycle, our HRIS (Rippling), people data, service delivery, and self-service.
 Total Rewards: compensation and benefits, Living Wage governance, pay equity, and job banding.
 Business Partnering: ER cases and investigations, multi-country labor law compliance, risk and audit, and the policies and handbooks that keep us fair and consistent.

 This is a role for a builder and an operator. The longer-range strategic agenda, organizational design, performance strategy, and strategic business partnering, sits with the VP and grows alongside our People Success team. Your mandate is to make the backbone genuinely excellent: scalable processes that do not rely on heroics, clean and trustworthy data, sound compliance across every jurisdiction, and a team member experience that reflects our values wherever people work.
 You report to the VP, People, and you are one of the leaders the rest of the division depends on to keep the engine running as we scale.

 WHY DO WE WANT YOU
 We are looking for an impact-driven operator who can give a fast-growing, five-country division the backbone it needs to scale without breaking. Someone who builds systems that last, holds a high bar on compliance and fairness, and still keeps the human center in every process they design.
 You will protect organizational health, bring calm and consistency to sensitive moments, and make the everyday experience of working at Boldr feel reliable and fair in every country we operate in. We do all of this so our team members can thrive as we grow.

 WHAT WILL YOU DO
 People Operations and Systems
 Own the employee lifecycle end-to-end: onboarding, changes, and offboarding, delivered consistently across all five countries.
 Lead Rippling as our HRIS and system of record; design and maintain clean workflows, self-service, and service delivery (ticketing and knowledge base).
 Establish data integrity and reporting discipline: headcount, attrition, and the people data leaders rely on to decide well.
 Partner closely with Payroll to protect accuracy and timeliness in every jurisdiction.
 Modernize People infrastructure through automation and sound system design, so support scales without manual workarounds.

 Total Rewards
 Own compensation and benefits governance across all geographies, anchored to our Living Wage philosophy as the pay floor.
 Direct compensation cycles with rigor and clarity: timelines, manager enablement, auditability, and clear communication.
 Oversee job banding and pay structures using our market data source (Payfactors), keeping pay equitable and defensible.
 Steward pay equity and transparency norms that build trust while managing risk appropriately.

 Employee Relations
 Oversee sensitive ER cases, investigations, grievances, and disciplinary matters through the Business Partnering team, and personally lead the most complex cases, with consistency, fairness, and empathy.
 Build the ER frameworks and manager guidance that keep outcomes fair and well-documented across countries.
 Serve as a trusted, high-integrity escalation point on difficult people matters.

 Compliance, Risk, and Governance
 Ensure compliance across all five countries and both operating models: Managed Outsourcing and Global Employment (EoR).
 Own records, audit, and data protection for People data.
 Translate local labor realities into sound, consistent decisions, flag clearly where in-country counsel is needed, and engage and consult with counsel on these matters.
 Build the governance and risk frameworks that let us scale responsibly.

 Policy Development and Maintenance
 Own the development, maintenance, and governance of People policies and employee handbooks.
 Keep policy current with changing labor law in each jurisdiction, and consistent with our values and B Corp commitments.
 Make policy clear, accessible, and genuinely useful to managers and team members, not just technically compliant.

 Team Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership
 Lead and develop the People Operations, Total Rewards, and Business Partnering teams; set clear goals, coach for growth, and build a culture of service excellence.
 Own the budget for People Operations, Total Rewards, and Business Partnering, including people, systems, and vendor costs, and ensure it meets company requirements.
 Establish clarity on decision rights, service levels, and escalation paths, so it is clear how People decisions get made here.
 Partner with the VP, the Talent Acquisition and People Success pillars, Business Operations, Finance, and client-facing teams to keep the backbone aligned to the business and company strategy.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering (Canada)
jobs.description:
At Flosum, we are building the world's best software for the modern enterprise. Our team is passionate about crafting elegant, high-performance products that delight our customers and set a new bar for engineering excellence. We combine deep expertise in cloud-native development with a relentless focus on quality, speed, and innovation. Every line of code we ship is built to scale, built to last, and built to make a real difference for the businesses that rely on us.
 We are a company where technologists lead, ideas win on merit, and shipping great software fast is a core value—not a slogan. If you believe world-class engineering teams are the ones that move quickly and build things right, you'll feel at home here.
 About the Role
 We are hiring a Director of Software Development to lead a team of 10 engineers building and scaling our Node.js and Salesforce-integrated products. This is a hands-on leadership role for a technical architect at heart who can compress delivery schedules, drive developer velocity, and own the performance of the overall solution. You will be the single point of accountability for turning our roadmap into shipped software—on time, at quality, and at scale.
 What You'll Own
 Lead, coach, and grow a team of 10 full-stack developers across Node.js services and Salesforce customizations.
 Drive measurable improvements in developer velocity using DORA metrics: lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and MTTR.
 Compress delivery schedules by breaking epics into small, independently shippable slices and challenging inflated estimates with data.
 Architect end-to-end solutions spanning Node.js microservices, APIs, event-driven patterns, and Salesforce (Apex, Lightning, integrations).
 Own solution performance: latency, throughput, scalability, and cost—set SLOs and hold the team accountable to them.
 Establish estimation, sprint, and release discipline; remove blockers; enforce accountability without burning the team out.
 Partner with Product, QA, and Infrastructure to align roadmap, capacity, and dependencies.
 Recruit, onboard, and performance-manage engineers; build a culture of ownership and speed.

jobs.title: Director of Business Development - Agriculture and Industrial
jobs.description:
About Auto Electric Service
 With over 80 years serving Saskatchewan, Auto Electric Service Ltd. (AES) is a locally owned wholesale distribution company serving the automotive, agriculture, industrial, heavy-duty, and retail markets.
 Since 1943, we have built our reputation on strong customer relationships, extensive product availability, industry expertise, and dependable service. As we continue to grow, we are looking for an experienced business development leader to help build and lead our Agriculture & Industrial market segment.
 The Opportunity
 We are looking for a Director of Business Development – Agriculture & Industrial who understands the Saskatchewan market, knows the needs of agriculture and industrial customers, and has the experience to turn opportunities into long-term business.
 This is a hands-on growth role with the opportunity to help build a business segment from the ground up. You will identify where AES can win, develop new customer relationships, secure strategic accounts, help determine the products and solutions our customers need, and develop a practical strategy for sustainable and profitable growth.
 Initially, you will be heavily involved in direct business development and account acquisition. As the Agriculture & Industrial segment grows, you will help recruit, coach, and lead a team of Client Solutions Partners to support continued expansion.
 What You'll Do
 Identify and develop new business opportunities within Saskatchewan's agriculture and industrial markets.
 Build relationships with owners, procurement teams, maintenance leaders, operations leaders, and other key decision-makers.
 Lead strategic opportunities from initial discovery and proposal through negotiation, implementation, and repeat business.
 Develop and execute plans to grow strategic accounts and expand AES's share of customer business.
 Gather customer and market insight to identify product gaps, new product opportunities, and changing customer needs.
 Work closely with Purchasing, Assortment Optimization, Operations, Logistics, Marketing, and branch teams to support new products and customer programs.
 Help develop pricing, territory coverage, sales campaigns, account acquisition strategies, and go-to-market plans.
 Negotiate pricing, freight, payment terms, and service expectations while maintaining a strong understanding of profitability and cost to serve.
 Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline, forecasts, account plans, and customer information within our CRM.
 Track segment performance, identify opportunities or challenges, and take action to achieve sales and profitability goals.
 Recruit, coach, and develop Client Solutions Partners as the Agriculture & Industrial segment grows.
 Provide field coaching, account support, pipeline reviews, and clear performance expectations for the sales team.
 Represent AES professionally with customers, suppliers, and industry partners throughout Saskatchewan.

jobs.title: Director
jobs.description:
Role Synopsis: 
 The Director is responsible for leading the creative vision and execution of an animated production from script development through final animatic delivery and into animation production. Working closely with the Line Producer, Production team, Creative Leadership, clients, and partner studios, the Director ensures the project achieves its creative objectives while remaining aligned with production schedules, scope, and technical requirements.
 This role provides creative leadership across story, performance, staging, pacing, and visual storytelling, while fostering strong collaboration between internal teams and external production partners. The Director identifies creative opportunities, provides timely feedback and solutions, and helps balance artistic ambition with production realities to successfully deliver high-quality content.

 Project Responsibilities 
  Work with LP and Production to ensure on-time completion from approved scripts through shipment of final Animatics to our animation partner studio.
 Collaborate with LP and Production Team to ensure scope, schedule and assumptions are on track, flagging any concerns as soon as they arise and coming up with solutions/compromises to effectively manage the given scope, assumptions and production limitations.
 Collaborate with internal designers to ensure it aligns with scope and flagging any concerns for asset creation with our animation partners.
 Lead creative kickoffs and Collaborate with internal storyboard team to ensure storytelling pieces are communicated clearly and offer creative solutions for productivity issues. You will also be responsible for providing revisions, when required based on client feedback up until the animatic is locked.
 Identify ways to add fresh, creative ideas that compliment the overall creative vision
 Strong collaboration with LP and Production to ensure aligned messaging to internal editing team and animation partners.
 Lead creative kickoffs and collaborate with the client to ensure storytelling pieces are communicated clearly and offering creative solutions to producibility issues as well as compliment the overall creative vision.
 Provide director notes for lead sheets for the purposes of layout and shot production kickoffs with partnering studios to ensure storyboards have been properly executed before transitioning into animation shot production. 
 Make best efforts to be available for and participate in all meetings including (but not limited to): dailies, production meetings, creative meetings, review sessions and weekly touch points with Management and or department heads, etc.
 Availability to work in-studio on a consistent weekly basis, alongside work-from-home days.Working in-studio on a consistent and regular basis to promote a culture of collaboration
 Cultivate strong communication and care with both the internal team and partners aligned with Kickstart’s core values
 This list of Services is not exhaustive and will include any other responsibilities that are deemed standard to the industry for this project and those associated with the Company.
 And such other duties as Kickstart may assign from time to time

 Studio Responsibilities:
 Interact respectfully and professionally with colleagues, other staff members, partners, and clients.
 Work collaboratively across multiple productions and departments as required.
 Foster and mentor the development of up and coming Lead and Supervisor roles from time to time
 Act as a Studio representative by aiding Talent Management to attract and network with new artists.
 Contribute to a positive team environment aligned with Kickstart’s Core Values.
