jobs.title: Account Director (Performance Marketing Agency)
jobs.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version. 
 Cette offre d’emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française. 
 ________________________________
 Remote - U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time 
 Compensation: 
 $80K - $130K USD (U.S.-based candidates)
 $80K - $130K CAD (Canada-based candidates)
 We’re Not Looking for Generic Account Leadership. We’re Looking for a Performance Marketing Leader. 
 Level Agency is hiring an Account Director with deep performance marketing agency experience — someone who knows how to lead client relationships, connect strategy to execution, and drive measurable business outcomes.
 You may be a current Account Director at a performance marketing agency. Or, you may have started hands-on in paid media, analytics, or campaign management before moving into account leadership. Either way, you understand what great performance marketing looks like because you’ve worked close enough to the work to know what actually moves results.
 You can speak credibly about Google Ads. You understand how media, SEO, creative, data, CRM, websites, CRO, and reporting all connect. You know how to spot issues before they become client escalations. And you’re confident enough to lead a room without making it about your title.
 You’re especially strong when the path to conversion is complex — where lead quality, pipeline, sales alignment, landing pages, and conversion journeys matter as much as media efficiency.
 This is not a “status call and recap email” role. This is for someone who can connect client business goals to marketing strategy, push back with purpose, and lead a focused book of accounts with depth — rather than spreading their attention across a high-volume roster with limited depth.
 This Isn’t for Everyone. 
 We’re building something rare: a place where growth, truth, and high performance go hand-in-hand.
 You’ll thrive here if: 
 ✅ You’ve led client relationships in a performance marketing agency environment.
✅ You understand how modern marketing channels work together — media, SEO, creative, data, CRM, website, CRO, and analytics.
✅ You can speak credibly about Google Ads and paid media strategy.
✅ You care about client business results, not just campaign metrics.
✅ You can lead a focused book of clients deeply, not manage a huge roster shallowly.
✅ Your default is “I’ll handle it,” even when the work sits slightly outside your lane.
 And you’ll struggle here if: 
 ❌ Your experience is primarily brand, creative, ecommerce, or DTC without deeper performance agency experience.
❌ You’ve only managed accounts at the surface level across a very large client load.
❌ You need a narrow job description to know what you should own.
❌ You protect scope before you protect the outcome.
❌ You can’t speak credibly about channel strategy beyond talking points.
 About Level
 We’re an AI-powered performance marketing agency — built for precision, designed to scale, and powered by a scientific mindset. At Level, we blend strategy, media, creative, and machine intelligence to deliver outcomes that matter. Every time. At scale.
 We’ve been named one of Pittsburgh’s Best Places to Work and an Inc. 500 Fastest-Growing Company. Our clients span B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, and more.
 Your Role (and Impact)
 As an Account Director, you’ll lead performance-driven client relationships across a focused book of accounts. You’ll sit at the intersection of client strategy, marketing execution, internal team leadership, and business impact.
 You’ll be the person clients trust to tell them the truth, the person internal teams count on to create clarity, and the person who keeps strategy tied to measurable outcomes.
 You’ll:
 Lead Performance Strategy: Translate client business goals into multi-channel marketing strategies that drive measurable growth.
 Own Client Relationships: Build trust with senior stakeholders through clear communication, proactive thinking, and sharp strategic recommendations.
 Connect the Marketing Ecosystem: Help clients understand how paid media, SEO, creative, data, CRM, websites, CRO, and reporting work together to improve performance.
 Bring Paid Media Fluency: Speak credibly about Google Ads, paid social, and media performance — even when you’re not the person making every in-platform change.
 Spot Issues Early: Dig into performance trends, ask better questions, and catch problems before they become client escalations.
 Push Back with Purpose: Challenge client assumptions when needed — always in service of the performance goal, never ego, scope protection, or control.
 Manage a Deep Book: Lead a focused portfolio of accounts with enough depth to truly understand each client’s business, performance drivers, and risks.
 Guide Internal Teams: Partner with media, SEO, creative, analytics, and strategy teams to keep work moving, priorities clear, and outcomes aligned.
 Tell the Story in the Data: Turn reporting, dashboards, and performance analysis into insights clients can act on.
 Own the Details: Keep budgets, forecasts, timelines, documentation, and communication sharp and accurate.
 Requirements
 Must-Haves
 5+ years in a performance marketing agency. You have agency experience rooted in performance, paid media, and measurable outcomes — not primarily brand, creative, or ecommerce-only work.
 Account leadership experience in a performance environment. You are either currently an Account Director at a performance marketing agency or you started in marketing, paid media, analytics, or campaign management before transitioning into account leadership.
 Google Ads fluency is required. You can speak credibly about Google Ads and understand what to investigate when performance shifts, lead volume drops, or conversion quality changes.
 Modern marketing ecosystem understanding. You understand how paid media, SEO, creative, data, CRM, websites, CRO, and analytics connect to drive outcomes.
 Paid media strategy depth. You understand how media channels work together, especially search and social, and can translate performance signals into strategy.
 Client leadership experience. You’ve managed client relationships, led strategic conversations, and presented recommendations to senior stakeholders.
 Focused account management experience. You’re used to leading a meaningful book of clients deeply — roughly 3 to 8 accounts — rather than spreading your attention across a high-volume roster with limited depth.
 Experience with meaningful media spend. You’ve worked with clients spending at least $50K/month in media per client; $100K+/month is strongly preferred.
 Business-first mindset. You talk about revenue, pipeline, lead quality, conversion paths, customer journeys, and business outcomes — not just CTRs, CPCs, and platform metrics.
 Low ego, high ownership. You’re willing to build the dashboard, chase the answer, clean up the ambiguity, or step into the gap when the team needs it.
 Strong Preferences
 B2B, lead generation, or complex-sale experience. Experience with longer buying cycles, pipeline quality, sales alignment, or non-DTC conversion paths is a major plus.
 Meta, LinkedIn, SEO, CRM, CRO, or other channel fluency. You don’t need to be an expert in every channel, but you should understand how they work together.
 Experience in financial services, healthcare, education, SaaS, or other considered-purchase verticals.
 Comfort with dashboards, reporting tools, Google Analytics, and data visualization.
 Experience mentoring account team members or coordinating cross-functional delivery teams.
 AI Expectations
 At Level, AI is a skillset — not a shortcut. In this role, you’ll be expected to:
 Use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, and Perplexity to improve how you work
 Share your prompts, process improvements, and ideas with the team
 Experiment regularly and refine your workflows over time
 Embrace discomfort as part of the learning process
 Apply AI tools to increase your speed, clarity, and creativity — not to replace thoughtful work
 AI should make you sharper, faster, and more strategic. It should never replace judgment, taste, accountability, or a strong point of view.
 Our Core Values
 No Ego, All In 
We don’t do “that’s not my job.” We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart.
 Better Every Day 
We want the feedback — even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar.
 Relentless for Results 
Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward.
 Driven by Truth 
We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear — not just what is easy to say.
 Perks & Benefits
 At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.
 Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
 Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
 Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
 Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
 Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities
 Remote First
 This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents and is fully remote. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.
 Level Is Built on Inclusion
 We are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer — we celebrate what makes you, you.
 Ready to Apply?
 Click below to submit your resume. You’ll also answer a few thoughtful questions, so take your time.
 We care more about how you think, how you lead, and how you create impact than whether your path has been perfectly linear.
 Let’s build something together.

 Télétravail – États-Unis et Canada seulement | Temps plein 
 Rémunération: 
 80 000 $ à 130 000 $ US pour les personnes candidates basées aux États-Unis
 80 000 $ à 130 000 $ CA pour les personnes candidates basées au Canada
 Nous ne cherchons pas un leadership de comptes générique. Nous cherchons un leader en marketing de performance.
 Level Agency recrute un ou une Account Director possédant une solide expérience en agence de marketing de performance — une personne capable de diriger les relations clients, de relier la stratégie à l’exécution et de générer des résultats d’affaires mesurables.
 Vous êtes peut-être actuellement Account Director dans une agence de marketing de performance. Ou encore, vous avez commencé les mains dans le cambouis en médias payants, en analytique ou en gestion de campagnes avant de passer au leadership de comptes. Dans tous les cas, vous comprenez à quoi ressemble un excellent marketing de performance, parce que vous avez été assez près du travail pour savoir ce qui fait réellement avancer les résultats.
 Vous pouvez parler de Google Ads avec crédibilité. Vous comprenez comment les médias, le SEO, la création, les données, le CRM, les sites Web, le CRO et le reporting s’imbriquent. Vous savez repérer les problèmes avant qu’ils ne deviennent des escalades client. Et vous avez assez d’assurance pour mener une discussion sans que tout tourne autour de votre titre.
 Vous êtes particulièrement solide lorsque le parcours vers la conversion est complexe — là où la qualité des leads, le pipeline, l’alignement avec les ventes, les pages de destination et les parcours de conversion comptent autant que l’efficacité média.
 Ce n’est pas un rôle de « status call et courriel de récapitulation ». Ce rôle s’adresse à une personne capable de relier les objectifs d’affaires des clients à la stratégie marketing, de challenger avec intention et de diriger un portefeuille de comptes ciblé en profondeur — plutôt que de disperser son attention sur une longue liste de clients gérés en surface.
 Ce poste n’est pas pour tout le monde. 
 Nous bâtissons quelque chose de rare: un endroit où la croissance, la vérité et la haute performance avancent ensemble.
 Vous allez vous épanouir ici si: 
 ✅ Vous avez dirigé des relations clients dans un environnement d’agence de marketing de performance.
✅ Vous comprenez comment les canaux marketing modernes fonctionnent ensemble — médias, SEO, création, données, CRM, site Web, CRO et analytique.
✅ Vous pouvez parler de Google Ads et de stratégie médias payants avec crédibilité.
✅ Les résultats d’affaires des clients vous importent plus que les simples indicateurs de campagne.
✅ Vous pouvez diriger un portefeuille ciblé de clients en profondeur, plutôt que gérer une énorme liste en surface.
✅ Votre réflexe naturel est « je m’en occupe », même lorsque le travail dépasse légèrement votre champ habituel.
 Et vous aurez de la difficulté ici si: 
 ❌ Votre expérience est principalement axée sur la marque, la création, le commerce électronique ou le DTC, sans expérience approfondie en agence de performance.
❌ Vous avez seulement géré des comptes en surface, dans un contexte de très grand volume de clients.
❌ Vous avez besoin d’une description de poste très étroite pour savoir ce qui vous appartient.
❌ Vous protégez le périmètre du mandat avant de protéger le résultat.
❌ Vous ne pouvez pas parler de stratégie de canaux avec crédibilité au-delà des grands principes.
 À propos de Level
 Nous sommes une agence de marketing de performance propulsée par l’IA — bâtie pour la précision, conçue pour croître, et alimentée par une mentalité scientifique. Chez Level, nous combinons stratégie, médias, création et intelligence machine pour générer des résultats qui comptent. Chaque fois. À grande échelle.
 Nous avons été nommés parmi les meilleurs lieux de travail de Pittsburgh et reconnus comme l’une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide du classement Inc. 500. Nos clients œuvrent notamment en B2B, en éducation, en santé, en services financiers, en commerce électronique et dans plusieurs autres secteurs.
 Votre rôle et votre impact
 À titre d’Account Director, vous dirigerez des relations clients axées sur la performance au sein d’un portefeuille de comptes ciblé. Vous serez au croisement de la stratégie client, de l’exécution marketing, du leadership auprès des équipes internes et de l’impact d’affaires.
 Vous serez la personne à qui les clients font confiance pour leur dire la vérité, celle sur qui les équipes internes comptent pour créer de la clarté, et celle qui garde la stratégie arrimée à des résultats mesurables.
 Vous devrez:
 Diriger la stratégie de performance: Traduire les objectifs d’affaires des clients en stratégies marketing multicanaux qui génèrent une croissance mesurable.
 Prendre en charge les relations clients: Bâtir la confiance avec les parties prenantes seniors grâce à une communication claire, une pensée proactive et des recommandations stratégiques solides.
 Relier l’écosystème marketing: Aider les clients à comprendre comment les médias payants, le SEO, la création, les données, le CRM, les sites Web, le CRO et le reporting travaillent ensemble pour améliorer la performance.
 Apporter une aisance en médias payants: Parler avec crédibilité de Google Ads, des médias sociaux payants et de la performance média — même si vous n’êtes pas la personne qui effectue chaque changement dans les plateformes.
 Repérer les problèmes tôt: Creuser les tendances de performance, poser de meilleures questions et détecter les enjeux avant qu’ils ne deviennent des escalades client.
 Challenger avec intention: Remettre en question les hypothèses des clients lorsque nécessaire — toujours au service de l’objectif de performance, jamais par ego, protection de périmètre ou besoin de contrôle.
 Gérer un portefeuille en profondeur: Diriger un portefeuille ciblé de comptes avec suffisamment de profondeur pour vraiment comprendre les activités, les leviers de performance et les risques de chaque client.
 Guider les équipes internes: Collaborer avec les équipes médias, SEO, création, analytique et stratégie afin de faire avancer le travail, clarifier les priorités et aligner les résultats.
 Raconter l’histoire dans les données: Transformer les rapports, les tableaux de bord et les analyses de performance en insights que les clients peuvent mettre en action.
 Maîtriser les détails: Garder les budgets, prévisions, échéanciers, documents et communications clairs, exacts et à jour.
 Exigences
 Essentiels
 5 ans et plus dans une agence de marketing de performance. Vous avez une expérience en agence ancrée dans la performance, les médias payants et les résultats mesurables — et non principalement dans la marque, la création ou le commerce électronique seulement.
 Expérience en leadership de comptes dans un environnement de performance. Vous êtes actuellement Account Director dans une agence de marketing de performance, ou vous avez commencé en marketing, médias payants, analytique ou gestion de campagnes avant de faire la transition vers le leadership de comptes.
 Aisance obligatoire avec Google Ads. Vous pouvez parler de Google Ads avec crédibilité et savez quoi examiner lorsque la performance fluctue, que le volume de leads baisse ou que la qualité des conversions change.
 Compréhension de l’écosystème marketing moderne. Vous comprenez comment les médias payants, le SEO, la création, les données, le CRM, les sites Web, le CRO et l’analytique se connectent pour générer des résultats.
 Solide profondeur en stratégie médias payants. Vous comprenez comment les canaux médias fonctionnent ensemble, particulièrement le search et le social, et pouvez traduire les signaux de performance en stratégie.
 Expérience en leadership client. Vous avez géré des relations clients, animé des conversations stratégiques et présenté des recommandations à des parties prenantes seniors.
 Expérience en gestion de comptes ciblée. Vous avez l’habitude de diriger un portefeuille significatif de clients en profondeur — environ 3 à 8 comptes — plutôt que de répartir votre attention sur une longue liste à haut volume avec peu de profondeur.
 Expérience avec des budgets médias significatifs. Vous avez travaillé avec des clients qui investissent au moins 50 000 $ par mois en médias par client; 100 000 $ et plus par mois est fortement souhaité.
 Mentalité orientée affaires. Vous parlez de revenus, de pipeline, de qualité des leads, de parcours de conversion, de parcours client et de résultats d’affaires — pas seulement de CTR, de CPC et de métriques de plateforme.
 Peu d’ego, beaucoup d’ownership. Vous êtes prêt ou prête à construire le tableau de bord, chercher la réponse, clarifier l’ambiguïté ou combler l’écart lorsque l’équipe en a besoin.
 Fortement souhaités
 Expérience en B2B, génération de leads ou ventes complexes. Une expérience avec des cycles d’achat plus longs, la qualité du pipeline, l’alignement avec les ventes ou des parcours de conversion non DTC est un grand atout.
 Aisance avec Meta, LinkedIn, le SEO, le CRM, le CRO ou d’autres canaux. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être expert ou experte dans chaque canal, mais vous devez comprendre comment ils fonctionnent ensemble.
 Expérience dans les services financiers, la santé, l’éducation, le SaaS ou d’autres secteurs à achat réfléchi.
 Aisance avec les tableaux de bord, les outils de reporting, Google Analytics et la visualisation de données.
 Expérience en mentorat auprès de membres d’équipes de comptes ou en coordination d’équipes de livraison interfonctionnelles.
 Attentes liées à l’IA
 Chez Level, l’IA est une compétence — pas un raccourci. Dans ce rôle, on s’attendra à ce que vous puissiez:
 Utiliser des outils comme ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude et Perplexity pour améliorer votre façon de travailler
 Partager vos prompts, vos améliorations de processus et vos idées avec l’équipe
 Expérimenter régulièrement et raffiner vos façons de travailler au fil du temps
 Accueillir l’inconfort comme une partie normale du processus d’apprentissage
 Appliquer les outils d’IA pour augmenter votre vitesse, votre clarté et votre créativité — sans remplacer un travail réfléchi
 L’IA devrait vous rendre plus aiguisé ou aiguisée, plus rapide et plus stratégique. Elle ne devrait jamais remplacer le jugement, le goût, l’imputabilité ou un point de vue solide.
 Nos valeurs fondamentales
 Pas d’ego, engagement total
 Chez nous, « ce n’est pas mon travail » n’a pas sa place. Nous gagnons ensemble, nous prêtons main-forte là où il le faut, et nous nous soucions davantage du résultat que de l’organigramme.
 Meilleur chaque jour
 Nous voulons recevoir du feedback — même lorsqu’il pique un peu. Nous testons, apprenons, nous adaptons et continuons à élever la barre.
 Obsédés par les résultats
 L’activité ne vaut rien sans résultats. Ce qui compte pour nous, c’est le travail qui fait avancer l’entreprise.
 Guidés par la vérité
 Nous remettons les hypothèses en question, suivons les données et disons aux clients ce qu’ils doivent entendre — pas seulement ce qui est facile à dire.
 Avantages et bénéfices
 Chez Level, nous soutenons nos équipes aux États-Unis et au Canada grâce à des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.
 Télétravail complet partout aux États-Unis et au Canada, allocation mensuelle pour le travail à domicile et vendredis d’été
 Congés généreux, incluant des congés payés illimités aux États-Unis, des vacances concurrentielles au Canada et des options de congé parental/familial
 Assurances collectives complètes, soutien en santé mentale, et assurance invalidité et assurance vie payées par l’entreprise
 Cotisations de retraite de l’employeur: 401(k) aux États-Unis et contribution REER au Canada
 Évaluations de performance trimestrielles et occasions d’avancement professionnel
 Télétravail d’abord
 Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes résidant aux États-Unis et au Canada et est entièrement en télétravail. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de commanditer des visas pour le moment.
 Level est fondée sur l’inclusion
 Nous sommes engagés envers la diversité, l’équité, l’inclusion et l’appartenance. Level est fière d’être un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi — nous célébrons ce qui fait de vous une personne unique.
 Prêt ou prête à postuler?
 Cliquez ci-dessous pour soumettre votre CV. Vous répondrez aussi à quelques questions réfléchies, alors prenez le temps qu’il faut.
 Ce qui nous importe le plus, c’est votre façon de penser, votre façon de diriger et votre capacité à créer de l’impact — pas que votre parcours ait été parfaitement linéaire.
 Bâtissons quelque chose ensemble.

jobs.title: Director, Client Success and Adoption US
jobs.description:
Jacobian builds AI-powered radiology reporting software, including Fluency for Imaging (FFI) and SmartAssist. Our customers are US health systems, imaging centers and radiology groups that rely on FFI every day to produce patient reports.
 This director brings together two teams with a shared mission: helping customers realize measurable value from FFI and grow into long-term partners. Client Success Managers own the commercial relationship, account health and renewals. Adoption Specialists drive radiologist and administrator enablement, including SmartAssist rollouts. The director runs both as one motion, with the Client Success Manager accountable for the account and the Adoption Specialist work planned against each account's goals.
 As Jacobian's US customer base grows, this director will scale both teams to match. That means planning headcount ahead of demand, hiring and onboarding new team members, and building repeatable playbooks and coverage models so service quality holds as account and site volume increase. The role partners closely with Implementation, Support, Sales, Marketing, and Product teams. Drive growth through our existing customers by ensuring each one is live, engaged, and achieving measurable clinical and operational results, earning their renewal, expansion, and advocacy.
 This is a remote role based in the US or Canada. 
 Key Responsibilitites 
 Operating model: Define US customer segmentation (high-touch, scaled, digital), the engagement model and coverage ratios for each tier, and the customer lifecycle from the go-live handoff through renewal. 
 Team leadership: Hire, onboard, coach, and retain Client Success Managers and Adoption Specialists. Define role profiles and career paths between the two roles, run a regular performance-management cadence, and plan headcount ahead of customer growth.
 Training and adoption: Lead new-customer training on Fluency for Imaging, from administrator onboarding through radiologist go-live. Run adoption programs for AI features such as SmartAssist, own speech recognition tuning and troubleshooting, and set utilization benchmarks by product.
 Customer health and risk: Build health scores in HubSpot from FFI usage, SmartAssist adoption, speech recognition performance, support trends, and sentiment. Set early-warning signals, and own how at-risk accounts are identified, escalated, and recovered.
 Value and retention: Lead executive business reviews that show customers the clinical and operational value they are getting. Own the US renewal calendar and forecast.
 Build and run a US reference radiologist network through the Adoption Specialists and CSMs: recruit continuously (including via the SmartAssist rollout), match members to Sales and Marketing needs, give back through fees or non-financial benefits, and measure participation and impact on renewals.
 Growth and advocacy: Partner with Sales on expansion opportunities and clean pre- and post-sale handoffs, and with Marketing on references and customer advocacy.
 Cross-team handoffs: Own the customer relationship across Implementation and Technical Support. Set exit criteria for the go-live handoff from Implementation, and coordinate with Technical Support on escalations and recurring issues so customers get one consistent experience.
 Scaled engagement: Serve smaller accounts efficiently through HubSpot-driven touchpoints, triggered playbooks, AI-assisted account preparation, and meeting capture.
 Voice of the customer: Bring structured customer feedback to Product, Clinical, and the executive team. Close the loop on adoption friction and feature requests, and represent customers in roadmap discussions.
 Financial accountability: Accountable for gross and net revenue retention, churn, and renewal and expansion targets for US accounts. Contributes to the Client Success budget and headcount plan with the VP, Client Success.
 Quality and compliance: Make sure customer feedback that may be a complaint is routed into Jacobian’s complaint-handling process. Partner with Legal, Security, and Compliance on protecting customer data under HIPAA.

jobs.title: Director of Sales
jobs.description:
Help enterprises put AI agents to work in customer experience. 
 Most enterprise support teams have spent years building on platforms they rely on every day. Those platforms hold their tickets, workflows, knowledge and customer history. What’s missing is AI that can actually do the work: resolve issues, take action across systems and hold up at enterprise scale.
 That’s what Botpress does. We’re the enterprise-grade AI agent platform for customer experience, backed by a $25 million Series B. Over 1 million AI agents run in production on Botpress, and more than 4,000 customers use the platform, including American Express and GE. We pioneered tool calling for AI agents and were the first to bring a commercial retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) offering to market. 
 We work alongside the systems our customers already use, integrating and partnering with them to make them work better.
 At Botpress, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective and talents. We work fully in-office in Montreal. If you want to help build what comes next, we’d like to meet you.

 About the Role 
 We’re hiring a Director of Sales to lead our team of three account executives through a pivot into a more consultative, sales-led motion with mid-market and enterprise companies. You’ll report to our CRO and work closely together to find product-market fit in a new category, then build the team to scale it. This is a hands-on role: you’ll be in deals alongside your AEs at critical moments, and you’ll grow the team with us, with a seat in hiring from day one. The role is based in our Montreal office.
 Responsibilities 
 Lead and develop the sales team. Coach and lead our account executives as a hands-on leader, and grow the team with us. Set clear expectations and build a culture of curiosity, accountability and consistent execution.
 Own the forecast and pipeline. Run a weekly operating rhythm with rigorous forecasting, pipeline reviews and deal inspection in HubSpot. Translate our revenue goals into account priorities, pipeline targets and coverage, and drive the team to hit them.
 Guide complex deals from discovery to signature. Coach sellers through multi-stakeholder buying committees using MEDDPICC or a similar framework, and engage directly at critical moments. Bring in Solutions Engineering, security, legal and leadership for business cases, technical validation, pricing and negotiation.
 Turn pilots into contracts. Make sure each pilot has a clear scope, agreed success measures, a defined spend cap and terms that convert it to an annual contract. Help the team navigate budget timing, procurement and security reviews, and lead deal reviews that surface risk early and turn it into clear next steps.
 Help define product-market fit. Test what resonates with mid-market and enterprise buyers, read the signals in our pipeline, and tell us plainly what’s working and what isn’t. Bring market signals and customer feedback to Product and leadership to shape where Botpress goes next.
 Partner with outbound and Marketing. Work with our outbound team and Marketing on account segmentation, targeting, messaging and account-based plays. Give them regular, specific feedback on what converts so pipeline quality improves every month.
 Build a repeatable go-to-market motion. Turn what works into stages, playbooks, enablement and metrics the team can run without you in the room. Once product-market fit is established, build the hiring model and capacity plan: headcount, ramp and pipeline coverage.
 Lead an AI-native sales team. Embed AI into how the team researches accounts, develops outreach, prepares for calls, plans deals and forecasts. Model it yourself, share what works, and help sellers spend more time on judgment, strategy and customer relationships.

jobs.title: Director, Operations
jobs.description:
veritree and Job Overview
 veritree is an award-winning climate tech start-up based in Vancouver. Launched in 2021, our technology measures and verifies the impact of global restoration efforts from the ground up. We are on a mission to plant 1 billion verified trees by 2030, collaborating with businesses, planting organizations, and consumers who believe in the transformative power of verified restoration projects to create real and meaningful impact for the planet, nature, and people.

veritree is seeking a Director, Operations to lead our Operations team: the glue that connects our teams and initiatives. Reporting to the COO, you will own veritree’s Revenue Ops, Supply Ops, Business Ops, and Business Intelligence functions. These functions empower our Revenue, Forests, Product & Engineering, and Finance teams to operate as one business.

 We sell verified trees sourced from planting partners worldwide, alongside new business lines in carbon, monitoring technology licensing, and nonprofit programs. That makes our business closer to a two-sided marketplace than pure SaaS: every customer commitment depends on supply, delivery, and data lining up behind it. As we move to a new AI-native platform, our Operations team is evolving into a team of operations engineers who build the tools, automations, and data flows the business runs on.

This is a hands-on role: you’ll run operations first and then evolve the systems behind it. You inherit a capable team and working systems (several of which we’ve outgrown) and leave behind infrastructure the rest of the company can build upon. The role starts at Director-level, with room for advancement as determined by job performance and business needs.

 12 Month Key Outcomes (12m KOs)
 Take the wheel: within your first 90 days, run the weekly operations cadence, own escalations across all four functions, and become the decision-maker on operational calls.
 Operating rhythm: set up how Operations runs for the next stage of the company: a clear meeting rhythm, defined team roles/decision rights, one agreed definition and owner for core metrics (pipeline, ACV, NRR, gross margin, tree inventory), and a 12-month operations roadmap signed off by executive leadership.
 Trusted data and reporting: keep commercial and delivery data clean across HubSpot, NetSuite, and the platform through go-live and beyond, and produce the monthly reporting pack and the operational metrics in board reporting from the BI stack.
 AI and automation: ship AI-powered tools and automations that measurably reduce manual work and save costs across the business.

What You’ll Do
 Cross-Functional Operations
 Run the operating cadence (meeting cadences, monthly business reviews, semi-annual planning) and the forums where Revenue, Forests, and Product & Engineering align on priorities.
 Own the deal desk with Sales, Customer Success, and Forests, so what we sell matches what we can deliver.
 Own the intake, prioritization, and SLA framework for operations requests from every team.
 Own operational readiness on the platform after go-live: close workflow gaps with Product & Engineering and lead change management.
 Make operational and commercial decisions within agreed guardrails (pricing, margin floors, custom deliverables), and escalate exceptions to executive leadership with a clear recommendation.
 Team Leadership & Development
 Lead, coach, and develop the Operations team, including managers and individual contributors.
 Own hiring, onboarding, and ongoing performance management, in partnership with People Operations.
 Evolve the team into operations engineers by defining roles and scopes and building a culture that is both high-accountability and high-support.
 Revenue Operations
 Own HubSpot as our commercial system of record, including deal stages, order and contract workflows, and clean handoffs between Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance.
 Own the customer revenue forecast and its methodology, in partnership with Finance and Revenue leadership.
 Own pricing discipline: the price sheet, margin floors, and a quarterly margin and pricing review.
 Own lead and sales funnel, retention, and unit-economics reporting.
 Supply Operations
 Own demand and supply planning, translating the customer forecast into tree demand by ecosystem and region and partnering with Forests on sourcing and capacity.
 Own order management, inventory allocation, purchase orders, and fulfillment tracking, including future obligations to customers and planting partners, so every order is delivered on time against the right supply.
 Business Operations
 Own the processes, policies, tooling, and Operations budget that keep the business running, and decide what gets automated and what stays manual.
 Run the OKR process and tracker, and support annual operating planning.
 Own the operating model for customer and partner site visits.
 Business Intelligence & Reporting
 Own our data warehouse and BI layer, pulling from HubSpot, NetSuite, the platform, and planting data, as the single source of truth for operational metrics.
 Direct the team’s AI agenda, shipping internal tools, agents, and workflow automations that measurably increase output across the business.

jobs.title: Director, Fleet & Assets
jobs.description:
Transdev Ontario & Manitoba is hiring a Director, Fleet and Assets to fill an upcoming vacancy.

 Your Role 
 Reporting directly to the Senior VP Ontario & Manitoba, this role will be the lead to manage costs of maintenance, location maintenance facilities, external vendors ensuring one of the largest mobility passenger fleets in these provinces safe and compliant. 
 This role is accountable for fleet maintenance across both provinces: roughly 2,000 vehicles across 35 Ontario depots, 10 internal garages, The ideal candidate will have experience managing a highly diverse, geographically vast fleet and operation, and must be willing to travel to all Transdev Ontario & Manitoba locations. This role will be based in the GTA (Mississauga/Brampton). This is not a hybrid role – your time is split between the field and the office.  
 Primary Responsibilities 
 Fleet Compliance & Safety  
 Own fleet maintenance compliance and safety, #1 one priority: every vehicle seen on a regular cycle within the required preventative maintenance schedules, 
 Lead the Fleet Managers who monitor compliance across their location zones, and protect service availability so routes and contracts are never at risk 
 Cost & Garage Performance  
 Reduce total fleet maintenance spend by contract while maintaining 100% safety & compliance
 Use data to diagnose where cost and time, technician productivity, standard repair times, vehicle age and type, unscheduled repairs and the current ratio of technician to vehicle ratio
 Transform internal garages to operate as stand-alone entities that quote cost, turnaround and return time at drop-off, and assess technician specialization by vehicle type or service line 
 Vendor Management & Procurement  
 Manage agreements and performance for external repair vendors, including all maintenance in Ontario & Manitoba, measured on turnaround, repair quality, price and work allocation 
 Share work deliberately across vendors to keep pricing competitive, and act directly on pricing and urgent procurement needs 
 Fleet Lifecycle, Growth & Systems  
 Lead fleet replacement and capital planning, 
 Support growth from new contracts and acquisitions, 
 Define and review the fleet maintenance KPIs the organization needs, and join the national move to Hexagon fleet maintenance software, using it from go-live alongside the project team that leads implementation 
 Team Leadership & Executive Presence  
 Lead direct reports:  zone-based Fleet Managers and an Administrative Supervisor who manage about 50 licensed technicians 
 Represent fleet credibly with the SVP, the Ontario & Manitoba provincial leadership team and national maintenance leadership, explaining what is being done, why and by when 
 Bring a business case, not just an opinion, and stay open to challenge, feedback and coaching

jobs.title: Director of Retention Marketing
jobs.description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.
 We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.
 The mission of this role 
 Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.
 Who are we? 
 We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit? 
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday: have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
 Speed Is King: spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
 Work Smart: AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
 Overdeliver: bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like) 
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.
 Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
 Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
 Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
 Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
 Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order
 Key Objectives 
 Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
 Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
 Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
 Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
 Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
 Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
 Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Content & Community
jobs.description:
THE ROLE 
 We are looking for an Associate Director, Content & Community to join our growing Creative Strategy team. This is a team of curious, culturally connected thinkers with a passion for social, where audience behaviours, platform intelligence and creative ideas come together to move brands forward.
 This is a client-facing role for someone who loves turning business challenges into compelling social-first strategies and creative opportunities. They know their platforms, keep their finger on the pulse of culture, and believe great strategy should inspire great work. Creative briefs are their love language, and a good brainstorm is their happy place.

 WE ARE  
 A creative agency powered by social connections. That means we thrive on what’s trending and creating campaigns that get people buzzing. We call it “Ideas Worth Talking About,” and we're proud to have played a part in some of the most culturally relevant campaigns of the decade for brands like McDonald’s, Adidas, Universal Studios, and YouTube.

 WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE 
 We like to laugh, we live for celeb gossip and we’re great on AUX.
 Our passport program lets you explore and work from one of our 16 other offices worldwide, including Paris, Singapore, Madrid, Dubai, London and more!
 You best believe we know how to celebrate our wins. And our losses (it’s how we learn). 
 From carbon offsets to community kitchens, we’re passionate about making a difference. 

 YOU ARE 
 A person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, responding quickly and proactively
 Not interested in just following trends – you want to create them
 A self-starter, who’ll take ideas from concept to execution, navigating feedback like a pro  

 Traditional agency experience is not required, but it’s a plus. What matters is your deep understanding of what resonates with social audiences. This role is energetic, innovative and forward-thinking. Alongside engaging with communities, you’ll guide brands by staying ahead of social trends and cultural moments. In return, you’ll join a global agency dedicated to generating buzzworthy ideas for some of the world’s leading brands. 

 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Lead social strategy development across clients, translating business objectives, audience insights and brand priorities into compelling social-first strategies and creative opportunities.
 Develop actionable content pillars, editorial frameworks, campaign strategies and channel plans that guide creative execution.
 Apply deep platform expertise to ensure strategies are native to each channel, reflecting evolving behaviours, formats and opportunities.
 Identify cultural trends, audience behaviours and emerging conversations to uncover meaningful opportunities for brands.
 Translate research, social listening and performance insights into strategic recommendations, creative briefs and ideas.
 Partner with Creative and Influencer teams to develop distinctive, culturally relevant work grounded in strong strategic thinking.
 Own strategic delivery across multiple projects and accounts, ensuring the quality and consistency of all outputs.
 Lead newsroom and planning processes, connecting cultural intelligence, platform opportunities and brand priorities to drive proactive storytelling.
 Identify paid social opportunities, formats and placements that amplify creative ideas and strengthen campaign effectiveness.
 Build trusted client relationships, confidently presenting recommendations and influencing strategic decision-making.
 Establish meaningful objectives and success measures, using performance insights to continuously improve creative and strategic approaches.
 Apply AI tools to accelerate research, uncover insights and enhance strategic thinking, creative development and ways of working.
 Mentor and develop junior talent through clear direction, constructive feedback and ongoing coaching.

jobs.title: Managing Director
jobs.description:
Managing Director 
 Remote — Canada or United States     |     Full-time     |     Reports to: Managing Partner

 About Edelweiss Software Group
 Edelweiss Software Group is an operating group of Valsoft Corporation, serving as a permanent basecamp for vertical market software companies. Our philosophy is simple: your company leads; we support the ascent. With a buy-and-hold-forever approach, Edelweiss preserves each company's brand and provides the steady guidance, capital, and resources needed to keep both products and people moving upward. We form long-term strategic alliances with existing management teams — we don't buy to sell — placing a premium on the well-being of customers and employees over short-term goals.

 The Role
 We are seeking an entrepreneurial and operationally minded Managing Director to lead one of our software businesses. Reporting directly to the Managing Partner, you will own the P&L, set strategic direction, and drive sustained, profitable growth across the product portfolio.
 This is a hands-on operator role for a leader who can build as much as run. The business is at an exciting inflection point, with a stable core and a new generation of products moving toward market. You will define and execute the strategy for its next phase — evolving the operating model, sharpening the go-to-market engine, and bringing new products successfully to market — while building a transparent, high-performing, customer-obsessed organization. You will operate with high autonomy, supported by Valsoft's long-term investment model, operational expertise, and global network.

 What You'll Lead
 •    Drive the next phase of growth — Expand repeatable, high-quality revenue; refine cross-product go-to-market; and identify new opportunities across markets, segments, and channels.
 •    Steer the product portfolio — Refine clear, market-aligned product roadmaps, bring the next generation of products to market and toward self-sustaining economics, and leverage emerging tools (including AI) to enhance the platform.
 •    Evolve the operating model — Move toward business-unit-level ownership and accountability, with the transparency, discipline, and incentives to scale while improving E2E operational efficiency with the use of AI
 •    Deepen customer value — Improve retention, satisfaction, and lifetime value, and embed a culture of customer-led innovation.
 •    Own performance and outcomes — Take full accountability for revenue, EBITDA, and cash flow, with disciplined capital allocation and predictable financial performance.
 •    Lead and grow the organization — Build and develop a high-performing team and a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, with a customer-first mindset.

 Candidate Profile
 Experience 
 •    Proven experience as a CEO, Managing Director, COO, VP or General Manager with full P&L ownership of a software or technology business.
 •    P&L scale: Prior P&L accountability of $5M or more.
 •    Team leadership: Experience leading and developing a team of 10 or more.
 •    New-product track record: Has brought new products to market and successfully scaled them.
 •    Track record of scaling and growing established software businesses and of transforming a business.
 •    Strong commercial instinct across sales, pricing, and go-to-market strategy, including cross-sell and market penetration.
 •    Ability to lead across product, operations, and finance, with sound financial acumen (P&L management, budgeting, forecasting).
 •    Comfort with emerging technologies, including AI.
 •    Bachelor's degree in business, finance, engineering, economics, or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is a strong asset.
 Personal characteristics 
 •    Empathetic leader:A strong ability to influence others, and an empathetic, active listener.
 •    Entrepreneurial spirit — results-oriented, driven, proactive, and a team player.
 •    Both strategic and hands-on, with the ability to translate vision into actionable plans and drive results.
 •    A high degree of accountability and ownership.
 •    Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to change with agility.
 •    A people-centric leader who leads with humility, empathy, and sound judgment.

 Why This Opportunity Stands Out
 •    A platform for growth — Lead an established, market-leading business at a genuine inflection point — with the core stabilized and a new product generation ready to scale.
 •    True ownership — Run the business with full autonomy and accountability, empowered to make decisions and drive outcomes.
 •    Long-term backing — Valsoft's buy-and-hold-forever model means you build enduring value rather than managing toward an exit.
 •    A proven operating model — Access Valsoft's playbooks, capital, and global network of experienced software operators while retaining independence in execution.
 •    Flexibility — Fully remote, based anywhere in Canada or the United States.

 #EdelweissSoftware

jobs.title: Director, Integrated Marketing
jobs.description:
Who we are:
 Creyos (formerly Cambridge Brain Sciences) is a leading growth-stage B2B SaaS HealthTech company. Our proprietary digital cognitive assessment tools, including digital cognitive tasks and electronic behavioral health questionnaires, are used by healthcare providers treating mental health conditions, brain injuries, aging, and other patient populations throughout the world, as well as by leading researchers. You will be part of a team that includes not just your typical SaaS business functions (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success), but also engineers, psychologists, business leaders, and even a world-renowned neuroscientist
 Who we are looking for:
 We’re seeking a Director of Integrated Marketing to build the engine behind our growth. The ideal candidate has experience in both SMB and enterprise marketing and has built winning demand generation programs from the ground up—equally comfortable crafting account-based marketing (ABM) strategies as they are launching and optimizing hands-on, multi-channel campaigns. You appreciate the complexity of healthcare, including long sales cycles and buying committees spanning clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders. You are energized by building relationships with key stakeholders, advancing opportunities, and inspiring action.
 You are a player-coach. You know when to set the strategy and when to write the brief yourself, challenge the message, and review the work. You’ve led multidisciplinary marketers before and raised their game, not just their output. You’re comfortable deciding with imperfect information and building a repeatable process where little exists yet.
 This is a hybrid role based in Toronto, ON. The successful candidate must live in the GTA and be available to commute regularly to our downtown office. 

 What you will be doing: 
 As a Director, Integrated Marketing at Creyos, you will:
 Enterprise Marketing & Account-Based Marketing 
 Help build and lead our enterprise and ABM strategy with the CMO, Sales leadership, and Revenue Operations.
 Develop a tiered ABM model — one-to-one for strategic accounts, one-to-few for account clusters, one-to-many for broader segments — with clear target-account criteria and success measures.
 Create repeatable account plays Sales and Marketing activate together, measured on account progression and opportunity creation rather than impressions and clicks.
 Team Leadership & Development 
 Lead, coach, and develop team members across demand generation and field marketing, helping them gain new experiences and elevate competencies. 
 Set clear priorities, ownership, and performance expectations, and address gaps directly and fairly.
 Introduce the frameworks and coaching that let the team execute high-quality campaigns independently.
 Integrated Campaign Leadership 
 Lead campaigns end to end: business objective, audience insight, message, creative, activation, and optimization.
 Write the briefs that align messaging, content, creative, channels, Sales participation, timelines, and metrics.
 Sharpen segmentation and targeting for professional and mid-market programs, moving demand generation from broad tactics to focused, insight-led campaigns.
 Customer Marketing & Retention 
 Partner with Account Management, Sales, and Product on lifecycle programs supporting product engagement, renewal, advocacy, and expansion.
 Support GTM strategies for new feature launches, developing communication and advertising plans to promote early excitement and adoption.
 Messaging & Creative Direction 
 Partner with the CMO to continually elevate the clarity and differentiation of our messaging, grounding it in customer problems and outcomes rather than product features.
 Give specific, actionable feedback to team members on concepts, writing, design, and sales materials that materially improves the work.
 Planning, Performance & Optimization 
 Own the marketing campaign calendar and a consistent cadence for planning, briefing, launch readiness, and post-campaign review.
 Report on performance across SMB and enterprise segments, including target-account engagement, lead progression, opportunity creation, pipeline value, and closed-won business. 
 Partner with Revenue Operations to improve reporting and attribution, and use results to improve the next program.

 The skills and experience we are looking for: 
 8+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, ideally in high-growth SaaS and specifically HealthTech.
 4+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional marketing programs.
 Demonstrated success building enterprise and ABM programs across one-to-one, one-to-few, and one-to-many motions.
 Proven ability to connect ABM activity to account progression, pipeline, revenue, or expansion.
 Experience marketing to enterprise buying committees through long, complex sales cycles.
 Strong integrated campaign development and project management across multiple channels and functions.
 Exceptional messaging, writing, editing, creative briefing, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor tone, framing, and content to the audience and desired outcome.
 A close working history with Sales, account management, and Revenue Operations.
 Experience coaching marketers at varying levels of capability and independence.
 Comfortable in a growth-stage, resource-constrained environment — resourceful, decisive, and low ego.
 Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Analytics, and other MarTech platforms.

 Some of the reasons people choose to join the Creyos team include:
 Get access to comprehensive benefits. We pride ourselves on offering benefits covering medical, dental, vision, mental health, wellness and more.
 Grow through our career paths leading to more senior roles. We invest in the development of our team members, provide significant opportunities for growth and career advancement, and do everything we can to support one another to ensure individual and team success. We regularly promote team members to more senior roles.
 Recharge during our annual company-wide break and extra holidays. In addition to vacation and quarterly Personal Days, every year we take a company-wide break in December to rest and recharge. We also give team members two additional holidays off per year: U.S. Independence Day and U.S. Thanksgiving, which we celebrate as Brain Holidays. We want you to feel motivated and energized at work! 

 This role is targeting a salary of $155,000 - $175,000 CAD. 

 Additional information:
 Creyos uses an AI-powered tool as part of an automated process to support our hiring process by analyzing your experience, skills, and qualifications to help identify alignment with role requirements. These tools also assist with administrative tasks such as calendar invites, note-taking and documentation to ensure we can focus more fully on our conversations with you. Because AI-generated documentation occasionally contains inaccuracies or omissions, our team uses this as secondary, supportive reference only. Please note that the tool does not make final decisions or automatically disqualify candidates. Hiring decisions are made by our team, with thoughtful human judgment and oversight. We are committed to fair and transparent hiring practices and have implemented safeguards to help mitigate bias and support compliance with applicable laws. By proceeding with your application, you understand that these administrative tools are used to support our team’s evaluation and documentation process. 
 Please Note: This posting is for an existing open vacancy at the company. 
 Creyos is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, or another legally protected status. We are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA). Creyos will provide accommodations to job applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodation, please notify our Talent Acquisition Manager directly and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Creative Director (Organic Social)
jobs.description:
Marriage Reset is on a mission to save one million marriages. Our coaching programs help men rebuild their relationships and become better husbands. More than 7500 clients have enrolled, and our content has generated millions of views across social platforms.
 We are hiring a Creative Director to take full ownership of our organic social department. Paid media currently drives most of our client acquisition. We want to build a stronger organic presence that earns trust in the brand and consistently generates qualified inbound calls.
 Instagram is our main growth priority. You will be responsible for the content strategy and creative standards across all our organic channels, with the autonomy to lead the department and accountability for its performance.

 The role 
 You will work directly with Josh Hudson, our co-founder and main spokesperson, to develop the brand’s organic content strategy. You will plan several months ahead, establish the monthly content agenda, and direct the work from initial concept to final approval.
 Your responsibilities include developing content angles, writing scripts in Josh’s voice, and preparing recording briefs. You will run a content waterfall that turns long-form recordings into content tailored to each platform, with a consistent production and publishing schedule.
 You will manage and develop the editors and copywriters, review their work, and take responsibility for the quality of everything we publish. You will also work with the wider marketing team to maintain a consistent brand across our digital presence.
 Performance analysis will guide the strategy. Across all organic channels, you will assess audience growth and content performance, then work with sales to understand the contribution to qualified enquiries and booked calls. You will use that evidence to set priorities and improve results.
 We expect you to take initiative, make informed creative decisions and lead the department without close supervision.

 Requirements 
 • Proven organic social growth | A track record of growing an account for a founder, brand or yourself, supported by starting and ending audience figures, a clear timeframe and evidence of your personal contribution.
 • Strategic content leadership | Experience developing content strategies over several months, directing production and adapting the plan based on performance. You must be able to connect day-to-day creative decisions to the wider business objectives.
 • Advanced copywriting and scriptwriting | Strong command of hooks, storytelling and copywriting frameworks, with the ability to translate a founder’s expertise into compelling content that retains their voice.
 • Content waterfall implementation | Experience building and managing a repeatable system for turning long-form recordings into short-form video and other content adapted to different platforms.
 • Management of both video editors and copywriters | Direct experience setting briefs, reviewing scripts and edits, coaching team members, and holding them accountable for quality and deadlines.
 • Practical AI experience | Experience integrating AI into content production or editing workflows, with editorial oversight to protect accuracy, quality, and brand voice.
 • Excellent written and spoken English | The ability to write persuasive, natural copy for an English-speaking audience and communicate precise creative direction.

 Preferred experience 
 We place particular weight on substantial growth achieved for a founder’s account, especially on Instagram. Candidates with strong results from their own accounts or other brands will also be considered.
 • Significant audience growth | Adding around 100,000 followers to another person’s account, or growing your own account to that size, is highly valued. This is a preference, not a minimum eligibility requirement.
 • Coaching industry experience | Experience in any coaching specialty is an advantage. We also consider candidates from other industries who meet the core requirements.
 • YouTube or other long-form audience growth | A record of building an audience through long-form content.
 • Commercial results | A demonstrable contribution to multimillion-dollar sales, with a clear understanding of how that contribution was measured.

 Working arrangement 
 -This is a fully remote engagement under an independent contractor agreement, requiring a full-time commitment. The compensation package includes a base salary plus performance incentives linked to sales.
 -Time zone and core working hours: EST/PST

 Applications 
 -Please apply only if you meet the required criteria and can provide evidence of your experience. Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be progressed. 
 -Applications must be submitted through this job posting or our website. Please do not send applications or follow-up enquiries by direct message.
 -Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within one to two weeks of applying. If you have not heard from us within two weeks, your application has not been shortlisted.

 Thank you for your interest in Marriage Reset!

jobs.title: Director, Content and External Communications
jobs.description:
Aviso Wealth: 
 At Aviso Wealth, we are dedicated to improving the financial well-being of Canadians. As a leading wealth management organization, we are committed to leadership, innovation, partnership, responsibility, and community. Working with talented and energetic professionals who exemplify our values every day, you will quickly notice that our people and dynamic ‘oneaviso’ culture sets us apart. If you are looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, find out more about what Aviso Wealth has to offer at www.aviso.ca.
 The Opportunity: 
 We’re looking for a Director, Content and External Communications to join our Marketing and Client Experience team. Reporting to the VP, Marketing, this role is accountable for Aviso’s end-to-end external narrative including how we show up in the market, how our story is told across channels, and how our reputation is enhanced and protected. 
 As the leader of content strategy and external communications, you will be responsible for Aviso’s external voice across PR, thought leadership, content marketing, and social media, ensuring strong alignment between brand, business priorities, and audience needs. You will provide strategic leadership to a multi‑disciplinary team responsible for earned media and media relations, content marketing and social channels, and end‑to‑end content planning and production – ensuring consistent, high‑quality execution at scale and a clear, credible external voice. 
 This role is critical to shaping and stewarding Aviso’s reputation within the Canadian wealth services ecosystem. This includes supporting executive and CEO external communications, and managing issues and crisis communications in close partnership with Aviso’s internal Corporate Communications and Enterprise Risk Management teams. 
 Who you are: 
 Service – You consider both internal and external stakeholders and demonstrate intent of understanding and putting the clients’ needs first. You advocate service excellence and work to deliver solutions that meet the needs. You proactively develop strategic partnerships that allow Aviso Wealth to become a trusted advisor and partner
 Execution – You are committed to achieving your goals and to succeed. This includes focusing on “getting things done”, as well as recognizing and taking advantage of opportunities as they arise. You are consistently looking for ways to improve your personal best and see value in continuous improvement. You take accountability for your actions and learn from mistakes
 Collaboration – You work collaboratively with others with the common goal of driving positive results. Making meaningful contributions to your team to achieve organizational goals is a priority. You proactively encourage collaboration, build trust and inclusion, and work to establish effective relationships both inside and outside of the organization
 Leadership – You lead your team and provide regular direction, guidance, coaching, and motivation, all while striving for peak performance. You assist them in overcoming obstacles through additional resources, removal of roadblocks, and providing the level of support required for their success. You delegate and deliver feedback based on the in-depth understanding of your individual team members
 What your day looks like: 
 Strategy and Planning 
 Own and lead Aviso’s enterprise content and external communications strategy, translating business, brand and reputation priorities into integrated annual and quarterly plans across content, public relations, thought leadership, executive communications and social media
 Establish a disciplined planning and prioritization approach that balances enterprise storytelling, business-line requirements, audience needs and team capacity, supported by an integrated editorial and communications calendar 
 Content, editorial and channel leadership 
 Set Aviso's content strategy, including audience priorities, messaging architecture, editorial themes, channel roles, content formats, distribution and reuse
 Champion a clear and differentiated external voice and provide strategic and editorial oversight for high-impact content, including thought leadership, remarks, articles, presentations, social content, video, infographics, campaign content and Aviso's annual report
 Guide content experiences across Aviso's external digital and social channels, ensuring content is authoritative, accessible and discoverable across traditional search, answer engines and AI-driven discovery (SEO/AEO/GEO)
 Set the strategic direction and governance for social media channels and community management, including platform-specific strategies and engagement objectives aimed at strengthening brand trust, relevance and insight generation
 External communications and reputation 
 Lead Aviso's external communications and earned media strategy, strengthening visibility, credibility and thought leadership
 Oversee proactive media relations, including narrative development, media outreach, journalist relationships, spokesperson preparation and the identification of timely earned-media opportunities
 Guide executive external communications, including speeches, presentations, media engagements, thought leadership, and other external-facing materials
 Support issues management and crisis communications, in close partnership with Internal Corporate Communications, Enterprise Risk Management, and executive leadership
 Team leadership, governance, and performance measurement 
 Lead, coach and develop a multidisciplinary team responsible for content strategy and production, social media, public relations and earned media, setting clear mandates, priorities and performance expectations
 Foster a high-performing, collaborative culture, working closely with marketing and business line colleagues to identify and develop robust strategies that support brand trust, growth, client engagement and retention
 Develop and reconcile annual budget, oversee PR agency partnerships and related budgets, scopes, deliverables and performance
 Establish and oversee a content performance and measurement framework to assess engagement, effectiveness and impact across owned, earned and shared channels; Ensure a disciplined approach to ongoing optimization of content strategies, formats and distribution based on performance insights
 Play a key role in establishing a centralized content repository across business lines, with appropriate governance protocols, to enable consistent use, optimization and re-use of high-quality content 
 Monitor the Canadian wealth services ecosystem for developments and trends and identify opportunities for Aviso to shape conversations and anticipate reputational risks and opportunities
 Champion editorial standards, brand voice and quality across all external content, ensuring accuracy, consistency and impact

jobs.title: Director of Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
Ready to Build the Team Behind a Brand Families Love? 
 At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.
 We are seeking a Director of Talent Acquisition to own how Hadley Designs finds, vets, and closes the growth operators and future leaders who will carry our next phase of growth. If you treat recruiting like a growth problem, love being the face of a brand to candidates, and want the autonomy to run the whole engine, this role is for you.

 About Hadley Designs 
 Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.
 Our mission is to design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. Our vision is to build the most trusted children's brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow.

 Role Overview 
 As our Director of Talent Acquisition, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top talent for every open role, from Amazon and ecommerce operators to senior leaders. You will design and run the recruiting engine that consistently delivers a strong top of funnel, put every candidate through a process that shows who they really are, and bring our leadership only the people worth their time.
 This is a leadership-tier role with end-to-end ownership of recruiting, from the pipeline to the right people joining our team. There is no recruiting coordinator. You build the engine and let AI and the tools you set up carry the admin, so your time goes to meeting candidates, sourcing them, and finding new ways to reach great talent. You will run first-round interviews, including for director-level roles, manage our outside recruiting partners to our standards, and be the face of Hadley Designs for every candidate, so you need to be great on camera and great with people.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Recruiting pipeline management. Source candidates outbound and inbound across LinkedIn, Workable, job boards, online communities, referrals, and your own network, and filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and alignment with each role profile.
 Test project and interview operations. Run our Culture Index step, case studies, and first-round interviews, review submissions, and manage the candidate experience end to end, including for the people we do not hire.
 Sourcing channel optimization. Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance, and build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.
 Outside recruiting partners. Manage our agency partners so every candidate they send follows the same process, and hold them to our terms.
 New talent channels. Find creative new ways to reach great people, especially in the online communities where they already spend time.
 Employer brand and reviews. Monitor and manage Glassdoor and Indeed reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, and protect our rating.
 Hiring metrics and funnel reporting. Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role, and track funnel performance against KPIs.
 Reference checks. Run reference checks, by phone for leadership roles.

 How Success Is Measured 
 Average time to fill open roles under 45 days
 250 or more qualified applicants per active role per week
 Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel, 100% complete and on time
 15 or more completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week
 A Glassdoor company rating of 4.5 or higher across the year, with Indeed tracked beside it
 An interview and recruiting experience candidates rate highly, including the people we do not hire

jobs.description:

Powered by our AI engine, AI Services, we embed risk checks, accelerate contracting, and surface savings in one platform—helping lean teams stay compliant, efficient, and audit-ready.
 Gatekeeper has consistently achieved significant, profitable growth YoY, with our customer base including Ford, The Telegraph, Autotrader, SumUp, Crocs and Funding Circle.
 Following private equity investment from  Vista Equity Partners  we are scaling rapidly and looking to build out our Account Director team.

 Note: This is a fully remote position, open to applicants based in Ontario. 

 Role Overview 
 As an Account Director at Gatekeeper, you will be the primary contact and owner of a portfolio of high-value existing accounts, responsible for retaining, growing, and expanding these relationships. This strategic role requires a customer-centric approach to strengthen relationships, drive renewals, identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and ensure our customers achieve maximum value from our solutions.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Expansion & Growth: Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional Gatekeeper solutions by understanding customer needs and aligning our products to their business goals to help drive net revenue retention (NRR).
 Account Retention: Build strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders within your accounts, ensuring high customer satisfaction and loyalty to drive renewals to reduce logo churn.
 Customer Success & Professional Services Collaboration: Partner with the Customer Success & Professional Services team to ensure smooth onboarding, product adoption, and continued engagement, maximising customer value and product utilisation.
 Strategic Account Planning: Develop, collaborate on and execute customised account plans that align with customer goals and Gatekeeper’s growth objectives.

 Domain & Product Expertise: Become a subject matter expert in Gatekeeper’s product offerings and the broader domain of Vendor & Contract Lifecycle Management (VCLM). Leverage this expertise to guide customers in maximising the value of our solutions and to position yourself as a trusted consultant.
